detail.title: About the Partner Center Console
detail.content:
Welcome to the TikTok Shop Partner Center Console end user documentation!
The [Partner Center Console](https://partner-sso.tiktok.com/account/login) is the web application used by TikTok Shop Partners of all types to create and manage the services they offer to sellers and creators, and streamline daily operations. The TikTok Shop Partner Center Console simplifies collaboration processes and offers valuable insights into your business.
If you're just getting started and haven't yet determined which type of TikTok Service Partner you are or you haven't yet onboarded, please start by learning more about [TikTok Shop Service Partner types](6789f6fd2dccb8030e8de98b).
## **Next steps**
If you're ready to get started or are an established TikTok Shop Partner, you can learn more about TikTok Shop Partner Center Console functionality in the guides specific to your partner type.
### **TikTok Shop Partner Center Console guides**

* [TikTok Shop Partner Center Console Guides for TikTok Shop Partners (TSPs)](65040e15a57708028b5a9cde)
* [TikTok Shop Partner Center Console Guides for Creator Agency Partners (CAPs) and Multi-channel Networks (MCNs)](650a32eec16ffe02b8e4a6b8)
* [TikTok Shop Partner Center Console Guides for Affiliate Partners (TAPs)](66208ee0e696a602e0aac207)
* [Partner Center Console Support](66688ae10664fe02c1da888e)
* [Partner Center Console Terms and Policies](66063c677be39902c7774b24)

detail.title: Agency - Creator Instant Messaging (IM)
detail.content:
**Note:** *Agency-Creator IM is available to* ***Creator Agency Partners (CAP)*** *and/or* ***TikTok Shop Affiliate Partners (TAP)*** *- manage and work directly with creators.* # Overview Connect directly with creators through TikTok Shop's Agency-Creator IM system. Send instant messages within the platform - no external messaging needed. Track creator engagement seamlessly. * **Build Direct Relationships** - Send invites, negotiate, and collaborate in one place for faster results * **Streamline Your Outreach** - Share products with verified creators and track real-time engagement * **Grow Your Network** - Efficiently manage multiple markets and creators in one professional space # Messaging Features & Guidelines ## Message Limits Send up to 5 messages per creator monthly before receiving a response. Enjoy unlimited messaging with linked creators and active collaborations. ## Who Gets Access The feature is available for both CAP and TAP Agencies. The IM function entry point will be displayed on the TTSPC navigation bar when you log in select CAP, TAP or All Roles.
Sub-accounts do not automatically have access to the IM feature. To grant access, go to **My Account** > **Team Members** > **Add New Role**, and check "**Instant Messaging with Creators"** for sub-accounts. ## Start a Conversation Access instant messaging through five convenient entry points in TikTok Shop Partner Center: 1. TTSPC navigation bar 2. Find Creators page 3. Manage Partnerships 4. Partner Campaigns details 5. Partner Campaigns product sharing ### EntryPoint 1: TTSPC navigation bar
### Entry Point 2: Find Creators
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/344af497a6d14ca7a9f5764cc1dd6dfb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Entry Point 3: Manage Partnerships
### Entry Point 4: Partner Campaigns Collaboration Details ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/002f2faa5ba341c2816c79abe74913de~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Entry Point 5: Partner Campaigns via share products with creators ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/66ff622f19d44df09be7510950dc3fb3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Message Options & Tracking Send text, GIFs, photos, and product lists. Track when creators add products to their showcase. Send and monitor linking invites with acceptance status.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/20aef93215284e08af0b3cf7abf214cc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Agencies can see whether the creator had accepted or rejected the linking invitation ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/27c4bfb167464616a14ddaeb75091a6e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) All product lists are available for sending via instant messaging, with the newest lists displayed at the top, and agencies can view the status once a creator adds a product to their showcase via IM. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8b21d7a17a2c44729f829ce2bbd16ffb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: Agency Access to Live Manager
detail.content:
# Introduction: What is Agency Access to Live Manager? To streamline the agency's live operation process, Agency Access to Live Manager allows TikTok shop agencies to access the PC Live Manager ([https://shop.tiktok.com/streamer)](https://shop.tiktok.com/streamer)) on behalf of linked creators. Please note: This feature is currently in beta and available only to allowlisted partners. # What are the benefits？ 1. **Streamlined Operations:** Simplifies the live operation process for agencies by providing a one-click way to log in to the PC Live Manager. 2. **Agency Empowerment:** Allows TikTok shop agencies to manage live streaming activities on behalf of linked creators, enhancing control and coordination. 3. **Centralized Management:** Offers a centralized page for CAP to manage all live streaming activities, improving efficiency and effectiveness in live session handling. # What's the Workflow？ ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c8a49e490c764a449084660b3da3a99b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/813db69b00e4410380ad9a4492896c7e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Steps Step 1: Get Live manager authorization from Creator If CAP is going to add a new creator, CAP can click add "new creator" and choose **"request access to creator live manager tool"** to initiate the authorization request.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1cd78ce1d7024c2da19fd2fcbe36b65a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7281ecacc4c843e4881fe46f9b314459~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
If CAP needs to add a creator live manager tool authorization request for the **linked creator**, CAP can navigate to Creator Management ➤ Manage Partnership ➤ Request LIVE access
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fa526b0ba41245a0b6ba3cd05841614f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/323ea10c40154477bb4cd955365e4286~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
> **Note：** > 1. The request will expire 7 days from when it is sent. Please guide your creator to check after you send the invitation > 2. CAP would lose access to the creator's LIVE Manager immediately after unlinking > 3. CAP can't request a LIVE Manager request if there is an existing pending Extend request ## Step 2: Creators check and respond application After the CAP request, the Creator will be able to receive an application via the **EC center -> System notification -> Cooperation management.** Creators can either accept or decline:
1. **If Declined:** If there's already a linking relationship with the agency, declining will only reject the Live Manager request and will not affect the existing linking relationship. If the request includes both linking and Live Manager access, declining will result in the deletion of the entire linking relationship. 2. **If accepted:** Live Manager access is granted for the duration of the CAP linking period.
## Step 3: CAP enters the live manager and assists the live operation After gaining authorization from the creator, CAP can access all pre-LIVE and after-LIVE features on PC Streamer by clicking **Enter Live Manager.**
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6a936fb0d2c34596981be88612f2986a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/99c9d08e06434024be03a8a642ba1755~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
After accessing the Live Manager, CAPs can set up live events for the creator, and the creator will receive related notifications
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0053fd219f364930b0e2fb828ca245dd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
After the creator starts a live show, CAP can join livestreams to assist creators with operations. Please note: Only the creator can start or end a live concert ### ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4696317ceabf4cef9a3f06f5bdb5c49c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
What actions could CAP conduct after entering **Live Manager？** | **Pre & After live** | **During LIVE（only after a creator goes on LIVE）** | | --- | --- | | 1. LIVE Events (scheduling and entering)
2. LIVE Product Sets
3. LIVE Giveaway: Set up giveaways, flash sales
4. Livestream Campaigns
5. Showcase
6. Data Compass
7. Account Health | 1. Shopping bag actions
1. Pin items
2. Delete items
3. Shift item positions
4. Filter by category and stock
5. Add products
2. Promotions
1. Set up and deploy giveaways
2. Set up and deploy flash sales
3. Billoboard
1. Deploy billboard
4. View activity feed and all the different fields, such as orders, subscriptions, etc.
5. View in-console violations
6. Settings
1. Manage LIVE comment settings such as
1. Allow comments
2. Show the most sent comment
3. Filter spam comments
4. Mute duration
5. Set block duration
2. Mute accounts
3. Block accounts
7. Open the LIVE dashboard to view even more advanced

| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/65f5f3de98b240c3abfa0a1429ffefa4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Notes 1. Any event created by an agency will be communicated to creators through EC Center notification -> partnership and Creator inbox -> System notification -> Account update 2. CAPs cannot **initiate or end a go-live on the LIVE Manager**. They can only join livestreams that creators have already started, providing support and management during the live session. 3. For Cross-border CAPs, this feature is only available to creators who have a commission-sharing or data-sharing relationship with CAP. # FAQs ### 1. Can a creator cancel LIVE Manager authorization while still being linked? Yes, if the Creator only wants to cancel Live Manager authorization without affecting the existing linking relationship, the solution would be that CAP and Creator can unlink first, and then CAP can send linking requests **without requesting LIVE Manager access** (by deselecting the LIVE Manager checkbox when sending the link request). ### 2.Does an agency's activity on LIVE Manager notify creators? Yes, creators will receive notifications when an agency schedules a new LIVE event or enters the LIVE room as staff.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1f1287f327844115a891aa4287b489d4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/269f029202934d61bcbfaa416b99d05d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8c1c95acb1ae446a9396f7b32ca1c9af~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
### 3. Are agency activities that happen behind the scenes displayed as creator activities? Yes, the LIVE room audience cannot distinguish between agency and creator activities, since agencies perform all actions through LIVE Manager under the creator's account. If you notice any suspicious activities by agencies that may harm your interests, please contact your CAP or customer support for investigation. ### 4.Why can't I request a live manager access？ Please check if there are any pending Link extension requests. LIVE Manager access cannot be requested while a link extension request is pending, and vice versa

detail.title: CAP Agency LIVE Commission (US)
detail.content:
# Overview This introduction provides an overview of new product features enabling CAP Agencies to establish exclusive LIVE commission-sharing agreements. The new fee agreement for LIVE empowers CAP Agencies to collaborate with their bound Creators, driving LIVE business growth while ensuring a dedicated revenue stream for providing LIVE-focused services. # How to set up LIVE commission sharing? ### Set up LIVE commission with new Creators #### Step I: CAP Agencies set up a fee agreement * Login to TikTok Shop Partner Center as a CAP Agency, navigate to "Creator Management" - "Manage partnerships", and click the "+Add new creator" button on the top right corner. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f86433b541dd43e78c5704ada43c7418~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * Fill in Creator user name and select a **Link expiration date** (the date cannot be modified, but you can extend the link before it expires). * Enter the **Fee agreement** **rate** (between 0-100%). This is the management fee percentage that you are taking from the creator's commission for providing CAP Agency services across all content types, including short video, showcase and LIVE. * Check "**Set an exclusive fee agreement for LIVE only**", enter the commission share percentage (between 0-100%), and enter the proposed commission share rate for the exclusive LIVE fee agreement. * Note: the exclusive fee agreement for LIVE is taken as the management fee applied solely to LIVE GMV, and it overrides the standard Fee Agreement rate specified above when calculating the LIVE commission share. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/94b1d1743acd40f397653f70ef142cd5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * Check the services terms and click the "**Add**" button to send the Fee Agreement to the Creator. * The fee agreement will start once the creator accepts the request and the percentage can be changed later by submitting an adjustment request, which requires confirmation from you and the creator. #### Step II: Creators review and accept a fee agreement * Creators will receive a notification for the new link request, and they can Agree or Decline the request after reviewing the fee agreement details. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ad723fdc53864f7abb8cbca5c4c2a6fe~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### Step III: CAP Agencies review fee agreements * Navigate to "Creator Management" - "Manage partnerships", and find the **Free agreements** based on different content types, including Short video, Showcase, and LIVE. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ea5f8d28072a41fb9f4d6c45ea4ec602~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * Click on "View History" to review the Free agreement updates based on different content types. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/30b5d1138e1f4788be14fbefa5a84591~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### Step IV: CAP Agencies review commission sharing for product orders * Navigate to "Finance" - "Earnings", and review the "Agency commission sharing portion" based on Content type.
### Set up LIVE Commission with existing Creators #### Step I: CAP Agencies set up a fee agreement for LIVE only * Navigate to "Creator Management" - "Manage partnerships", under the "Linked" tab, click "Adjust fee agreement" to update the existing fee agreements by adding a fee agreement for LIVE only.
#### Step II: Creators review and accept a fee agreement change * Creators will receive a notification for the new revenue sharing agreement, and they can Agree or Decline the proposed fee agreement changes after reviewing the details of the current and updated agreements. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2b20d1dccfb442f89482c9070bec29c2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Commission sharing for Agencies serving as both CAP and TAP When an Agency serves as both CAP and TAP for its bound creators, the Agency can distribute a TAP product to its CAP-bound Creators for showcases. In this case, product orders will appear in both the CAP and TAP order lists for the Agency, and the Agency will receive (1) TAP commission share set by the Sellers, and (2) CAP commission share agreed upon with the bound Creator. | **CAP order list** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b78f7a02129e4a8fb9c893be856b0cf7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | --- | --- | | **TAP order list** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e2d92ed748ba40149846b8f0c51fa5ee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| # FAQ 1. **In which regions is the exclusive fee agreement for LIVE feature available?** * Currently, the feature is only available in the US. 2. **Can Agencies set up different commission share rates for the standard CAP fee agreement and the exclusive fee agreement for LIVE?** * Yes, CAP Agencies can configure separate commission share rates for standard CAP fee agreement and the exclusive fee agreement for LIVE, and the exclusive fee agreement for LIVE will override the standard fee agreement rate when calculating the LIVE commission share. * For example, the commission share calculation for four different fee agreement scenarios is illustrated in the table below.
| **Scenarios** | **Fee Agreement** | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | | **Short Video** | **Showcase** | **LIVE** | | # 1 | 5% | 5% | 5% | | # 2 | 5% | 5% | 50% | | # 3 | 0% | 0% | 50% | | # 4 | 50% | 50% | 0% | 3. **How is the commission share between CAP and Creator calculated when a Creator uses a TAP product link shared by the same Agency?** * When an Agency serves as both CAP and TAP for a bound Creator, and the Creator uses a TAP product link shared by the Agency, the Agency receives both the TAP commission set by the Seller and the CAP commission agreed upon with the bound Creator, as per the valid CAP fee agreements.

**This feature is only available for** [MCN/CAP](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/YVSSdFlS4olNfdxSPjecs8kYnOg) **partners on TTSPC**. detail.title: Creator Management - Find Creators (US)
detail.content:
## **What is Find Creators？** Find creators helps CAPs discover and partner with TikTok’s Creator community. ## **How It Works？** * Find creators is a set of features that enable CAPs to connect and collaborate with Creators. * CAPs can view the contact information of the creator or send an invitation with one click. * CAPs can search for creators by using filters such as Creators, Followers, and Performance. ## **What type of creator can be found on Find Creators？** Creators who have e-commerce permissions and are not official or marketing accounts. ## **How to use Find creators？** ### **Step 1 - Navigate to Find creators** Log in to your TikTok Shop Partner Center account and click "**Creator Management**" followed by "**Find creators**". ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/26086883d77848c7bacc21d03f675381~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### **Step 2 - Apply filters to find the right creators** You can use the following filters as you need： * **Creators** * Product category * Avg. commission rate * Content type * Creator agency * Category pro * Fast growing * LIVE creator ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3ee56c56c7b544a8b60f569208c197ae~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * **Followers** * Follower age * Follower count * Follower gender ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2e52c57ba0114524a40d52bb9190ee4d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * **Performance** * GMV * Items sold * Avg. views per video * Avg. views per LIVE * Engagement rate * Brand collaborations ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3a11b8b6951644888810734843b77923~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Note**: 1. When the mouse clicks on the "?" icon, the definition of the filter will be displayed ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3732603592b84351a8c71c90d0b7bb02~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. If there is no creator information under the filter, it may be because the creator has not authorized that data to be shared. ### **Step 3 - Check the creator's detailed information** Once you find a creator you are interested in, you can click on their profile to see more detailed information about the creator along with their contact information. 1. You can check creator basic information including： 1. Profile photo; account name; nickname, profile information of profile homepage 2. Click the TikTok icon to jump to the creator TT details page 3. Click the QR code icon to see a QR code icon which you can scan to view the creator homepage
Note: some creator's data may not show since they have not authorized it to be shared
### **Step 4 - Invite the creator** After finding a creator you would like to work with, click the invite button.
You will need to select the invitation purpose, provide a message to the creator (no more than 500 words), and your contact information (at least one type contact) in order to send an invitation. **Invitation purpose**: For CAPs, please choose "Establishing a long-term partnership with the creator". For affiliate partners, please choose "Inviting the creator for product distribution". **Message to creator**: We recommend sharing a brief overview of your agency along with the advantages of working with you. **Contact information**: We recommend providing your WhatsApp, email address, and phone number to provide creators with multiple options to reach out to you.
## **FAQ** **Q1: Why is the contact information of some creators unavailable?** A creator is able to turn off displaying information causing their contact information to not be displayed on Find Creators. **Q2: Is there a limit to how many invites I can send out?** A CAP can only send out 100 invites a day to creators.

detail.title: Creator Management - Find Creators
detail.content:
**This feature is only available for** [MCN/CAP](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/YVSSdFlS4olNfdxSPjecs8kYnOg) **partners on TTSPC**. Available Market: UK,ID,MY,VN,TH,PH,SG ## What is Affiliate Marketplace？ The Creator Marketplace helps MCN/CAP discover and partner with TikTok’s Creator community. ## How It Works？ * The Creator Marketplace is a set of features that enable MCN/CAP to connect and collaborate with Creators. * MCN/CAP can view the contact information of the creator or send an invitation with one click. * Businesses search for partners by using filters such as *Category, Creator attributes, and Followers*. ## What type of creator can be found on Affiliate Marketplace？ ✅ creators who have e-commerce permissions ❌ creators who are not linked with other MCNs ❌ creators who are not official or marketing accounts ## How to use Affiliate Marketplace？ ### Step 1 Check and find potential creators You can go to [creator management] ➤[find creator] ➤[Affiliate Marketplace] and check the creator card on the marketplace You can use the following filters as you need： 1. **Category:** The first-level category to which the creator belongs 2. **Creator attributes** 1. **Creator score(only in ID market):** The creator score is calculated based on creator's GMV (sales), livestream count, average livestream viewers and viewing duration, video count, average video views and completed video view rate in the last 30 days 2. **Creator type:** The creator's better performing content type. Eg. The content type with higher GMV (sales)in the last 30 days 3. **Followers profile:** followers number/ followers age/ followers gender 4. Others 1. **Quick to respond:** Quick to respond means that creators are quicker to check and respond to messages. 2. **Posts frequently:** Frequent Posts mean that the creator has published a greater number of short videos or livestreams. 3. **Reliable with samples:** Reliable with samples means that the creator's fulfillment rate to showcase sellers' samples is well above average. Note：If there is no creator information under the filter, it may be because creator has not authorized the data. *If you are a cross-border partner, you can switch markets and check creators under different markets. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f500e140bb044e0b8c267840a91970ee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) If you also have affiliate partner role, you can click "Managed By Agency" to filter creator linked with MCN. After clicking creator cards, you can go to creator details page to check the MCN to which this creator linked with. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9a18c7bb32ba4823b4822f576467fc4f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Step 2 Check the creator's detailed information 1. You can check creator basic information including： 1. Profile photo; account name; nickname, profile information of profile homepage 2. Label icon (display status will be closed if the creator is not authorized), e-commerce rating, number of followers, product volume, main industry label (0-3) 3. You can click the TikTok icon to jump to the creator TT details page 4. Click the QR code icon you can scan to view the creator homepage 2. You can check the data of creators, including video/livestream GPM data （GMV generated by 1,000 shopping cart exposures in videos/livestream), published videos, videos views, like etc. Note: data will be closed if the creator is not authorized
### Step 3 Contact and Invite creator **(1)Check the contact info** Click contact on the creator card or the creator details page, you can get the contact information (including WhatsApp and Email) and get a connection with creator. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c18e9b0d820c4ef7bd4d1fc307c662f3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **(2) Invite Creator** After clicking the invite button, you can send an invitation to the creator with one click. * You can choose invitation purpose if you are both MCN（creator management）and affiliate partner（Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up) * For MCN: please choose "establish long-term linking relationship with creators" * For affiliate partner： please choose "improve the efficiency of product distribution" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3babe0db6d634be2baf6b0304efddfd2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f98cb069a65942c994f64bd124440c6f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) You need fill in the invitation message (no more than 500 words) and contact information (at least one type contact), click Send Invitation。 1. Invitation message: Filling in the Invitation Message to show the advantages of your company will help attract creators. 2.Information check: The basic information of your company will be synchronized to the creator 's side . In order to ensure the experience from the creator 's side, we suggest you check the information before inviting creators. > *How to check the information: > You can go to my account→ profile → My category&market→view details ,you can also click [check information] on the invite creator page to jump directly to the company information for checking > If there is inaccurate information, you can contact your account manager to deliver the modification requirement 3. Contact information: You can choose different contact information on the invitation page as below： * ID：WhatsAPP+Email+Phone（optional） * VN：Zalo+Email+Phone（optional） * PH：Viber+Email+Phone（optional） * MY：WhatsAPP+Email+Phone（optional） * TH：Line+Email+Phone（optional） ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c51791237ba640a5979d0f2e789958e9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 4. Invitation limitation: * You are allowed to send invitations to a maximum of 100 creators per day, and the same creator can only be sent once within 7 days. *if you have both an Affiliate Partner and MCN ： 1. **Invitation limitation:** the total maximum invitation per day is 100, and the same creator can only be sent once within 7 days by both categories. 2. You can choose invitation intention when sending invitation to creators * For MCN: please choose "establish long-term linking relationship with creators" * For affiliate partner： please choose "improve the efficiency of product distribution" ### Step 4 creator receives invitation After you send the invitation, the creator will check this invitation in the **[TikTok Shop Inbox]—[notification]**, which mainly includes the following information: > 1. The invitation message filled in by you > 2. The TOP 3 creators of your company ranking by the followers > 3. Company Information: creator you partner with（the history linked creators accounts）,company name, service, category, introduction, address. Creators who are interested in the MCN can click **"I'm interested"** button to get the contact information. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/13c3feeb7abd44bcacb2ed3646d96d91~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/131f058b92c3456da3dd2d0901bf6326~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2ddd9a6e4d234b128c34bbe416c1d849~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Step 5 Check Invitation history You can go to [creator management] ➤[find creator] ➤[Invitation history] and we support the following functions: 1. Search for creator: Search by username/nickname 2. Filter function: Set the start and end time to filter the invitations within the time period 3. View invitation: View the latest invitation information (including invitation information and contact information) through viewing details 4. Resend invitation: support send an invitation to the creator again within one click ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/864fe54fe0e54f78843da31873ab23d2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7bb885fb916148b8be8c6e25d32721a3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Note： You can switch the invitation intention if you have both MCN（creator management）and affiliate partner（Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up）role * Creator partnership ：MCN role * Product distribution：affiliate partner role ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e0ee0572acd34c7eb2284175b543320b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) You can switch markets if you are a cross-border partner, after switching the market ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3b9c8c954d0642e19f90769a94f0b993~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## FAQ ## Q1：Why is the contact information of some creators unable to check? Only the invite option available? Answer: After some creators turn off the switch to displaying information to MCN, their contact information will not be displayed on Affiliate Marketplace.

**This feature is only available for** [MCN/CAP](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/YVSSdFlS4olNfdxSPjecs8kYnOg) **partners on TTSPC**. ## What is linked Creator? detail.title: Creator Management - Linking with Creators for Data Authorization & Commission Sharing (US ONLY)
detail.content:
# Overview We are making collecting management fees from creators a more seamless experience by including commission sharing as part of our onboarding process in the TikTok Shop Partner Center. You can now link accounts, authorize data sharing, and set up commission sharing in a single request. It's now even easier to start working with your creators and earn revenue sooner. When setting up a creator relationship, you'll establish the fee agreement rate you're taking from the creator's TikTok Shop commission as a management fee, also known as commission sharing. The fee agreement starts once the creator accepts the linking request. You can change the fee rate anytime by submitting an adjustment request requiring creator confirmation. ## Changelog **3/20** * New Filter to allow agencies to see Creator Links expiring in 1, 15, and 30 days. * Agencies can now request to extend one additional time if a creator hasn't responded to the first 7-day extension window * Agencies can now add up to 100 new creators per day in TTSPC (previously 30). # Onboarding Step 1: In order to set up commission sharing, you will first need to provide your tax and payment information. If you are a new agency, you will see the page shown below. In the Creator Manager section, click on the **Manage Partnerships** tab, then click on **Go to Finance**.
Step 2: If you are an existing agency that has linked with Creators in the past, you will see the following page below with Request fee agreement greyed out. In this case, navigate to the Tax information page as shown and press **Complete now** to follow the required steps.
Step 3: After providing tax information, you will need to provide payment information. In the Manage Partnerships page, click on **Go activate**.
Step 4: In the Payment Account page, press **Activate account** and follow the required steps.
# Linking with Creators for Data Authorization & Commission Sharing Step 1: In the Creator Manager section, click on the Manage Partnerships tab, then click on **Add New Creators**.
Step 2: Add the Creator’s **User Name** and select a **Link Expiration Date**, which can’t be changed. The first time you link with a Creator, the maximum linking duration is two months, and if you link with them again, it can be one year. By linking with a Creator, you will gain access to their data in Data Compass. Next, enter the **Fee Agreement** rate (between 1-100%). This is the management fee percent that you are taking from the creator's commission. The fee agreement will start once the creator accepts the request and the percentage can be changed later by submitting an adjustment request, which requires confirmation from you and the creator. Click the **checkbox** and press **Add**.
Step 3: Once you have added the link request, it will appear on the Manage Partnerships page, under the **Link requested** tab, showing the Creator's handle and a Link requested status. Link requests expire after 7 days. The fee agreement will also show as pending, and you can click on **View history** to view the commission sharing percentage history.
Step 4: Once the Creator has accepted the link request, the status will update to **Linked** and the Creator will be shown in the **Linked** tab. Here, you will also see the **Fee agreement** will be updated to the agreed upon percentage.
Step 5: If the Creator declines the linking request, then the status will update to **Not linked - link declined** and the Creator will be shown in the **Not linked** tab. The Fee agreement will also be shown as **Declined**. You can try to link again by clicking on **Request again**.
Step 6: If the Creator does not respond to the link request, it will expire after 7 days. You can try to link again by clicking on **Request again**.
Note: Agencies can only send 100 Link Requests to Creators each day. ## Linking with Agency (Creator Experience) Step 1: In the **Partnerships** page or **Notifications** page, Creators will see a notification for a new link request to click on and view the details. Here, the Creator must accept that they understand they’ll be sharing their data and that they will be sharing revenue with the agency **** by clicking the checkboxes and pressing **Accept**. Once accepted, the Creator will see the linking and revenue sharing details and can also choose to unlink from the agency. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/23311732bd3244d19533f2aaf864503c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/413cd8503ba148a08290161ca7a3733e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b5243920e89143c6aec99c19f79d767a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/52f755ae818a41d780c2fe400d37d52e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/045615df396447fea844dab764e7cd37~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Note: We recommend that creators set up offline contracts with agencies that specify the percentage of TTS commission that will go towards the agency, and we recommend that the duration of these offline contracts aligns with the duration that is specified on the linking invitation. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/22a59cdf962d4e96b24622316186170b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/da206daacec04a50ab2d523922e48468~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 2: The Creator can also choose to **Decline** the linking request in the previous step.
# Extending Agency-Creator Links Step 1: Agencies will see a countdown starting 30 days before the Agency-Creator link expires. To see a list of which Agency-Creator links are about to expire in next 30/15/1 day, select the **Expiring** filter (see Example 1). At this time, the agency can click on **Extend** and set a new expiration date for the link request, which can’t last for more than one year. Once a new expiration date has been set, press the checkbox and then press **Submit**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4a23a8e7ed934b65b972e41ae831b6d0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/41ce30e3c1bf4e35a6b4d98f4b2f103a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Example 1 Step 2: If the Creator declines the extension request, the Agency won’t be able to request an extension again. If the Creator doesn’t respond to the extension request within 7 days, an Agency can send one more extension request to the Creator before the Link expires.
## Accepting Extension Requests (Creator Experience) Step 1: Once the Agency has submitted an extension request, the Creator will receive a notification in the Partnerships page or Notification page. The Creator must confirm that they understand they’ll be sharing their data and then click on **Accept**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/806afb50dc2b4fc18611185ad25b32f9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eb794da22f62460180530f58a16704df~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b360591545fc46f0b86932c0c20ddd79~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d904fbda20f84a1ab1af2987b33b5ae5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 2: If the Creator **Declines** the extension request or the original link expires during this time, then the Creator will see that the request has been declined or expired. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/591aa9d5a2b44c8cbcc5302a95ec98d1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/50f60ffd349449eb8ef4d32be1577065~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Adjusting the Commission Rate Step 1: Click on **Adjust fee agreement**. Then set a New Fee Agreement, click the checkbox, and press **Submit**. Note that the new fee agreement cannot be the same as the current one. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/aac21686145941a7b0318bf84141ac9e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a00024a102cb4dfe8abb67181f9c400e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 2: By hovering over Adjust fee agreement or pressing on View history, you are be able to see the most recent fee agreement rate that you have submitted. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d3fbc057b4eb47b299a1ad85bc144b81~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e6f575cf6a374bb69ac269bba6aa9244~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 3: If the creator accepts the new fee agreement, you will see the new fee agreement rate on the **Linked** page, or you can click on **View history** to see it there as well. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2df67f85ae3b41e0a94d8325c3919906~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/98c6f1d438a64cac960fea21faed367b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 4: If the creator declines the new fee agreement or does not respond to it within 7 days, then you will see that the new fee agreement has been Declined or has Expired in **View** **history**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/23ad34b26e104fd09936ee36cfaad16a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1e08de7cafd34902aa6420dff835132d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Accepting Commission Rate Adjustment (Creator Experience) Step 1: Once the Agency has submitted a new fee agreement request, the Creator will receive a notification in the Partnerships page or Notification page. The Creator must confirm that they understand they’ll be sharing their data and then click on **Accept**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6368864538b14c8d8f081643efef6404~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/13c0e05e0ed24c499ca182f46416573d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a4ddc0d542f74fc7bc46aa9e89f3180d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7cf6637bbba64f1080e8e21c1bc2d9fd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 2: If the Creator **Declines** the new fee agreement request or doesn’t respond to it within 7 days, or the original link expires during this time, then they will see that the request has been declined or expired. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/47ff16d6589d48e28282f2b5630c51d0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ae41a7e24f864d858eaa2ec149cbc0ff~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Unlinking with Creators Step 1: You can unlink with a Creator by clicking on **Remove.**
Step 2: Once the Creator has unlinked, the status will update to **Not linked - unlinked**. The agency can choose to send another linking request by clicking on **Request again**.
Step 3: If the Creator is the one who initiates the unlinking request, the agency can **Approve** or **Decline** it in the **Unlink requested** tab.
## Unlinking with Agencies (Creator Experience) Step 1: If the Creator would like to initiate an unlinking request, they can go to the Partnerships Page, click on **View details**, then click on **Unlink**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3d560001dcd24124b9a2fa2d87b35693~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bc98d8d019414e84a90090ee8b4ea7ca~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Step 2: If the agency declines the unlinking request, then the Creator will receive a notification that it has been declined and they can resend an unlinking request. If the Creator sends an unlink request a second time and the agency declines it or does not respond within 7 days, then it will be automatically approved. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/836013dca81a4ae3a5a577dbea2a67c0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/deffcc43725b4e02b0b5f42160ef587e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # FAQ 1. **What happens if I'm already linked to a creator?** 1. If you are already linked to a creator, you will need to set up the new fee agreement by pressing **Request fee agreement**. Then set a new fee agreement rate, which is the management fee percent that you are taking from the creator's commission (between 1-100%) and click the checkbox and **Submit**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0657f6d27ddf49da8bc3500aa1116c2b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5463717386a74ec0ba4c7a02514200bc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. If you are already linked to a creator, but the link is about to expire within 30 days, then you must press **Extend**. Then set a new Link Expiration date (up to one year in the future) and fee agreement rate, which is the management fee percent that you are taking from the creator's commission (between 1-100%) and click the checkbox and **Submit**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1a8817d907fb441da0769f7255aef3fd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1613b64972b4f3a886e05d338739f34~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **What should I do if I am only partially linked to a creator?** 1. Navigate to the **Not linked** tab and press Extend. Then choose a **Link Expiration date** that can be up to a year in the future. The Data Sharing Period will auto-update to align with the chosen Link Expiration date. Then, choose a **New Fee Agreement Rate,** which is the management fee percent that you are taking from the creator's commission (between 1-100%) and press **Submit**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/556e5d5783c543c7adc831ff2ce3dd90~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b6884456f860429180a2a511eb841b18~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. The creator will receive an **Extend partnership** **and revenue sharing** request and will need to click the checkboxes and press **Accept** and **Share** for you to be linked with the creator. If the creator does not accept the request, then you will remain partially linked with the creator until the expiration date.
3. **I am not able to change the fee agreement percent. Why?** 1. If you're not able to change the fee agreement percent, it is likely because the creator has not accepted the Terms of Service yet. In this case, you will see the fee agreement percent show as 100% and you will not be able to press submit.
4. **I am not able to add additional Creators. Why?** 1. If you're not able to add additional Creators, it may be because you have already sent 100 invites today. If you are unable to add specific Creators, it may be because they have declined your request recently.

detail.title: How to Link Your TikTok Business Account
detail.content:
In this article, we’ll introduce our latest feature that allows you to connect your TikTok business account in Partner Center to boost your brand, build trust, and streamline creator recruitment. After successfully linking your account, you’ll be able to display official business and partner information—whether you’re a **TikTok Shop Multi-Channel Network (MCN)** or **TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP)**—on your TikTok business account. ## ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/72af4ea1ac054d0fb92222774c48c30a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Why You Should Link Your TikTok Account
## How to Link Your TikTok Business Account in Partner Center 1. Go to [Partner Center > My Account](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/profile) and click **Link TikTok Account**.
2. Follow on-screen guidance. If you don’t have a TikTok account, click **Sign Up for TikTok** to create one. If you have an existing account, click **Get Started** to retrieve your QR code.
3. Open TikTok app, go to your profile, tap the top right button, select **My QR code**, and scan the code in Partner Center and tap **Connect Now** on TikTok app to complete the process.
**❗️Note:** Ensure you link the correct TikTok account. If you wish to unlink or change your TikTok account, please contact your account manager.
## How to Attach Your TikTok Handle to Your Invitation After successfully linking your TikTok business account to Partner Center, you will be able to attach it to your invitations. Creators and sellers will be able to view your TikTok business account through various journeys: ### Manage Partnerships To initiate a binding relationship with creators, go to [Manage Partnerships > Add New Creator](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-creator/binding-creator?market=4&tab=all). On this page, select **Attach TikTok profile** to include your TikTok handle.
### Find Creators If you want to invite creators for product collaboration, go to [Find Creators > Invite](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-cmp/creator?market=4). On this page, select **Attach TikTok profile** to include your TikTok handle.
### Partner Campaign To initiate a partner campaign, go to [Partner Campaigns > Campaigns](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-campaign/campaign) and click **Create Campaign**. Scroll down to the page to the **Social Account** section, select **Attach TikTok profile** to include your TikTok handle.
T ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fe049c4741df42caa84d2a45d261e8fe~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) i ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ce976bba80b34fcab79756f3f9449d34~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) is what your sellers will see on the **Campaign Details** page. They can also click on the TikTok handle to visit your official TikTok account.
## FAQ 1. **Can I link multiple TikTok business accounts to the same Partner Center account?** No, you can only link one TikTok business account to each Partner Center account. If you need to manage multiple TikTok business accounts, you’ll need separate Partner Center accounts for each. 2. **What happens if I accidentally link the wrong TikTok account?** If you link the wrong TikTok account, you’ll need to contact your account manager to unlink it. Once unlinked, you can go through the linking process again with the correct account. 3. **What should I do if I encounter an error while linking my TikTok account?** If you encounter an error when linking your account, ensure your TikTok account meets the following criteria: * The TikTok account holder must be at least 18 years old. * The status of the TikTok account must be active and have no violation history. * The TikTok account cannot be a registered business account. * The TikTok account cannot be linked with another agency or the Creator Network. If all criteria are met and the error persists, contact your account manager for further assistance.

detail.title: Product Management
detail.content:
📌 **This feature is only available for** MCN, CAP, TAP **partners on TTSPC**. Available Market: US,UK,ID,MY,VN,TH,PH,SG # What is Product Management？ Product management includes **Product Marketplace** and **Product Sets** which allow you to: 1. **Find and select products:** you can view/search/filter products according to your needs in the product marketplace 2. **Create your product set and share with creator:** you can create a product set and share with your creator using one link 📌 **Note** Product marketplace will be accessible for all MCN（Category:creator management）and TAP （Category:Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up). # MCN & TAP Feature Guide ## Step 1 - Pick your products The Product Marketplace is where you can search and discover products that you would like to share with your creators. Currently, there are three different ways you can find products: * **Search:** Use the search bar to look for specific products, categories, or brands that match your interest. * **Product rankings:** If you're unsure where to start looking for products, the product rankings section is a great place to get inspiration. This section is only available in certain regions. * **For you:** You can find recommended products based on your preference. The more you use this section, the more customized the results will be. *If you are cross-boarder MCN & TAP and have multiple markets certification, please choose the market first.
**Filter** * Use filters to narrow down the number of products you're looking at. * Filter products by **category, price, high score rating, commission rate, product sales, store rating, and free samples.** * Check the "**Top** **LIVE picks**" filter to identify high quality LIVE products recommended for your creators. | Filter 1 | Filter 2 | | --- | --- | |

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/dc4d36a6bf1e4855a1b9776f2f2bee6c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Product details** Click the product card to know more about this product. **Note: the product details page only displays basic information. If the seller didn't provide any contact info, you can instead use the creator product marketplace to contact seller by IM. > ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8d68400680444c048876e219e95cd86a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 2 - Add products to your product set **How to add a product to your product set？** **Option 1: click "add" on product card** Click add and choose a product set to add to your created product set. **💁♀️ Tips:** 1. You can choose multiple product sets 2. You can also uncheck if you want to remove the products that have already been added to your product set 3. You can create a new product set while adding products. If you need to cancel it, you can go to product set tab | Add One Product to Your Set | Add Multiple Products to Your Set | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0162bf5e02204236b1b8a65e696f210a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1b44348da834022b35d957f8cc127c1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Option 2: copy the product link and add** Copy the product link and paste your link into [product set]-[add products] | Copy Link | Add to Your Set | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eab3cddf013c4a96abce9c51579ef08e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/239221b85090439c8c5e95f8398e603e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Note：** 1. You can add a maximum of 50 product set 2. For each product set, you can only add up to 100 products *(*which is the same creator's side, the shopping bag can only have up to 100 products in the LIVE* *room)* ### How to create a new product set? You can create a product set under the product set tab or you can create a new product set while adding products quickly **Option 1: Create a product set under the product set tab** *If you are cross-boarder MCN&TAP, please choose the target market first | Create product set | Choose target market | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3ed9f89509e24054b1c90c2d92121a8c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a43ce4e7ee19431db3d2ca6736129801~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Option 2: create a product set while adding products** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d7a7809005574c3c99c61562e7a6aea5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### How to manage your product set? 1. You can add/delete top products on the product list page. ⚠️ Please double confirm before deleting the product set. After deleting, the creator will be unable to check the product set (will not affect the product that creator has already added).
## Step 3 - Share product set with your creator Option 1: You can click "share" to add a creator. | Click "Share" | Add a creator | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/58eb8ed7a92c4614aefa3e80f824c52e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/62a77de120134d50aaf3fb93482b20ca~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | Option 2: you can also go to **product set ➤ manage shared creator ➤ share** to add a creator | Manage shared creator | Share to add a creator | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/381e04d5e7a84bccaabc5913dc437938~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d1056bf75507410bb9fd79416cac4f15~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | 📌 **Note:** 1. You can only share product sets with linked creators 2. You can only choose maximum creators **20** to share at one time 3. One product set can be shared with up to **1000** creators **How to cancel sharing with creators?** To cancel sharing, go to “**manage shared creators**” in the product set and delete the creator from the sharing list.
# Creator Feature Guide ## Add products in APP ### Step 1 - Receive the product set After sharing the product set, the creator will receive the product set and a message notification. The creator can go to **TikTok Shop➤Live product set** **➤Shared tab** to check. The product set will be listed in time order, and there will be a partner name under the product set name--**"shared from xxx"** | TikTok Shop | Live Product Set | Shared Tab | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1352d03b73344f099ce26754badb47cf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b2b35b7f86234ab996beb6a79797632e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9fff85d593264e64b95eebe896c01911~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ### Step 2 - Add products By clicking the product set, the creator can choose a single product to add or click "add all to showcase". 📌 **Note:** If the creator has already added the products before, the products will show as "added" The creator can also add product sets to shop live: click "**add all"** or click product set to choose product one by one. | Add all | Add one by one | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ee7898b2f5084490a522b860d601ca2f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/61ccb0e1761949bfa1299997556bf9b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ## Add products on PC ### Step 1 - Receive the product set After sharing the product set, the creator will receive the product set on PC. The creator can go to **Livestream➤Live product set** **➤Shared product sets** to check.
The product set will be ordered by update time. The creator can copy and delete the product sets shared by MCN/CAP Partners, but can not edit the shared sets. After copying, the new copied set will be displayed under the "your product sets" tab. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d103577e83a340d295e5229f962841fa~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Step 2 - Add products By clicking the product set, creator can choose a single or multiple products to add to showcase. 📌 **Note:** If creator has already added products before, products cannot be chosen anymore. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0e907b57e79349f29ec927689ab8cfc2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## **👉 If Product Set becomes invalid** If a partner **unlinks with the creator** or deletes the **product set**, the creator will receive a message and the product set will be inaccessible from creators' side (creator can delete it or after 30 days the product set will be deleted automatically). | Message | The product set is inaccessible. | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cdebc6a93e204f63a9bb9591f18a88f2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e6faecdd65314988ac7ed5f80e06a35b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ## **👉 If Product Set updated** If you update new products in the product set, the creator side product set will be notified and the newly added product will add a "**New**" label. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ea109f5ccef54d55b1beba4ed7798417~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # FAQ ### Q: If I delete the product set that has already been added by creators, will it affect the current short video/live/showcase? A: Deleting product sets won't affect the products already added by creators

detail.title: [US]Creator Lead Management
detail.content:
# Introduction: What is Creator Leads Management？ Creator Leads is a feature designed for CAP to manage and follow up with all creator leads before establishing an official linking relationship with the creator. ++Please note: This feature is still under testing and is only available to CAPs on the allowlist. Please check with your CAP manager if you have any questions.++ # What are the benefits？ ✅ **More Creator Leads:** you can spread the promotion code offline to connect with more creators. ✅ **Centralized Lead Management:** Provide a consolidated page to handle and track all livestream creator leads
# Steps Please ensure you are using the **main account** or **member account with Creator lead management permission** before visiting this page.
### Get more leads through promotion codes You can navigate to [TIkTok Shop Partner Center -> Creator management-Lead management. ](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-creator/lead-management?market=100)By downloading the QR code, you can spread this exclusive QR code to gain more leads offline.
Note: If you are also a Top LIVE agency CAP, you will receive some leads from Top LIVE agencies. Creators can click "Learn More" to apply for collaboration. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/64d392560be8470aa9dd2e9dd6508ab3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/938aea4c492c43a29cba0f234ffe5cd6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/dbcb6cd8f6014e52928393e59a634543~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4eab4bb44f6c4cbea603df30644b31ab~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Check creator performance to consider further collaboration. You can search specific creators by **username,** and **view** the creator profile by clicking the creator's name. * **Creator level:** Multi-select tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire, Diamond) to focus on specific creator levels. Tier data refreshes on the 2nd day of each month. * **Follower count:** Select predefined ranges (0–10K, 10K–100K, 100K–1M, 1M–10M, 10M+) or manually enter values. Data refreshes daily. * **Lead Source:** See if a lead comes from "Collaboration request" (formal submission) or "Instant message" (marked by you). ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/133b3574f66741c49b94e5b94be24dc0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***Note*:** Creator data authorization expires after 7 days for formal collaboration requests, so you should act promptly to follow up. You can check the highest GMV LIVE dashboard in the last 30 days by clicking View Live Dashboard. Note: 1. There will be no data if this creator has no live stream data in the past 30 days 2)The visible data is valid for only 7 days. If it has been 7 days since the creator applied, the information will no longer be accessible. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7e0fe616c0254592b5bd173e1f9ca63c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6e25fa1e9ae54f78b6affbc94eee8aaf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Message Creator and invite to link You can send a message to the creator to get more information, and share invitations to link with this creator if you would like to build an official linking relationship with this creator. Note: The "invite to link" button may not appear if this creator is already linked with you.
### Manage your creator leads with status tags and notes. Status tag: The lead status will be set as a new opportunity as default. You can update the lead's status manually according to your needs. * **Follow up:** All newly created leads. * **In progress:** Leads currently in contact progress. * **Contacted:** Leads that have been successfully contacted. * **Invalid**: Leads that are no longer valid or actionable.
You can also add notes (up to 200 words) for leads to help you manage them more effectively.
### FAQ ### Why can't I access leads management? Lead management is now only available for the cap on the allowlist. Please contact your account manager for more information. ### How can I be displayed on this Top LIVE agencies list？ Please get in touch with your account manager and check if you have met the criteria for Top LIVE agencies CAP ### Why can't I see part of the creator's data or contact info？ There are two possible reasons: 1)The data might not be available for display, or the creator may not have authorized data sharing. 2)The visible data is valid for only 7 days. If it has been 7 days since the creator applied, the information will no longer be accessible.

detail.title: [User guide] CAP Profile displayed to Creators
detail.content:
The agency profile will display key information and data, allowing both existing and potential creators to evaluate and review your collaboration. This will be featured across various sections of the TikTok Shop App for creators. * The profile will appear across multiple entry points, including the linking page, IM, and TAP product list, to enhance the agencies' credibility and increase acceptance of binding agreements. * Main process: 1. TAP/CAP upload the basic info and authorize TikTok Shop sharing operation data in TTSPC(TikTok Shop Partner Center) 2. Creator can browse and send messages to TAP/CAP in EC center(TikTok Shop Creator Center)
## Benefit With this feature, creators can now assess the suitability of an MCN/TAP partner by reviewing details such as the categories and products they promote, as well as key performance metrics like data and commission rates. This will help to: 1. Strengthen trust in MCN/TAP partners, as the data is directly pulled from the platform. 2. Improve matchmaking by empowering creators to evaluate partners using relevant data, while aligning with their specific needs.

detail.title: [CAP Analytics] CAP Data Overview
detail.content:
# Overview For CAP agencies, it is important that they can monitor the performance of their creators and identify top creators and content that is performing well. As a result, we have introduced a new Data Overview page dedicated to presenting the core information needed for operation monitoring, to enhance monitoring and issue finding capabilities for agencies' bound creators, and allow agencies to identify help improve creators posting rate of the products added to showcase. # **Benefits** 1. **Overview of core business metrics as well as trend comparisons** that allows for further analysis of the core data related to revenue, creator and content performance. 2. **Creator performance diagnostics** that denotes key collaborated creators that need attention and those that have potential to grow. 3. **Easy viewing of top content** (ongoing LIVES and videos) and that helps you to identify creator's performance via trend data and creator growth data. # **Why use this data overview feature?** Below we have highlighted use cases for why it's useful for CAP agencies to use this new Data Overview section within the Partner Centre. ## Use Case 1 I want to get an overview and understand trends for my CAP business performance: * Users will be able to readily view core data metrics for their performance over the selected time frame * The list of metrics available at this time will include: 1. Affiliate GMV 2. Est. Commissions 3. Commission base 4. Items sold 5. Affiliate Orders 6. Direct GMV 7. Direct refund GMV 8. Refunded items * Additionally, users can choose to view and compare trends across these core data metrics for the selected time period
## Use Case 2 I want to understand which creators have generated the highest sales and helped to generate the most revenue, and who I should follow up with due to low performance * The Creator Performance section identifies creators who have made sales in the current or previous periods and their performance. * You will see 2 different headings under this section: 1. **Attention -** This includes the following: 1. Creators whose revenue has dropped significantly compared to the previous period 2. **Potential**: These are creators who have contributed positively to your agency's overall revenue.
## Use Case 3 I want to easily access and identify top performing content across LIVES and videos for my creators. * In order to enable users to understand which creators are producing content that is generating sales, they can go to the Content Performance section. * Here, agencies can see the top 20 content pieces that have been produced by the creators that have a binding relationship with. This includes data for Ongoing LIVEs as well as Videos that have been produced. * For each of these top ranking lists, users will be able to select and rank the Ongoing Lives and Video data by: GMV, Order and Views. * Agencies can also turn the option on for 'real-time' data which is especially useful, if you're trying to see data for LIVEs as they are taking place.
# Entrance CAPs can navigate to the functionality within TTSPC by navigating to [Analytics > Data Overview](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/compass/data-overview) **** They can then select the particular country (if they are registered as CAP in multiple countries) to view that country's particular affiliate CAP specific data.
# Feature walkthrough ## Date filter 1. You can easily select the date range for the data on the top left side. This date range will apply to all succeeding metrics displayed 2. By default the last 7 days will be selected.
## Core Data 1. The core data section will display the following aggregated metrics: 1. **Affiliate GMV:** The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed from this affiliate within 14 days of clicking product links in their content. 2. **Est. Commissions:** The amount of commission we estimate creator can earn on all paid or unpaid cash-on-delivery (COD) orders, non-COD orders, and refunded orders. 3. **Commission base:** The amount of order refunds generated from this creator the selected period. 4. **Items sold:** The number of products sold through this affiliate during the selected period, including items in refunded orders. 5. **Affiliate Orders:** The total amount of paid orders generated from Affiliates 6. **Direct GMV:** Direct GMV is the total amount paid for orders including returns and refunds. This excludes any form of attributed GMV 7. **Direct refund GMV:** The cumulative amount refunded to buyers during the selected period based on Direct GMV achieved. This means that the Refund GMV only calculates GMV from refunded orders based on buyer's last clicked content type and excludes any form of refunded orders from attributed GMV. 8. **Refunded items:** Number of items with refund from affiliate orders during selected time period
2. Below each metric you can find the % deviation (increase or decrease) of the metric over the selected date range: 1. Green color reflecting positive changes (increase in % vs previous period) 2. Red color reflecting negative changes (decrease in % vs previous period) 3. You will find the toggle to compare **Trends** and when switched on, this will allow you to compare up to 2 core metrics with each other. The trends of these two selected metrics will be displayed over the selected date range in a graph.
## Creator Performance The aim of this section is to provide more action-oriented insights so that agencies can identify actions for their bound creators.
1. **Attention (this lists 3 different metrics)**: 1. Creators whose revenue has dropped significantly compared to the previous period 2. Creators who have not added products into their showcase 3. Creators who have not yet posted content **Note:** Only creators who are bound and have authorised data sharing access with their agency will be displayed here. 2. **Potential**: 1. These are creators who have contributed positively to their agency's overall revenue. 3. Next to both **Attention** and **Potential** sections, you will find **[View list]** and **[Export list]** options: 1. **View list:** When you click on this, you will see a diagnostic category for each individual creator that has been identified. These category tags are intended to help CAPs easily identify why a particular Creator has been flagged in this section 2. **Export list:** This allows you to download the list for offline analysis via Excel.
### Core Metrics * **Creators with sales:** The number of creators that generated in revenue during the selected period * **Creators posting contents:** The number of creators posting videos or having livestreams during the selected period * **Creators with adding products:** The number of creators adding products into the showcase during the selected period * **Authorized Creators:** The number of creators that agreed authorization during the selected period * **% of creators with sales:** This is calculated as **** *Creators with sales / Authroized Creators * 100%* * **% of creator posting content:** This is calculated as *Creators posting contents / Authroized Creators * 100%* * **% of creator adding products:** This is calculated as **** *Creators with adding products / Authroized Creators * 100%* Similarly to the **Core Data** section above, you will find the toggle to compare **Trends** and when switched on, this will allow you to compare up to 2 core metrics with each other. The trends of these two selected metrics will be displayed over the selected date range in a graph.
### GMV segment movement 1. This section highlights the different GMV ranges that creators fall into 2. Agencies can use this to track fluctuations, allowing them to understand which creators have had a decrease in their GMV.
### Creator ranking This displays up to the top 20 creators that have been ranked by **GMV** or by **Order** that have generated. * In addition to the Creator, further information will be available regarding: * Creator name * Contribute %: this is the amount of GMV the creator has generated for the agency * GMV: this is the GMV generated by the Creator * % deviation in GMV generated (compared to previous period) * You can also select **[View All]** and this re-directs to the Custom Report page where you can find information for all the creators you have a binding relationship with. * You can also click on the creator name which will direct you to the Creator Analytics page.
## Content performance This section displays information about the performance of LIVEs and Videos produced by creators that agencies have a binding relationship with. ### Key Metrics 1. LIVE Affiliate GMV 2. LIVE Affiliate orders 3. LIVEs 4. LIVE products sold, [affiliate attribution] 5. LIVE CTR 6. LIVE CTOR 7. Video Affiliate GMV 8. Video Affiliate orders 9. Videos 10. Video products sold, [affiliate attribution] 11. Video CTR 12. Video CTOR ### Top contents This displays the top 20 content pieces that have been produced by your bound creators. This includes data for **Ongoing LIVEs** as well as **Videos** that have been produced. You will notice a toggle button called **Real time**. When switched on, the top 20 ongoing LIVEs will automatically be displayed by GMV. When switched off, you will be able to view historical LIVES as well. 1. **Top 20 Ongoing LIVES:** 1. You can choose to display the top 20 Ongoing LIVES list by one of the following: GMV, Orders or Views.
2. If you select a creator in this section, you will be redirected to the **[LIVE Console]** where you can monitor the data for the LIVE as it's taking place. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/502ef458be3b44349e0c83e6f525a7ab~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/01368b10a04d4ccaa553bb35d7e1bd03~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Top 20 Videos** 1. For this section, you will be be able to see the video under the **[Video info]** heading. If you click on the video, a new screen will pop up where you can view the video that is live on that creator's page 2. The creators name will be displayed beneath each video
3. You can also click on the the video name which will redirect you to the [**Video details]** page where you can find further information about the video. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/597621de8e30406fa6da51f51370b73a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3a5c7c17302246eb878c052ea4bd329c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
