detail.title: [CAP US]TTSPC Data Compass Playbook
detail.content:
> If you have a TSP Role, the Data Authorization process can refer to this Doc: [【TSP】TTSPC Data Compass Playbook](658280c3f48fbe02df73ee0a) # 🔥🔥What ability can be provided by data compass? ## Product Feature ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/759b88ecc71b4692801513ae45f5ba42~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Application Scenarios ### Scenario 1: Live Operation - Analyze real-time live & recap performance, Monitor multiple livestreams at the same time.
Real-time monitoring of live transactions
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b5339c3011614444a19b9f52eb833255~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0eb77be81125410bbe356033c565f193~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. Monitor user's entry/live trends, capture traffic peaks and seize high conversion opportunities. 2. Analyze the conversion of different products to find potential products with low impression and high conversion.
Monitor multiple livestream
1. Monitor all creators' performances who are doing livestreams at the same time, find highlights and lowlights in the live room more quickly.
Recap creator historical live performance
1. Check each creator's past live performance to monitor their diligence and sales performance in a period. ### Scenario 2: Video Operation - Find good performance videos and Replicate Success Cases.
Monitor video performance
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f7c00013888e4f0c8d27248f14c66e4a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0a1d176c5c1641a9b6d9ff00533daee5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. Monitor the number of videos posted by each creator and overall video sales performance. 2. Analyze each video's product sales and find the best performance video recently to give more promotion budgets.
Learn from excellent video
1. Analyze the sales performance of different products within one video and find suitable product for this video content. 2. Learn from excellent examples of selling the same product, optimize your own video content to make the content more attractive. 3. Analyze each video's finish rate and traffic trends, summarize high finish rate/traffic videos' production experience. ### Scenario 3: Product Strategy - Monitor different creators' product sales Performance
Monitor product sales performance
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/beb67783fe944c2e9463a8ee032b2fb6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/943d6a6580a34a69a8c85b4929da9025~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. View each creator's sale performance, understand the best performance products, and match the creator with suitable products. 2. Filter by shop to check how much GMV has been achieved by this partner's creator or each creator, easier to calculate the goal achievement of each shop.
Analyze each product's performance
1. Analyze each creator's contribution to product revenue and find which content created most revenue, learn from the good examples and adjust creator's product strategy. 2. Analyze product's buyer profile and match it with creator's followers profile, find the potential creators for the product. # ❗️❗️Important Notice for New TTSPC： New Updates： 1. The authorization will all be in real-time: 1. Once the creator authorizes the CAP partner the data access rights, the CAP partner should see the **historical** data immediately if creator authorizes. # 🌟🌟Data Function Introduction： # **Data Overview** ## How to use data overview? New Updates： Added metrics "Settlement GMV" (30 days) for L2L CAP partners to see how much they can get from TTS based on their managed creators. * To understand the overall transaction performance and sales rate of the partner's bound creators, and to see the percentage of partners with sales, to determine the activity of its creators and the partner's ability to sell goods. * Analyze the live/video content channels to analyze the ability of the partner's bound creators to sell goods, the number of content releases, and the CTR conversion efficiency. ## Detail introduction of functions ### Present the sales performance of Partners **Core indicators：** * Livestreaming Partners: The number of partners that have live-streamed during the selected period * Partners with Sales: The number of partners that generated in revenue during the selected period * Active Rate: (Active Live Partners/Partners) * 100% * Sales Rate: (Partners with Sales/Partners) * 100% ### Present the overall sales trend of Partners * GMV (Total): The cumulative amount paid for orders generated from all partner channels during the selected period, including in-house and Affiliate channels, and including returns and refunds * GMV (Livestreaming): The cumulative amount paid for orders generated from partner live streams during the selected period, including returns and refunds * GMV (Video): The cumulative amount paid for orders generated from partner videos during the selected period, including returns and refunds * Avg. GMV (Livestreams): GMV (Livestreaming) / Livestreams * GMV (Refunds): The cumulative amount successfully refunded to buyers during the selected period ### Show the live sales & conversion trend * Livestreams: The number of in-house live streams by partners during the selected period * Duration: The cumulative duration of in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * Orders: The number of orders created and paid by users from all partners' in-house livestreams/livestreams * Product Sales: The cumulative number of products sold from in-house livestreams by partners during the selected period * live streamsAvg. CTR: (Number of product live streams of livestream views) / livestreams ### Show the video sales & conversion trend * Videos: The number of videos posted by partners during the selected period * Orders: The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from partner videos * Product Sales: The cumulative number of products sold from partner videos during the selected period * Avg. CTR: (Number of product clicks / number of video views) / number of videos

The core indicators are： * Transaction performance：Revenue, Orders, Item sold, Buyers * Refund performance：Refund revenue, Refund orders, Refund best-selling sold * Traffic performance：Views, Viewers, Product Clicks, CTR, C_O * Product quality：Return rate, Negative review rate, complaint rate
### **🔥**Scenario 4: View the percentage of deals brought by different creators to the item and the high revenue excellent content Agencies can see the amount and percentage of sales for each creator and the number of live streams/videos that sold the product. Agencies can also see the percentage of sales from different channels of live/video/merchandise cards. It helps agencies find the videos and livestreams that bring the highest sales to the product. Agencies can learn from the best content and imitate the content production methods to create more explosive content.
### **🔥Scenario 5:**Understand the conversion efficiency and user profile of products It helps organizations understand the conversion efficiency of the exposure-click-order traffic funnel of products and the user profile of each layer of the funnel. Agencies can view the fan demographics, phone price range distribution, and video preference of users for the exposure, click, and transaction users. And according to the differences in the portraits of different categories of people, they can find the types of people with higher conversion efficiency and locate the target groups of products.
## Details of Product Analytics ### Select products You can choose to view data from the previous 6 months, the last 28 days, the last 7 days, specific days, weeks or months, and custom time periods. Notes: 1. When a custom Items is selected, UV indicators (Buyers and Viewers) are not displayed. 2. If the account has not been authorized to view the data for the selected items, the data cannot be viewed when the time period is selected.
### Select account Agencies can select different accounts to view their performance over a set and compare the previous cycle's indicator fluctuations, with the following core indicators. * Revenue * Products： live streams5 Understanding According period the number of products with sales during the selected period * Items sold * Orders Select up to 2 indicators at a time to view the trends.
### Product sales performance periodperiod Partners can view the transaction performance of different products across different channels, the overall conversion performance, the negative review rate, number of refundsperiod and complaint rate. * Transaction performance: Revenue, Refund, Commission, Buyers, Orders, Items Sold, Refund unit sales for all channels * LIVE: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Video: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Showcase: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Traffic and conversion performance: Views, Viewers, Product clicks, CTR, C_O * Product quality performance: Return rate, negative review rate, complaint rate NOTE: Newly added the "Export" function right after the button "Metrics". ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b912ff6e1618484599e1ba983b281ede~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8d0bfe89049743ff845a81f8064ea737~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### View product transaction, channel and user analysis Organizations can click on the product's [Details] to enter the details page to view the performance of individual products. * **Transaction Analysis** * Support agencies to view the effect data of commodities: * Transaction performance：Revenue, Orders, the sold, Buyers * Refund performance：Refund revenue, Refund orders, Refund item sold * Traffic performance：,Views, Viewers, Product Clicks, CTR, C_O * Product quality：the Return rate, Negative review rate, complaint rate
* **Channel Analysis** * By splitting the merchandise transactions according to the Creator dimension, you can view the individual transactions: * revenue, Percentage of transactions（*The proportion of the transaction amount of the goods delivered by the person in the selected time period to the total transaction amount of the goods*）, Orders, Item Sold, Buyers * Split the product transaction by transaction channel, you can view the product in different channels: * Items revenue, Percentage of transactions, Orders, ,, Buyers,CTR，C_O * Support to view the video with the most transactions for the product, click on the video details to jump to the video analysis page * revenue, orders, item sold, buyers * Support viewing the livestream with the most transactions for the product.： * items live-stream room name, start time, creator name&picture of this , revenue, orders, item sold, buyers
* **User Profile** * Creators the conversion rate between Product viewers-Product click user \ Product click user-Buyers \ Product viewers-Buyers respectively, and show the trend of this User by day in the selected time period on the right * by-product period Show items live stream items Support viewing user portraits items sold impression, product click, and product buyers： * Age: 18-24, 25-34, 35+, Unknown * Gender: Male, Female, Others **ONLY** show profile when the total group users are over 1000

detail.title: [CAP/TAP] Custom Report
detail.content:
This guide outlines how to access the Custom Report that is available in the Analytics section of the Partner Center. Below, we explain how you can use them to export and analyze data so you can analyze your managed Creators' performance in-depth. # **Overview** Custom Report is available in the Analytics section of TikTok Shop Partner Center, which helps CAP and TAP Agencies access tailored data for easy analysis and reporting. It enables agencies to select relevant metrics, adjust timeframes, and apply filters to refine reporting results, providing clearer data visualization. Reports can be exported to Excel as well for deeper analysis, supporting long-term creator management strategies. As the Custom Report continues to evolve, four new features have been introduced in Dec 2024: Time Comparison, Summary, Trend Charts and additional filters, enabling lightweight analysis capabilities for Agencies. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8be96f4f7eec4ace87a61c68a315a359~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **Benefits of Custom Report for Agency Partners** 1. **Enables customization of data and reporting needs:** Customize filters and dimensions to fulfill key data analysis needs, such as getting hot product lists for specific campaigns and examining overall performance across campaigns. 2. **Improves efficiency:** Streamlines the process so campaign data can be easily viewed, exported and analyzed all in one place. 3. **Offers enhanced Insights**: Exporting enables further analysis and manipulation of data within Excel, empowering you to delve deeper into insights, leading to more informed decision-making and strategic planning. 4. **Provides ready access to past reports**: Users have easy access to reports along with dimensions and filter configurations) generated in the past and can download them again. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/31f1684c47bb405094ba8ad7fcfd92fb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **Use cases for Custom Report** ## New Use Cases Enabled by Latest Features ### [NEW] Use Case 1: Quickly access the trend chart of Affiliate GMV for a specific creator * Select creator dimension, input creator's handle in the creator filter, then click the "**Search**" button. * Navigate to the "Trend chart" tab., select "**Affiliate GMV**" metric to view its trend chart. * To compare Affiliate GMV trends across multiple creators, you can clear the creator handle in the initial filter and **input multiple creator handles** in the filter on the **Trend Chart** tab. ### [NEW] Use Case 2: Track campaign progress and compare performance across periods * Select the Campaign dimension and choose "**All Time**" for the date range; then enable the **Comparison checkbox**, and select the desired comparison metrics, and click "**Search**" to generate results. * View comparison rates for all selected numeric metrics in the "Table" tab, displayed in red/green below the raw data values to indicate increases/decreases. * Select "**Summary**" near the Export button to quickly access the rough proportion of each campaign. * Click the "**Export"** button to download the raw data, comparison rates, and summary data together. ## Salient use cases for Agency partners The following use cases are not exhaustive and only highlight key analytics use cases and metrics that Agencies can use as part of their creator management operations. ### Use Case 1: View creator management analytics at different timeframe ranges * You can use the **Time dimension** to group key metrics in terms of the time range that meets your analytics needs. You can choose to use **Daily** level aggregation for in-depth analytics of Creator management and use **Monthly** aggregation to view long-term trends, Creator performance/growth and overall reporting purposes. ### Use Case 2: Check product lists or categories of products * You can use the relevant **Dimensions** setting to select **Product** and **Product Category.** These can include but are not limited to product specific GMV, product level engagement and impressions etc. Add the **Creator** dimension to view how fruitful Creators/Product combinations are. * Next, you can use the **Filters option** to add in your date range and the specific list of **Creators and Shops** that have promoted the product. Once you click on Search, you will be given the list of all products for the campaigns that meet your filter options. ### Use Case 3: Understand Creator performance to maximize ROI * You can use the relevant **Dimensions** setting to select Creator specific metrics such as GMV, Orders etc. * Next, you can use the **Filters option** to **add the specific Creator IDs** for whom you want to see results. Once you click Search, you will be given the list of all creators in your selected campaigns. ### Use Case 4: Track performance metrics for LIVEs and short videos * You can use the relevant **LIVE and Video dimensions** to select channel specific metrics such as GMV, traffic efficiency, engagement and CTR/CO as well as other metrics. * *Note: You may not check live room level data and video level data at the same time, you can check them individually.* * Next, you can use the **Filters option** to **add Creator IDs and Product IDs** for your managed Creators and products. Once you click Search, you will be given the list of all products and shops for the campaigns selected in your filter options. ### Use Case 5: Export and access past reports * For every result set generated, you can **Export** results into Excel for more detailed analysis. * Custom Report allows you to refer to previous reports you have generated (within past 7 days) and re-download them with the dimension and filter configurations in place when the report was generated. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8b7f118603574abcb20129e783170a13~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **How to use Custom Report in your Partner Center** ## Entrance Authorized users can access and use Custom Report by navigating to **Partner Center > Analytics > Custom Report**
## Usage and access considerations 1. If an agency provides TSP or MCN/CAP services as well as the TAP services, they will need to change their service category to MCN/CAP to be able to view metrics for CAP related data. 1. *For example*: If an agency is registered as a TAP and MCN/CAP in US region, they must choose between TAP and MCN/CAP service categories to be able to view the relevant data 2. The region in Custom Report will not automatically be the same as the region selected on other tabs of the Analytics section. 1. *For example*: An agency is registered as an ++MCN/CAP++ in both MY and ID. While viewing data in the Video Analytics tab, they switch their region from ID to MY. However, when they open the Custom Report tab, the region will revert back to ID instead of remaining consistent with the region they were viewing in the Video Analytics tab. ## **Using Dimensions** Dimensions are logical groupings of important and relevant metrics. Within the Dimensions section, you can select a number of different dimensions. Dimensions correspond to the headings displayed in your search results. 1. **Time Dimension** — Here, you can select from **one of the below.** Select a particular **time dimension** to aggregate results by the selected dimension range. 1. By Day 2. By Week (starting on Monday) 3. By Month 4. All Time (is selected by default in the time dimension)
2. **Other Dimensions** — you can **multi-select** any of the below. The only exception is that LIVE and Video cannot be selected together. Note: When you select each dimension, **all the types associated with that dimension** are automatically selected. All associated metrics will also be displayed in the grid view. At a later time, users will also be able to select individual metrics within the selected dimensions to have an even more relevant view of the metrics of interest. | At present, the following dimensions will be available for authorized CAP users. | The following dimensions will be available for TAP users. | | --- | --- | | 1. Creator
2. LIVE
3. Video
4. Product
5. Shop
6. Product Category | 1. Campaign
2. Creator
3. LIVE
4. Video
5. Product
6. Shop
7. Product Category | *After selection of the required dimensions, the number of associated underlying metrics will be displayed and will dynamically change as the selected dimension combination changes.*
## **Using Filters** Filters can help you better refine search results. You can select from the time filter as well as the categories, as detailed below. 1. **Time** — both fixed and dynamic time periods are supported, with the oldest date option 6 months in the past. 1. **Fixed Date Range:** Select your desired date range by one or multiple days /week/month in the calendar box. Recent 6 month data is available. 2. **Dynamic Date Range:** Select from one of the following: 1. Last 7 days 2. Last 28 days 3. **Time comparison** — this checkbox is available when the "**All time**" dimension is selected. 1. The tool provides a default time comparison range, and you can customize it to any period within the last 6 months and before the base time range you select. 2. Comparison data is displayed below the raw data in red/green to indicate increases/decreases. This data can also be exported as an Excel file. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/19a0573364844360b8f6a72c809ff0a0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Creator Handle Name, Product ID, Shop ID filters, LIVE Room ID, Video ID, Product Category** — for each of these 6 filters supports accurate search as well as batch input. With batch input, you can separate each item by a comma and input a maximum of 500 items per filter. 1. You can select whether you want to **Include or Exclude** the items you have pasted for each filter. 2. This section is useful as it allows you to refine your results so that the data displayed will only be for the items you have added into the filters and is catered to what you need to analyze. 3. For Product category, you can choose to filter by whether Level 1 product category or Level 2 product category.
## Viewing data in table and trend 1. Once you have selected your dimensions and filters, press **Search** to get the corresponding results. You will see the total number of search results provided as well the underlying results in the grid view. 2. Within the grid view, you can sort by relevant metrics to highlight top/bottom metric trends.
3. Check **"Summary"** near the Search button to display a summary of all numeric metrics, located above the raw data and below the table header. This summary can also be exported as an Excel file.
4. The **Trend** tab becomes available when you select one dimension or leave all dimensions unselected. After clicking the **Search** button, navigate to the **Trend** tab to view a trend chart. 1. **Metric Selection:** Above the trend chart, select any numeric metric to display its trend. 2. **Legend Selection:** By default, the top 5 items are selected in the legend. You can switch to view trends for up to 10 different items of your choice.
**Metric selection** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/556b1b1bb92c4142b98e76128fd4e7de~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2e37b7f5c95d4019a6fa5f2a6df2acf3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Legend selection** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/30942879f2e440779f5634b9c35cf80b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Exporting data** To export this data to Excel, click on the **Export** icon on the top right of the results pane. This will automatically download **all items** into an Excel file that will be saved to your laptop. Load speeds will depend on data volume being extracted. You'll also see the **Export report** icon, which lists previous reports you have exported and which you can still download within 7 days (max 500,000 records can be displayed). This allows easy accessibility to previously generated reports without having to configure dimensions and filters separately again.
# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1. **Who can use Custom Reports in Partner Center?** In a previous launch, Custom Report was launched and targeted towards TAP partners with the ability to access data including campaign level analytics. As part of this launch, registered CAP Partners will also have access to Custom Report functionality. Custom Report will generally available across all regions. Considering the main and member account function, for CAP Partners, the main account can view and use all dimensions in Custom Report for CAP, while what dimensions the member account can view and use are determined by permission in other Analytics pages (Data Overview, Creator/LIVE/Video/Product Analytics). 2. **Can I choose which corresponding metrics for a selected dimension I want in my search results?** At this time, you cannot select individual metric associated with the dimension. All metrics linked to the dimension will automatically be selected and displayed in your results. For instance, if you select the LIVE dimension, your search results will automatically display all associated types: Room ID, Livestream name and Time info. This feature is slated for a future release. 3. **Why are some LIVE dimension results not visible when a particular date range filter is selected?** When the LIVE dimension is selected and data is requested within a specific date range, only LIVE rooms whose start date falls within this range will be included.

Real-time monitoring of live transactions
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d74145cf43c04281aa28f4d61a29778a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/dd2e1add4b3148e3b76945e1a5d35923~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. Monitor user's entry/live trends, capture traffic peaks and seize high conversion opportunities. 2. Analyze the conversion of different products to find potential products with low impression and high conversion.
Monitor multiple livestream
1. Monitor all creators' performances who are doing livestreams at the same time, find highlights and lowlights in the live room more quickly.
Recap creator historical live performance
1. Check each creator's past live performance to monitor their diligence and sales performance in a period. ### Scenario 2: Video Operation - Find good performance videos and Replicate Success Cases.
Monitor video performance

Monitor the number of videos posted by each creator and overall video sales performance. 2. Analyze each video's product sales and find the best performance video recently to give more promotion budgets.
Learn from excellent video
1. Analyze the sales performance of different products within one video and find suitable product for this video content. 2. Learn from excellent examples of selling the same product, optimize your own video content to make the content more attractive. 3. Analyze each video's finish rate and traffic trends, summarize high finish rate/traffic videos' production experience. ### Scenario 3: Product Strategy - Monitor different creators' product sales Performance
Monitor product sales performacne
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/44e34b30a26d49039b9a2b49a9662582~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a93b73cfbc97498cbaf10197e930a815~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. View each creator's sale performance, understand the best performance products, and match the creator with suitable products. 2. Filter by shop to check how much GMV has been achieved by each creator, which makes it easier to calculate the goal achievement of each shop.
Analyze each product's perfomance
1. Analyze each creator's contribution to product revenue and find which content created most revenue, learn from the good examples and adjust creator's product strategy. 2. Analyze product's buyer profile and match it with creator's followers profile, find the potential creators for the product. # ❗️Important Notice for New TTSPC： ## How to get creator's data authorization to check their performance? Step 1 Agencies can go to [ data authorization ] page and click [request] to send data authorization request. *If you are a cross-border partner, you can switch markets and check creators under different markets.
Step 2 fill in the request authorization period. Note: **the data authorization request will expire in 7 days . After expiration, you need to resend request**
Step 3 - After the agency sends an authorization application, the creators will receive an invitation on the TikTok app： | Message | Partnership center | INBOX | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8dc1b7d516b64b9dbc70fb092ea1966c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/37f1fe800d114deb9bf1123b3a11c426~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6101c96064d5451f983a1609bc401eec~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f7dba62444db4c2db4269aa9626fa34a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | After clicking on the message, creator can go to the data authorization page and choose to authorize or decline. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4305ec0512d9499cacc0cba6f0fd203e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) If creator chooses authorize, you can go to authorized tab and click [view data] to check the data *If you are a cross-border partner, you can switch markets and check creators under different markets.
## History Data in old Partner Platform: 1. For creators who already authorized the service and data to an agency, the available time period of data will be same as the old partner platform. 2. For creators accounts which have been bound with the agency, these creator accounts data will be moved to the new TTSPC. 3. After moving to the TTSPC, the original bound creator official and marketing accounts data can't be viewed as a MCN. ## Change Between different Partner roles and Markets // * If an agency has both TSP and MCN dual identities, the agency can click on the name logo in the upper right corner and click on it to switch to TSP/MCN identity, while the devolved data, too, will change according to the account data bound to different identities. * For agencies who operate in different markets, they can click on the name logo in the upper right corner and switch to different markets to check market performance. * Notice: an agency can only check one role performance in one market at one time.
(Note: The screenshot is for reference only and uses a test account with mock data. The actual interface and features may differ.) # Data Function Introduction： We have introduced a new Content Type Based GMV Attribution where GMV will be attributed to the last content type that a buyer clicked on when checking out a product. As such, across the Analytics pages, transaction related metrics (e.g. Direct GMV, Orders, C_O, GPM, Buyers) for LIVE/ Video will now be updated to reflect the logic change. **++LIVE++**++ ++**++Direct GMV & Video Direct GMV++** * You'll now see **LIVE** **Direct GMV and Video Direct GMV metrics** which previously were not available and are calculated using the **Content Type Based GMV Attribution** * LIVE Direct GMV and Video Direct GMV refer to the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from creator's LIVE or Video, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is only tabulated based on the last clicked LIVE/VIDEO. * Therefore, LIVE Direct GMV and Video Direct GMV are indicators of how effective a livestream or video is in directly **driving conversions and sales** **No change:** 100% of Affiliate GMV = LIVE + Video + Showcase * The way commission is calculated for creators will **++not++** change * The Affiliate GMV allows you to track the **overall GMV performance,** and takes into account attributed GMV as well. Traditionally, this is what is used to calculate your commission and, as there are no changes to this, this means there will be no changes to how your commission is calculated**.** # **Data Overview** How to use data overview? * You can use this to understand the overall transaction performance and sales rate of your bound creators * You can also find the percentage of creators with sales to determine the activity of your creators * Analyze the live/ video content channels and the number of content releases and and the CTR conversion rate ## Core Data * **Livestreaming Partners:** The number of partners that have livestreamed during the selected period * **Active Rate:** (Active Live Partners/ Partners) * 100% * **Partners with Sales:** The number of partners that generated in revenue during the selected period * **Sales Rate:** (Partners with Sales/ Partners) * 100% ## Affiliate Performance * **Affiliate** **GMV:** The cumulative amount paid for orders generated from all partner channels during the selected period, including in-house and Affiliate channels, and including returns and refunds * **Est. Commission:** The estimated commission a creator can receive, but it may differ from the actual commission payment due to factors such as orders refunds. * **Commission base:** This is the base number which we use to calculate the estimated commission, and excludes taxes. * **Items Sold:** The number of items sold in the selected time period ## Creator Performance * **LIVE Direct GMV:** LIVE direct GMV is the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from LIVEs, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is calculated based on the last clicked livestream and excludes any form of attributed GMV * **LIVE Avg. Direct GMV:** The average GMV achieved from LIVE stream by creators during the selected period * **LIVE Orders:** The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from LIVE stream * **LIVE Product Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from creators LIVE stream during the selected period * **LIVE Avg. CTR:** (Number of product clicks / number of livestream views) / livestreams * **Direct Refund GMV:** The cumulative amount refunded to buyers during the selected period based on Direct GMV achieved. This means that the Refund GMV only calculates GMV from refunded orders based on buyer's last clicked content type and excludes any form of refunded orders from attributed GMV. * **Video Direct GMV:** Video direct GMV is the total amount paid for orders placed directly from videos, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is only calculated based on the last clicked video and excludes any form of attributed GMV * **Video Orders:** The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from creators videos * **Video Product Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from creator videos during the selected period * **Video Avg. CTR:** (Number of product clicks / number of video views) / number of videos
# **LIVE Analytics** Use cases: * Partner portal live screen: support to view live & real-time data of multiple creators at the same time * Review live data: support viewing the historical live data of creators * Authorization of creator data: Agencies only get access to this after they have obtained permission from creator. ## **Ongoing livestreams** There are creators on LIVE.
Here, you can see the profile pictures, names and handles of people who are currently on LIVE (for ease, you can filter specific creator by name or handle in the search bar). * **For agencies that have obtained data authorization**, you will be able to see the following metric for the chosen creator: * **GMV:** The cumulative amount paid for orders generated from all partner channels during the selected period, including in-house and Affiliate channels, and including returns and refunds * **Direct GMV:** This is the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from LIVEs, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is calculated based on the last clicked livestream and excludes any form of attributed GMV * **Viewers:** The number of viewers watching the LIVE stream * **Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from creators LIVE stream during the selected period * **Orders created:** The number of SKU orders created by users from LIVE stream * **Product Clicks:** The number of clicks to the promoted Product * **Order paid:** The number of SKU orders paid by users from LIVE stream * **Product Impressions:** The number of views to the promoted Product * **For those who have not obtained data permission**, the button to apply for permission is displayed. At the same time, regardless of the data permission, agencies can view the creator’s live page, comments and commodity since this information is displayed publically during the LIVE.
When you click on any live card, more detailed information will be displayed as shown below.
If you click on the LIVE screen button (as displayed on the green background), you are able to to get more information about the creator via the Live Dashboard. ## **Live Dashboard** We have 2 versions of Live Dashboard available - Basic and Advanced. Here you can monitor real-time live performance of live as it's happening or monitor performance of historic lives you have hosted.
* Core transactions and traffic metrics are outlined in the below image
* You can also view the breakdown information for every product's sales & conversion rate
* Traffic source
After live ends, you can also replay livestream to recap live comments and host performances.
## **All livestreams** Under the **All livestreams** option, you can select a creator to view their **historical livestreams.** You can apply for permission in batches or alternatively apply for data permission for a single historic livestream. | **Option 1:** Bulk apply for permission | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b723241766b04c54b78944a9f695b532~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | --- | --- | | **Option 2:** Apply for one livestream | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/26cef3c0a1ef4ff78da77c897ff7a03c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
|
After obtaining the data permission, you can view the Start Time, Duration, GMV, Direct GMV, Viewers and Items sold. If you click on **LIVE Screen** (highlighted in green text), you can jump to the live screen of the creator to get further data.
## Q&A 1. Why are the common data indicators in the live room floating? * Each data indicator will be compared with the last five minutes and updated every minute 2. How many creators can get onto the live screen at the same time? * Max 5 3. What is the query range of the historical live room data? * The live room which is after signing the contract can be found, and the live room data during the contract time will be provided. * Example: Creator A signs a contract with the agency on May 1, 2020, then creator A terminates the contract on October 1, and finally re-signs on July 1, 2021. This way, the agency can apply for 01/04/2020 - 01/10/2020 time period and 01/07/2021 - current time period for data permissions. 4. What if it shows creator's data as not being available？ * Agencies cannot send data authorization requests to account holders who are based in the United States. # **Creator Analytics** Use cases 1. **Master the content production ability of creators** By intuitively showing CTR, CO, RPM indicators, creator analysis can help agencies analyze the content output quality of the creators. 2. **Analyze the performance of creators** Showing the exposure, conversion and transaction efficiency of all creators in both live/video can help agencies quickly grasp the content attractiveness and the ability to monetize the goods of the creators, so that determines the long-term cooperation strategy of the creators and agency. 3. **Tracking commission income** Creator analysis can help agencies understand the commission income of different creators to get out the total income. ## Creator data When you click on **Creator Analytics,** you'll be able to see the **data of authorized creators** in this section. You can send an authorization application to creator clicking request authorization in **pending authorization** if s creator has not approved the authorization as of yet. If you select **Metrics**, you can select what you would like to view for all sellers who have authorized data. Under the **'Affiliate Performance' metric** sub-heading, you can find the following: * Affiliate GMV * Items Sold * Est. commission * Commission base ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/692cb49059374a2f92637594e0c14bc5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/57f33577498b4cbaaf22158036c2194a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Q&A 1. How long does the request expire after the agency initiates the authorization? * Expires if there is no response in 7 days 4. What if it shows creator's data as not being available？ * Agencies cannot send data authorization requests to account holders who are based in the United States. # **Video analytics** The new video analytics on the [partner platform](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/partner/partner-settle/welcome?type=register) helps agencies get a comprehensive view of the video performance of managed creators, measure their diligence, content creativity, content popularity and ability to deliver products. This feature is built to enhance creator management efficiency. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8701c9a0d4ee4feea9f0f511c5841c54~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/43b5ec1009c0495eabc48f7d3e0f95ad~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Use cases 1. **Mastering the overall performance of Creator Videos** Agencies can view the amount of transactions, commission income and video releases brought by videos in any period of the last 3 months, and also support viewing the trend of transactions and video releases in the period to help agencies grasp the diligence and ability of the creator to sell products. 2. **Understand the number of videos posted and the video carrying capacity of each creator** Agencies can filter by account to view the video posting of different creators and their performance in bringing products, and at the same time, they can view the performance of the daily videos of the creators, so that they can promptly explore the explosive videos for marketing promotion. 3. **Understand the content of each video / Deal performance and closing / Watching user profile** Understand the transaction/attraction revenue and promotion effect of the short video channels of the creators within the statistical time, conveniently learn the similar short video production experience of the excellent creators, understand the video's viewer and transaction user profile, and the difference between different people. ## Core data | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | 1. When you select a creator, you can view their performance

1. Affiliate GMV

4. Est. Commission
5. Videos

Please note that the GMV shown here will be different to Direct GMV because here GMV takes into account indirect GMV from affiliates in order to make sure that **the commission paid to Creators via Affiliate Plans will not change.**

2. You can select 2 indicators and compare the metrics' trends.

detail.title: [MCN/CAP]Video inspirations
detail.content:
# **High-level overview** Ready to be inspired? Video Inspiration for TTSPC (TikTok Shop Partner Center) brings agency partners relevant data and tons of ideas for creating highly engaging content and optimizing their video creation strategy. Here's what's in store: 📈 Visibility on **critical metrics and data from top-ranked videos, music and hashtags** to help you understand successful content trends. 💬 **Identification of drivers** for fostering engagement and transaction, and **recommendations** on how to make your videos more engaging. 🔬 Drilldown on interaction patterns for top-ranking videos to **understand detailed trends in user engagement.** Let's dive in! ## **Feature value proposition** Video Inspiration for TTSPC provides the insights and recommendations needed to produce highly engaging and shoppable content. You can benefit from: 1. Insights and metrics from high-performing videos across categories and date ranges that allow you to benchmark your own content against performant and successful shoppable videos. 2. Recommendations and inspiration for scripting and conversation points that can unlock higher engagement and ultimately boost conversion. 3. Visibility on other aspects of high-performant content (e.g., music, hashtags) that are likely to increase impressions and conversion for published shoppable videos. Ultimately, Video Inspiration for TTSPC aims to empower TikTok Shop partners with insights and an understanding of the drivers behind the creation of content that fosters engagement and conversion for managed creators and sellers. ## **Access and authorization** Video Inspiration for TTSPC is available for registered TSP and CAP partners in the U.S. without the need for any specific category permissions. ## **Overall feature interface** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/76d65bbeda39453fbc20a685129b7a35~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## **Feature component walkthrough** The following section elaborates the different components of the Video Inspiration functionality for Agencies within TTSPC. #### **++Entrance++** Navigate to Partner Center and click into the Video Inspiration section of the portal under the Analytics tab. You can also use the link[ here](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/compass/video-inspiration?tabKey=video). | **Platform** | **Navigation path** | **UI interface demo** | | --- | --- | --- | | TikTok Shop Partner Center | Partner Center > Analytics > Video Inspiration | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8fcbd8759dd14bc8a265884fdb5677de~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b8f2f391961246fab745ed561249bf34~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| #### **++Applicable filters++** You can filter the data based on available parameters (described below). Filters are applied to all available content types (i.e., video, music and hashtag). | Filter parameter | Filter description | **UI interface demo** | | --- | --- | --- | | Product category | Drop-down list of available product categories.
All categories are selected by default. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a7f17af3ddc44c01a7db90d48bc9a3f3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | Date range | Calendar for selecting the date range to filter results.
**“Last 7 days”** is the default filter.
You can also choose “**Last 28 days"** as a preset date range.
You can select a custom date range, but you can only specify a one-week span. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/577ce1d3eb354d95b099967c4adcba56~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| #### **++Script skills++** Script skills outline a set of best practices and helpful insights that make videos and content engaging. These content suggestions are based on trends observed in successful videos. You can explore best practices and techniques and incorporate them within your published content to increase engagement, impressions and conversion. Click on Learn More to view insights and best practices from the Script Skills Hub that are grouped into themes, letting you browse, explore and incorporate them into your content. | **UI interface demo** | | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/79e520e42e3f4b3aa5ac1bba6bb29229~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/485d656748f04d2291f94c1e7bc7deb6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| #### **++Inspiration content++** Inspiration content within the Video Inspiration section is grouped into top-ranking videos, music and hashtags. ##### **🎦 Top-ranking videos** | Content | Elements and interactions | **UI interface demo** | | --- | --- | --- | | Top videos list view | In the Video tab, you can view a list of top shoppable videos with filters and sorting parameters.
Top video results can be sorted based on:

1. Video views
2. Interactions
3. Finish rate

The top 50 videos within the selected filter range are displayed and can be navigated with pagination. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c4cd5dee5ec54270b4203f7e490b57f1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Top video preview card | For each video within the top videos list, a video card displays metrics related to video engagement, utilized script skills and hashtags used in the video.
Hovering over the video triggers an autoplay preview.
*This information helps you understand engagement metrics, utilize the right hashtags and incorporate skills to boost conversion.* | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ef8e93940533495aaa498fdb397e53f7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Top video card details | You can click on the Details button to perform a deep dive on any video card. The detailed description contains the following:

* Overview — Provides details of the video, including the hashtags and music used coupled with the product information and link.



* Performance — Key performance metrics related to video engagement.



* Script skills — Description of script skills used in the video.



* Time series plot — Interactive trend plot that outlines video engagement metrics (i.e., views and likes) at a second-level granularity.


*You can leverage this critical information to customize content with the aim of boosting engagement and conversion.* |
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/caec47d2a27f4136bc176bf235e96efd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ##### **🎵 Top-ranking music** | Content | Elements and interactions | **UI interface demo** | | --- | --- | --- | | Top music list view | In the Music tab, you can view a list of the top music being used in shoppable videos, with filters.

The top 50 songs within the selected filter range are displayed, and you can navigate with pagination. |
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/08cee7174aa04a75b9a9ce7c8c84573d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Top music preview card | For each song on the top music list, the music card displays videos that have utilized the song. You can click on the Detail button to navigate to the song's detailed description. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/765207b77f434142850a3e22f4e4f212~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ffbcb2821c8d49c8b8ea0c056ba2adad~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/72518cbe705c4889a0c33e06dadfe6a6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ##### **#️⃣ Top-ranking hashtags** | Content | Elements and interactions | **UI interface demo** | | --- | --- | --- | | Top hashtags list view | In the Hashtags tab, you can view a list of the top hashtags used in shoppable videos, with filters.

The top 50 hashtags within the selected filter range are displayed, and you can navigate with pagination. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0ac8ef1857ef424fbbe86b3cbdc42461~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Top hashtags preview card | For each hashtag on the top hashtags list, the hashtag card displays videos that have utilized it.
You can see the number of views of videos with the hashtag within the selected filter range as well as the total number of views.
Finally, you can click on the Detail CTA, to navigate to the hashtag's detailed description. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e4b9ef73cc4c42859c2571bbc57b31ea~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/72e056181db743c480f3c1611f807033~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c146a7fd6a5046afb8528fafb3e62c2b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)** 1. **On what platforms can I access Video Inspiration for TTSPC?** A: At present, Video Inspiration for TTSPC is available only on PC.

detail.title: Submit a ticket
detail.content:
# Submit a ticket through the Partner Console
If you are a registered partner, you can open, submit, and manage support tickets directly in the Partner Center Console.

1. In the Partner Center Console, navigate to the **Help Center** located at the bottom of the left-hand navigation panel. Then, select the option to **View my tickets**:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/52dc0234bb8440fbaf2663cdc0d0f588~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Alternatively, you can also submit a ticket by clicking on the **TikTok Shop Partner** banner and selecting **Submit a Ticket** in the drop-down menu:
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8369e43f0d8f4d15a2ca8c674296c2ff~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

2. You will be redirected to the **Support tickets** page. In the upper right-hand corner, select **Submit a ticket** to file a new ticket with our support team:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d94e5ca158524819938e552097d5570c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

3. From the drop-down menu, choose the appropriate issue subject and category to ensure your ticket is directed to the relevant point of contact:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9a76b3a2c32f4987bebb4d749a4bf217~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

4. Please provide a ticket title, a detailed issue description, and any relevant files and documents. The more detailed your description, the more efficiently our support team can provide timely assistance:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/18543d33dbf24d04b3e2c5a434d48112~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

5. Upon successful ticket submission, a confirmation will be displayed:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ce098005a125419387ceb103dac9e106~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

6. When our support team responds, you can see the response on the **Support tickets** page. This page serves as a hub for tracking and managing all tickets you have opened. In addition, you can submit a new ticket directly from this page:

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/acddaddd2002485da9fee97ee44ad46d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Ticket response time
Once you've submitted a ticket, our support team aims to provide an initial response within 24 business hours, usually much sooner, to address your question. Our goal is to resolve your issue completely within 48 business hours.

* **Initial Response:** Typically < 24 business hours
* **Issue Resolution:** Target < 48 business hours

Please note that these are general response time guidelines, and we always strive to address your needs as promptly as possible.

detail.title: [US] Shop Health
detail.content:
# **Introduction** For U.S. L2L partners, the **Health Center > Shop Health** module on TTSPC centralizes key data for your signed sellers. No more switching to Seller Center, you can access seller health scores (AHR/SPS/CHR) and violation records directly in TTSPC. The module also highlights sellers with abnormal scores and offers flexible filters, helping you streamline governance and act proactively. # **What Are the Benefits?** * **Save time on data access**: Skip logging into Seller Center. Partners now can view all critical seller health and violation data in TTSPC. * **Prioritize high-risk cases**: Quickly identify sellers with abnormal scores or declining health to focus on your follow-up efforts. * **Reduce GMV loss**: Address violations faster with clear visibility, lowering revenue impact from unhandled issues. # **Step by Step Guide** ## Step 1 Get Required Authorization ### Required Authorization * **Shop health/performance data**: Sellers must authorize at least one Seller Center Access role (Full Access/Customer Service/Order Fulfillment/Product Access/Ad Manager/Affiliate). * **TikTok account health data**: Permissions follow the same scope as Seller Center Data Compass. ### How to get authorization: Detailed userguide: [TSP Access Authorization Guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666feffacf2e2202c8d39191). #### **For sellers** * For new seller: When the seller authorizes TSP service through an authorization link, sellers choose Seller center access role to allow TSP access the specific authorized pages on the seller center。 ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/de5ed148402345a2a67f0a7194e95def~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * For signed seller: Signed seller can edit authorization through **Find partner >"..." > my service > Edit** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1c8eda9609f848a288eda3b842b1793d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### **For Partners** * In **TTSPC > seller management**, if there is no Permission role authorization / Data Compass authorization, you can click **"..." > Edit > Request permissions > Edit selection**,and then send seller request links. The seller can open the link to complete the TSP access authorization. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/418f8c7d15524554bc33445c15db0260~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5ad0f053b9a34c40b41bcb29d59040bf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 2 Access the Shop Health Module You can reach the module in the following 2 ways, and the data updates are shown in the top-right corner. 1. **Direct entry**: Log in to **TTSPC > Health > Seller** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/455e6af281cf4e39b186fbad5576e8c5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Homepage shortcut**: Check the "Shop Health Overview" on TTSPC **Home**, then click **View More** to open the full module. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/82c1e5ee598c471bb2b2e51136cc84cb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 3 Use Health Overview This section displays the number of signed sellers with **notably abnormal scores.** Hover over the "?" icon for quick explanations of each score. | **Health Metric** | **Score Ranges** | **Score Definition** | | --- | --- | --- | | Shop Health Rating (AHR) | -Fair: 51-199;

detail.title: Affiliate Partner Custom Report
detail.content:
This guide outlines how to access the new Custom Report feature that will be available in the Analytics section of the Partner Center. Below, we explain how you can use this feature to export data so you can see the success of creators and sellers participating in your campaigns.
# **Overview**
Custom Report is a new feature within the Analytics section that has been designed specifically to help Affiliate Partners effortlessly access and export data so it can be viewed in Excel. This will help you better visualize the data and perform any necessary additional analysis in Excel, which can ultimately aid you in devising effective long-term strategies for future campaigns.
# **Benefits for Affiliate Partners**

1. **Enables customization of data:** Customize filters and dimensions to fulfill key campaign review needs, such as getting hot product lists for specific campaigns and examining overall performance across campaigns.
2. **Improves efficiency:** Streamlines the process so campaign data can be easily viewed, exported and analyzed all in one place.
3. **Offers enhanced Insights**: Exporting enables further analysis and manipulation of data within Excel, empowering you to delve deeper into insights, leading to more informed decision-making and strategic planning.

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b30b7351501843b2a6743f2622f2df17~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# **Use cases for Custom Report**
## **Case 1: I want to know the hot product list for a specific list of campaigns.**

* You can use the **Dimensions** setting to select **Time** and **Product**, which will provide you with the following search result headings: Date, Product ID and Product name.
* Next, you can use the **Filters option** to add in your date range and the specific list of **campaign IDs** you want. Once you click on Search, you will be given the list of all products for the campaigns that meet your filter options. You can easily export this file to further analyze the data in Excel and filter the top-performing products across your campaigns.

## **Case 2: I want to know the overall performance for 3 campaigns.**

* In order to see overall performance, simply select **Time** in **Dimensions**, (You **will not** need **** to select any other Dimensions) which will produce the following headings in your search results: Date, Commission, Revenue, Orders, LIVE GMV, Video GMV and Showcase GMV (these are the default headings when no Dimensions are selected).
* You can also use the **Filters option** to add your date range and input the campaign IDs for which you’re interested in overall performance. Once you click on Search, you will be given the overall performance for the 3 campaigns you selected in the filters.

## **Case 3: I want to know the creator list for several campaigns in weekly view.**

* You can use the **Dimensions** setting to select **Week** *(a week always starts on Sunday)* and **Creator,** which will result in the following headings appearing in your search results: Date, Creator name and Creator nickname.
* Next, you can use the **Filters option** to **add the specific campaign IDs** for which you want to see creators. Once you click Search, you will be given the list of all creators in your selected campaigns.

## **Case 4: I want to know the collaborated progress of products with specific shops across several campaigns.**

* You can use the **Dimensions** setting to select **Time,** **Shop** and **Product,** which will provide you with the following headings in your search results: Date, Shop ID, Shop name, Product ID and Product name.
* Next, you can use the **Filters option** to **add specific Shop IDs and campaign IDs**. Once you click Search, you will be given the list of all products and shops for the campaigns selected in your filter options. You can easily export this file to further analyze the data in Excel, including filtering the results further to understand which shops produce the most top-selling products.

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ee18fbdd542e47b6bd72048b43bf4ffc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# **How to use Custom Report in your Partner Center**
Go to: **Partner Center > Analytics > Custom Report**
There are several sections within Custom Report, which we delve into below to help you understand how to effectively use this feature to export data.
Note:

1. If an agency provides TSP or MCN/CAP services as well as the TAP services, at present they will only be able to see the Custom Report data in the region their TAP service is linked to.
   1. For example: If an agency is registered as an MCN/CAP in both MY and ID but is registered as an Affiliate Partner in MY only, then they will only be able to open the Custom Report page in MY region.
2. The region in Custom Report will not automatically be the same as the region selected on other tabs of the Analytics section.
   1. For example: An agency is registered as an ++MCN/CAP and Affiliate Partner++ in both MY and ID. While viewing data in the Video Analytics tab, they switch their region from ID to MY. However, when they open the Custom Report tab, the region will revert back to ID instead of remaining consistent with the region they were viewing in the Video Analytics tab.

## **Using Dimensions**
Within the Dimensions section, you can select a number of different dimensions. Dimensions correspond to the headings displayed in your search results.

1. **Time Dimension** — Here, you can select from **one of the below.**
   1. By Day
   2. By Week (starting on Sunday)
   3. By Month
   4. By Entire Period (extends 6 months into the past and is selected by default when the time dimension is checked)

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9d2b7ba821de4595a5289de896131052~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

1. **Other Dimensions** — you can **multi-select** any of the below. The only exception is that LIVE and Video cannot be selected together.

Note: When you select each dimension, **all the types associated with that dimension** are automatically selected and will be displayed in your results.
| **Dimension** | **Types** |
| --- | --- |
| Campaign | Campaign ID, Campaign name, Campaign status, Campaign validation, Campaign time info |
| Creator | Creator name, Creator nickname |
| LIVE | Room ID, Livestream name, Time info |
| Video | Video ID, Video name, Post time |
| Product | Product ID, Product name |
| Shop | Shop ID, Shop name |
| Product category | Product category (level 1-2) |
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4697133db8bb43a8bd77f2420db89972~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## **Using Filters**
Filters can help you better refine search results. You can select from the time filter as well as the categories, as detailed below.

1. **Time** — both fixed and dynamic time periods are supported, with the oldest date option 6 months in the past.
   1. **Fixed Date Range:** Select your desired date range in the calendar box.
   2. **Dynamic Date Range:** Select from one of the following:
      1. Last 7 days
      2. Last 28 days

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5185e8aa3e0e4098a93e25df2db03403~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

1. **Creator Handle, Product ID, Shop ID, Campaign ID filters** — each of these 4 filters supports single search as well as batch input. With batch input, you can separate each item by a comma and paste a maximum of 500 items per filter.
   1. You can select whether you want to **Include or Exclude** the items you have pasted for each filter.
   2. This section is useful as it allows you to refine your results so that the data displayed will only be for the items you have added into the filters.

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bfa881465759473d86bb260158a5d173~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/17eef058a0ad465fb1a77aa453e0098d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## **Exporting data**

1. Once you have selected your dimensions and filters, press **Search** to get the corresponding results. You will see the total number of search results provided.

Note: If the number of search results is greater than 500, only the top 500 results will be displayed which you can view by navigating through the different pages. To view the additional results, you'll need to press **Export**, which will then export **all results** to Excel.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b859a2bf442648b0968c458dd7602485~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
To export this data to Excel, click on the **Export** icon on the right. This will automatically download **all items** into an Excel file that will be saved to your laptop.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c56d6434c3c0471fbd9c3aee064731f3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
You'll also see the **Export report** icon, which lists previous reports you have exported and which you can still download within 7 days (max 500,000 records can be displayed).
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/934cbec58016402a80e2bbff31d445f4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# **FAQs**

1. **Can I choose which corresponding type for a selected dimension I want in my search results?**

No, you cannot select an individual type associated with the dimension. All types linked to the dimension will automatically be selected and displayed in your results.
For instance, if you select the LIVE dimension, your search results will automatically display all associated types: Room ID, Livestream name and Time info.

1. **Is Custom Report available for MCN/CAP or TSP service categories as well?**

Currently, only Affiliate Partners can access Custom Report, but we will be launching this function for MCN/CAP in the next few months.

detail.title: Creator Management - Managing Sample Requests for Campaigns
detail.content:
# Overview This introduction provides an overview of new product features designed for TAP Agencies to manage sample requests submitted by creators across various campaigns. It also highlights frequently asked questions to ensure effective utilization of sample management features. # How to Manage Sample Requests? ## Review sample requests submitted by Creators
* Login to TikTok Shop Partner Center as a TAP Agency, click the "Creator Management" menu, and select "Manage samples". You can search for sample requests by Product ID/name, Campaign ID/name, Creator username. * On the "To review" tab, TAP Agencies can approve/reject sample requests submitted by creators for Agency initiated campaigns, TikTok Exclusive campaigns, and Seller initiated campaigns. ## Approve/reject sample requests after communicating with Creators * On the "To review" tab, you can review and approve sample requests submitted by creators: * Click "Approve" button to approve sample requests made by creators within 72 hours. * "Approve" button will be disabled when the product is out of stock, or the free sample limit has been reached, or the campaign has ended. * Reject sample requests made by creators only after communicating with creators to prevent missed opportunities. * Creators will be notified when you reject the sample requests. * Creators can re-submit sample requests for the sample product. * Click the IM icon to start chatting with the creators. * Select "Ask this product" to share the sample product link via IM.
## Find more information about the sample requests
* On any of the tabs on the Manage samples page, you can click the product name to review product details, and click the campaign name to review campaign details. * Sample availability information: * For TikTok Exclusive campaigns, sample availability is represented as the available campaign budget ($). * For Agency and Seller campaigns, sample availability is represented by the remaining sample quantity (count).
## Review all sample requests * All sample requests, including those from campaign types that don’t require Agency approval, will be consolidated under the "All" tab.
* Sample requests made by Agencies under Creators' authorization are included for tracking shipping status and content creation status. * TAP Agencies don't have access to manage Global Selling (GS) sample requests. While GS campaign sample requests and statuses are included, Agencies cannot approve/reject these requests or access sellers' contact information. * Navigate to the "Ready to ship" tab, click "Contact seller" to access the seller's contact info and proactively nudge them to ship the samples promptly.
* Navigate to the "Shipped" tab, click "View logistics" to view shipping info and updates. * Navigate to the "Content pending" tab, click the IM icon to start chatting with creators and actively nudge them to create content showcasing the product through either LIVE or short videos. * Navigate to the "Completed" tab, click "View content" to review short videos or LIVE replay videos, as well as key content performance metrics. * Navigate to the "Canceled" tab, and find all the rejected, expired, unavailable, or unfulfilled sample requests here. ## Educate Creators to submit sample requests by themselves Creators can now request samples for all campaign types, as long as they meet the eligibility criteria for sample requests specific to each campaign. TAP Agencies are encouraged to prompt Creators to request samples directly, as this enhances sample management efficiency and match rates. By allowing Creators to handle requests independently, TAP Agencies can avoid delays caused by waiting for Creator authorization and eliminate the need to speculate on specific product variants Creators wish to showcase. * Creators can go to the TikTok Shop Creator Center, navigate to the Affiliate partner Product list, and find the extra commission earnings when creators join a TAP campaign (compared to the open plan commissions) displayed on the product card above the product price. * Click the "gift" icon on the top right corner of the Product list page to enter the "Manage samples" page.
* Click the "Free sample" tab to review and manage all sample requests.
* If a sample request is under TAP Agency review, the Agency's name will be visible on the product card as "Managed by XXXXX". * Click the product card to track the sample request approval status, shipment updates, and fulfillment timeline (content posting). Click the "Post" button to post content directly from this page. * Request samples: * Click on a product card with a "Free sample" label, find the earning details and start requesting a free sample by selecting the product variant and entering the address info. * Sample approval and shipment status will be updated after a sample request is submitted. * The product will be added to Creator's Showcase automatically once a sample request is submitted.
# FAQ 1. **For which campaign types can TAP Agencies review and approve or reject sample requests?** | | **TAP Agency campaign** | **Seller campaign** | **TTS exclusive campaign** | **Global selling campaign** | **Open Collab** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Can Creators request samples? | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | Do TAP Agencies need to approve/reject sample requests made by Creators? | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | | Can TAP Agencies request samples for Creators? | Yes (with creator authorization) | Yes (with creator authorization) | Yes (with creator authorization) | Yes (with creator authorization) | No | | Do Sellers need to approve/reject sample requests? | No | No | No | No | Yes | 2. **Can Creators make a sample request for the same product if TAP Agencies have already done so on their behalf?** * No, if a TAP Agency requests a sample on behalf of Creators with their authorization, the sample will be automatically approved (unless the sample budget limit is reached) and moved to the "Ready to ship" status. Once approved, Creators can no longer request samples for the same products. 3. **How to tell if a sample request needs TAP Agency approval?** * ++For Creators and Sellers:++ TAP Agency's name will be displayed on the product card as "Managed by XXXXX" on the Sample requests page, if a sample request is under TAP Agency review. * ++For TAP Agencies:++ navigate to TikTok Shop Partner Center - Creator Management - Sample Management, click the "To review" tab to find all sample requests submitted by Creators that need TAP Agency approval. 4. **Why are TAP Agencies not able to approve/reject some of the sample requests displayed on the TTSPC Creator Management - Sample Management page?** * TAP Agencies cannot approve/reject sample requests for Global selling campaigns, and will not have access to the seller's contact information in these cases. * Sample requests submitted by TAP Agencies with creator authorization don't need to be approved. 5. **Why are TAP Agencies not able to find Sellers' info for some sample requests?** * TAP Agencies cannot approve/reject sample requests for Global selling campaigns, and will not have access to the seller's contact information in these cases. 6. **Can TAP Agencies approve/reject sample requests on Campaign details - Sample management page?** * No, TAP Agencies can only review and approve/reject sample requests on the Creator Management - Manage samples page. However, TAP Agencies can order samples on the Campaign details - Sample management page (creator authorization is needed).
