detail.title: Global Selling Collaborations Handbook
detail.content:
This instruction outlines the new product feature for TAPs to join Global Selling collaborations. This instruction will guide you through the process and highlight the key steps involved in utilizing this feature effectively.
Generally, for an agency to successfully join a Global Selling Collaboration, there are mainly 4 steps: 1. Add TAP category; 2. Create a product list from a collaboration for your creators; 3. Ask your creators to add products from your product list and create contents; 4. View collaboration performance and earn commissions. Below is detailed step-by-step guidance. ### How to Add TAP Category? **Step 1**: Access the service provider backend and open "**My Account**" from the sidebar. Click the "**Category & market**" button located in the top right corner.
**Step 2:** After selecting the **target market**, in the "**Business Category**" dropdown menu, click "**View More**" and select "**Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up**." Once submitted, the platform will review the partner's eligibility for Group Leader permissions.
**Step 3: (*++Only applicable for partners conducting business in the United States++*) Complete the W-8 tax form.** Navigate to the "**Finance**" > "**Payment Account**" page from the sidebar. Click the "**Complete tax info**" button in the notification bar. Fill in the required information as per the instructions on the new page and submit it. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cffe11cd11e94dd5a8ee140c7d25471e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1803e95ac9b44f62bed648cb3d202fd6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 4: Link a Bank Account.** After the platform approves your application, go to the "**Finance**" > "**Payment accounts**" page from the backend sidebar. Click the "**Link bank account**" button to link the receiving bank account. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/300a14e7bee64d209917eff6c83058cc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5429c5b0d0034db3a8f07c32a0332cdf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * For cross-border partners, Lianlian payment and Chinese bank account (for corporate) are supported. * For local partners, bank accounts are supported. ### How to Manage Primary Partnership Relationships with Self-Incubated Creators? > Note: *++(This feature is only supported by whitelisted partners++*) If the primary partnership is built, the agency can set the commission to 0. This step is only for agencies who have in-house creators and needs to set 0 commission for their own creators. If you don't have in-house creators, feel free to skip this step. Participating in Global Selling Collaborations doesn't necessarily require this step. #### Adding a Self-Incubated Collaboration Relationship Step 1: partners should open "**Creator Management**" > **"Manage Partnership**" from the sidebar and click on "**Manage exclusive partnership**."
**Step 2**: In the dropdown menu, partners can search for the already linked creator accounts (supporting multiple selections, up to 10 at a time) and click "**Request**" to submit the request. After submission, partners can check whether the creator accepts the invitation. **++The invitation is valid for 7 days++**. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/962361842ab84b3d9ee4c0d6c0dff0c0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e51e670c01c54f19b39c1baa422cd79b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Once the creator accepts the invitation, the status will change from "Requested" to "Accepted." **Step 3: Creator Accepts the Invitation on the TikTok App** | **Step-by-step guide** | **Demo of Creator Side** | | --- | --- | | 1. Creators will receive the invitation through three channels on the TikTok App: Inbox, Notification Center, and Partnerships. They need to accept the invitation within 7 days, or the invitation will expire. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0414b7fcf6e944c882098406f48af8a1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ef542a9ae593480580cf89ed35af9bee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d47afa0de16d48ecb5239bd10a60a375~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 2. By clicking on the message, creators will enter the partnership confirmation page, where they can review the partner's name, binding validity period, partnership validity period (from the binding start date to the end of the binding validity period), partnership details. After reviewing, they can check the agreement box, click "Accept" to accept the invitation. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/88f1499910fb4e2494981cd9d036143a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7db9e18788ef4b4f8eabae1f6780feee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | #### Ending the Primary Partnerships Partners can cancel the "Self-Incubated Collaboration Relationship" with creators within the partnership validity period **without needing the creator's consent**. **Step 1**: Partners should open "**Creator Manager**" > "**Manage Partnerships**" from the sidebar and click on "**Manage exclusive partnership**" in the top right corner.
**Step 2**: In the list, locate the creator with whom the relationship needs to be terminated. Click on the delete icon on the right side and confirm the action by clicking the "End" button in the pop-up window. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e29c82131eaf41069b5bedcd4f49e68f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/83dc3a3a9b48466cb0740da80ba171d5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) > ***++Note: If the termination is successful, the partner will no longer be able to set a 0 commission activity for that creator.++*** **Step 3: The creator will receive a notification of the termination, and no action is required on their part.**
### How to Create a Product List for Creators? **Step 1: View Global Selling Campaigns list** Click on "**Partner Campaigns**" > "**Global Selling campaigns**" from the sidebar to view the list of all available activities. * You can see the campaign name, ID, status, period, and the number of products in the activity. * You can search for campaigns by name or ID or filter them by market.
**Step 2: Browse the Product Pool** Click on "**View Details**" in the list to enter the activity details page. Here, you can view the campaign information (name, description, status, and period) and the complete information of all products in the activity (thumbnail, title, product ID, stock availability, click to view the product details page, price, item sold, total commission rate, and open plan commission for comparison, and product status). You can also search for products by name, ID, or category. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e4f1b3963c5b4db1a19843c296c2523d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) > ***++Note: It is recommended to bookmark the products you are interested in by clicking the bookmark icon on the right side for easier selection in the next step.++*** * **Tags**: There will be two recommendation tags for products that meet certain thresholds. * Top Selling: This product has had consistently high sales or revenue over the past 30 days. * Trending: This product has been identified from a TikTok video with high views and is gaining popularity over the past 7 days compared to other similar products. * **Filter products:** Click the filter button, you will see a filter panel where you can filter products by different metrics including categories, product ratings, tags, commission rate, item sold, etc.
* **Bookmark Products:** It is recommended to bookmark the products you are interested in by clicking the bookmark icon on the right side for easier selection in the next step. * Click "Saved products", you can view all products that you have bookmarked. * To cancel the bookmark for all products, you can click "Saved products" and then click "Deselect all". **Step 3: Create a Product List** Click on "**Product Lists**" to enter the product list page, then click on "**Create a product list**." In the sidebar window, enter the product list name (up to 100 characters, which will be displayed to creators for reference, so it is recommended to keep it concise within 4-5 words), and then click the "**Add Products**" button to start selecting products. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/33a27b4ec3764577a59d88faabb0de9a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bded2042d24e48fb84677bdaba074c2c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4677ef1196854b90bf510af1b881a987~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) > ***++Note:You can search for products by name, ID, or category to find the desired ones. You can also filter the products you bookmarked earlier. Each product list can contain up to 100 products.++*** * **After adding the products, set the commission rate for each product.**
* You can set the commission rate for each product individually or select multiple products and click "**Set up commission in bulk**" to set the commission rate in bulk. * Click on the **trash can icon** on the right side to delete a product. * Once the commission rates are set, click "**Review list**" in the bottom right corner to proceed. * **Check and Publish the Product List** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0dc0b82d4ce14d80a3fd9a8000444006~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d8c898fbc7ff4e9fb2e33c7dba5aac44~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * Double-check the list name, selected products, and commission rates for accuracy.**++ Please note that after the list is created, you cannot modify the previously added products and commission rates.++** Only new products can be added. * After confirming, click "**Create**" to complete the creation. A product list link will appear on the page, which you can share with your collaborating creators. **Step 4: View and Modify the List** Once created successfully, the list will appear on the list page. You can copy the link, view the list details, add products, and delete the list. * **View Details**: Click "View" to see all the product details and commission information in the list. Click "Add more products" to add more products. Click "OK" to close.
* **Add Products**: Click the **"More" (three dots) button** in the list and select "**Add more products**" to add products. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/77410d680b8f4c81a88af8a503ef9001~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7c82a6361c8a428abb040ae137bae44a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3e793541ae5a4dca84a0e2263eb19227~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * First, select the products you want to add in the pop-up window, click "Add" to confirm, then set the commission rate for each newly added product in the sidebar pop-up window, and click "Review List" to check and confirm. * **Delete List**: Click the "More" (three dots) button in the list and select "Delete list" to delete it. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/25a5be81952b4ff68e75aa82a54f344e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6a7d120c9356415d82e605eae0368b15~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) * Confirm the deletion in the pop-up window. After successful deletion, creators will no longer see the product list, but it will not affect the products already displayed in showcases and short videos. **Step 5: Duplicate a product list** By duplicating a product list, you can easily create the same product list for different creators, and add or delete products and modify commissions based on the original list to improve the efficiency. 1. There are two ways to start a duplication: a. Find the list you want to duplicate in the Product List view, click the "more" (three dots) button on the right, and select "Duplicate list". b. Or you can click "Duplicate list" in the upper right corner on a product list detail page to start duplicating
2. Fill in the new list name in the pop-up side window, edit the products and commissions, and then click preview to preview and create the list (same as creating a list).
### How do creators add products and apply for samples? **Step 1: Open the product list link provided by the partner to launch the TikTok app and browse the products.** * On the page, you can view the list name, partner name, and the activity's validity period. * The product list supports sorting by commission rate (high to low), price (high to low or low to high), and sales volume (high to low). * You can click on "**Requested sample**" to filter and view products for which you have applied for free samples. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/77d8b790695c42ec9952705726d2dd62~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/df73b94738c0449cbc267c3fcf0f03ef~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 2: Add products to the showcase** You can add products to the showcase in three ways. When adding, the system will verify if the commission rate for this collaboration is lower than any ongoing collaborations. If it is lower, the system will provide a prompt, and after confirmation, you can proceed with the addition. If the commission rate is higher for this collaboration or there are no other ongoing collaborations, the product will be automatically added successfully. | Option | Demo | | --- | --- | | Option 1: Directly click the "**Add**" button to add the product. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/839014baa1aa4dfc8f86b11158398611~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/acb79765306c4c37809f768212388311~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/044b8e903911490cb42827aa31132ef4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Click **Add** to add directly
Added successfully

Commission drop tips | | Option 2: Add from the product details page. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4e20348148cd42288f0ac5f0a66b651c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/802c89846ae64bbeb7a88e14f1357a83~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d9da452be4654457bdccfea985faa240~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Click **Add** to add directly
Added successfully
Commission drop tips | | Option 3: Click "**Add all to showcase**" to add all products at once. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/17c138b2d07040a7b6737209aa312e53~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2107b5d575fe4444980bed9989d8fd11~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7eeb823b801d4673b345718e63c4a8bf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Click **Add** to add directly

Commission drop notification | > ***Note: If the product already exists in the showcase, it will be replaced (the commission will be calculated based on the newly added product). However, the product links and commission rates in previously published short videos will not be replaced, so you need to republish the short videos.*** **Step 3: Apply for samples** In the product list, if a product has the "**Free Sample**" label, it means you can apply for a free sample of that product. Click on the product image to enter the product details page. If you are eligible to apply for a free sample of that product based on the rules, you will see "**Free Sample Request**" in a semi-floating layer. Click to proceed and select the SKU, confirm the selection, enter your address information, agree to the posting and fulfillment requirements, and complete the application. You can click "**View Details**" to track the logistics information.
> ***Note: If a creator has already applied for a sample of the same product through other channels, they cannot apply again. (The partner can see if the creator has already applied for a sample of that product.)*** ### How to apply free samples for collaborated creators? After the creator added products from your product list, if they meet the sample application requirements, TAP agencies can request the creators' consent to apply for free samples on behalf of the creator and monitor the content posting. **Step 1 Apply for the consent from the creator (only consent to apply for samples, not a binding relationship)** | **Detailed steps** | **Demo** | | --- | --- | | 1. Click the "Sample management" tab under Campaign details. Under the "Creator authorization" module, you can see creators under Unauthorized, Authorized, Pending, Removed, and Rejected.

> Only those creators who have already added products to the showcase from the TAP's product list will appear here. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/172e9bb7717b4498aa1ef7b69734e40e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 2. By clicking the "Filter" button, you can filter creators based on the category, basic information, number of followers, performance, etc., and select those who are suitable to apply for free samples. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/30ed1b40ce2546849c8a9473a1d5fdc0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 3. Click "Request authorization" on the right side of the creator to request authorization. After clicking, the creator will receive the authorization request in the TikTok app. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/64c25fe2250744e1b2e40608a2ea64e7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7ae3497a5e894aba92fbddc009b173a1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 3. The creator will find the invitation within a notification in the TikTok App Creator Center. Please confirm the shipping address (which can be changed later), and then click "Accept".

> ++Please note: After the creator confirms, the TAP can ++**++always++**++ directly help the creator apply for free sample, ++**++without a second confirmation++**++. However, the creator can revoke the consent. After the revocation, the TAP can no longer apply for free samples for them.++


* After the creator agrees, they can return to this page at any time to modify the address or revoke the authorization (without TAP's consent). | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/709452bcbf914631ae7cbb24bf142ba0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f20cfadaced244098cec8e441f5b0378~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1885a59facac4c509a0c0b7deed0bffc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ac11e109312f4df89a77c0f5223154b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1f8c2a1d39a348ada43979daaad7143f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/207ba4a2a1c64bf8beb3e32f2a3120a9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 4. Once the creator has confirmed, the TAP will see the creator under the "Authorized" list.
1. In this list you can see how many items creators have added to showcase, how many samples you can request for them, and the fulfillment rate.
2. If the TAP wants to remove the authorization of the creator to apply for samples, just click "Remove authorization". It does not require a second confirmation from the creator. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fe86d68d0be942d0b4e3b1546b7069c9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Step 2: Apply for free samples on behalf of the creator** The TAP may request a free sample on behalf of a creator only if the creator has given enough free sample budget and has not requested the same item. | **Detailed steps** | **Demo** | | --- | --- | | 1. Click "Available samples" under the Sample management tab, find the creator you want to apply for samples in the list. You can search for the corresponding creator by "product id", "product name", "creator name". Then click the "Order samples" button on the right side of the creator. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/da297d9029064080934ac420a6bfe78e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 2. In the side pop-up window, you can see the "Available to order" tab and the "Ordered" tab of the creator.
1. Under the "Available to order" tab, select the sample you want to apply for the creator, and click the "Order now" button on the right; if the button is grayed out, it may be because: ① the creator has applied for the sample, ② the creator does not have free samples quota, ③This product is out of stock.
2. Select the SKU you want to select in the pop-up window and click "order" to apply successfully. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/10ee1add3b9a4db89860517174abe2b3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ee7bd2691c2d4848be80fdc30f2c046a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 3. Under the "Ordered" tab, you can see which samples and specific SKUs the creator has applied for, and click "View logistics" to view the progress of sample logistics. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/945561448b234fe8a9e8df707ff99c62~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1a0d3007ba354888a970fb4f86969640~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Step 3: Monitor the posting status** | **Detailed steps** | **Demo** | | --- | --- | | 1. Click on "Sample Status" under the Sample management tab to view the posting status of all the creators under this campaign. (The number in the box indicates the number of samples that have not been posted)
1. The first tab (Not yet posted) displays creators and samples that have not been posted, and the second tab (Posted) displays creators and samples that have been posted. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/88d4034603064cf5b69391f0d548b6d2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ### How can partners view campaign performance? In each Campaign Details, click on the "**Performance**" tab to view the data performance of that campaign.
* **Data Overview**: Includes overall data for the entire campaign period, with metrics such as the number of creators who added products (unique), the number of creators who posted content (unique), the number of creators with sales activity (unique), the number of unique products with sales activity, est. commission base, actual commission base, estimated partner commission, and settled partner commission. > ***Note: Data updates are not in real-time, so please pay attention to the data update time displayed on the right side. Due to compliance reasons, some data may not be visible to Chinese partners and will be displayed as dashes on the page.*** * **View Data by Product**: In the list below, you can view specific data for each product. You can search and filter by product name, ID, and category. * Click "**Reset**" to reset the filtering options. * Click the "**Metrics**" button on the right to configure the metrics. The available metrics include product price, creator commission rate, partner commission rate, number of creators who added the product, number of creators who applied for samples, number of creators who posted content, number of creators with sales activity, number of payment orders, number of settlement orders, est. commission base, actual commission base, estimated partner commission, and settled partner commission. * When selecting metrics, you can click the question mark "**?**" next to the metric to view its definition and explanation. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3b30f89bc02f4af580b49308e55ceed1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2f13a10e89c4402688a0c8136d93bc47~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) > ***Note: Due to compliance reasons, some data may not be visible to Chinese partners and will be displayed as dashes on the page.*** * **View performance of each product by creator**: Click on "**View Details**" on the right side of the product in the list to view the specific performance of all creators who promoted the product (added it to their showcase). You can also search for specific creators using their usernames. * **The available data includes**: * Creator commission rate * Product collaboration validity period * Sample application status * Displaying four statuses (Not Applied, Ready for Shipment, In Transit, Received) and a "View logistics" button * You can filter by status * In the case of sample application, clicking "**View logistics**" allows you to view detailed logistics progress for the applied sample (including samples applied through other channels by the creator).
* Content fulfillment * If no content has been posted, it displays "**Not Fulfilled**." If content has been posted, it shows the number of published short videos and live broadcasts. * You can filter by: Not Fulfilled (only added to the showcase), Fulfilled * Click "**View contents**" to see the content details: * Short videos: Preview image of each short video (click to play the video), title, publication time, views, likes, payment orders, payment amount. * Live broadcasts: Preview image of each live broadcast, title, time, views, likes, payment orders, payment amount. * **Viewing earnings details** (for non-Chinese partners only): In the service provider's backend, click on the "**Finance**" - "**Earnings**" section in the left menu to view: * Overview: Shows the unpaid amount that has been paid and the amount paid for the current week/month. * Details: You can view specific details based on "**Pending Payment**", "**Paid**" or "**Payment Failed**" categories. The fields include: SKU main order number, creator information (avatar, name, etc.), product information (image, name, ID), product price, sales volume, order status (cancel, processing, completed), promotion channel (live broadcast, showcase, short video; clicking on live broadcast and short video allows viewing), partner commission rate, creator commission rate, estimated commission base, estimated partner commission, estimated creator commission, actual commission (minus refunds), actual partner commission (shown after the order's post-sales period ends), actual creator commission (shown after the order's post-sales period ends), return/refund quantity, order creation time, order confirmation time.
* **Viewing payment bills**: In the service provider's backend, click on the "**Finance**" - "**Payment Bills**" section in the left menu to view all successful payment records. It includes the payment bill ID (Reference ID), payment time to the card (Payment Time), payment amount (Payment Amount in the currency of the card), exchange rate (Exchange Rate), and original payment amount (Original Amount in the account currency). * **When can agencies get payment?** For Global Selling campaign commissions, the payment will be made 15 days after the customer has received the product. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8c9f069362c3490fa6328b3c0ba739cf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### How can creators withdraw commissions? The process for creators to withdraw commissions is the same as the regular affiliate order withdrawal process. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/49e2bab8840d465bb39e745c4548d1a8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a3de53a0bb8945f89854563701c336bb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e114cf1caf42411e9cf12ef3c6b17b7b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5c7548b66f5c4af48d07b49b294e3135~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### FAQ 1. **What type of orders can TAP agencies earn commissions from?** TAP agencies can only earn commissions from: * Orders from videos that are posted **AFTER** creators collaborate with the agency; (the link on videos posted before collaboration will not be changed to TAP link and will not pay commissions to TAP agencies.) * Orders from creators' showcase and live that are paid after creators collaborate with the agency.

detail.title: Linking your Affiliate profile to TikTok Business Account
detail.content:
# Overview
TikTok profile linking for TikTok Shop agency partners is a new feature that connects your TikTok business profile to your agency account. It helps build your credibility and makes recruiting creators easier. By linking your profile, you can showcase your work directly on TikTok, helping creators trust your agency more.
Here are the key benefits:

1. Build Credibility: Show your work and partnerships on TikTok, increasing trust with creators.
2. Easier Recruitment: Stand out to top creators and simplify the process of connecting with them.
3. Better Insights: Use TikTok's marketing tools to understand what works and improve your creator strategies.

# How to Link Your Profile
## Step 1: Choose an entry point to link your TikTok account.
### Entry Point 1: Your Profile
Login to your TTSPC -> My Account->Profile
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/27c8883beece40baa7d124a8e20d8d20~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eac6c9b63bd243ad89d5d2520ebf64ff~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
### Entry Point 2: Inviting Creator
Login to your TTSPC->Creator Management->Find Creators
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bac16264184149519a653de41142115a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
### Entry Point 3: Adding New Creator
Login to your TTSPC - > Creator Management -> Manage Partnerships-> Invite a new creator for binding
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/86de1f1d747444dca2f335f3027531c4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
### **Entry point 4: Campaign Creation**
Login to your TTSPC -> Partner Campaigns -> My campaigns -> Create a new campaign
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/194db6f955434a7da5760879ade29bf4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
After choosing a starting point, follow these remaining steps to link your account:
## Step 2: Generate QR code to link with Agency's TT Account
If you do not have a TT account, you can go through the sign up flow. If you do have a TT account, proceed to "Get started"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d67a123a03fd44b1bd5f9f4ce33a2f94~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e563f76d894e49038b7311a306fdb399~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
The QR code will automatically generated. There are linking requirements for the TT official account :

* Account has to be 18 years old
* Active with no violation history
* Can't be a registered business account, you will have to switch back to a normal TT account in order to perform the linkage task
* Can't linked with another agency or creator network

## Step 3: Login your TT Account to the scan QR code
Navigate to Settings -> Select My QR Code -> Use the scanner to scan the QR code in TTSPC
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6a1cb46e21da4c56a1177cb5f856ecc5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bf1e5e8bc46348d4a66190f3eb518ac7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9175672626e74c12983a6bdba1757ff3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Confirm Linking
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3eac8a183eec4e1dab5c48b83e089b22~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9007dc0ec65f4f80b1f5384803879b75~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 4: Your display label on your TT account
If you are both a CAP and a TAP, it will display as Creator Agency Partner on your TTS account
If you are only a TAP partner, it will display as TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner on your TT account
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ccc48161bf1e41ca9c11ad7212fe96f2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Frequently Asked Questions
## **How do I switch back to a normal TT account?**
Step 1: Navigate to settings and privacy->Account->Switch to Personal Account-> Switch anyway
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f5d23060cffb43fe97f1fdeb2d2ac32a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/aa962e3d598148d6bfb8c382a060ea04~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/34d56031959f47d5bd40efd7494fc5cf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1ba0340a91f24ba68c6d77eb5c805fb0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6b7c6d02b9d84655b7decd635fc49eb3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## **Where does it appear once I've linked my TT account?**
On the Creator side, you have the option to attach your TT profile during the invite creator flow or the add new creator flow by selecting the checkbox
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8445242fbef549f08fc2c2923ab8f95f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6d986607a115453ea63d6d1ccf611817~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
When creators receive your invite, they will be able to view your TT profile
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5de9791b807143dda5c915747c1f9ba3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/12b258511bdb4968ad4abe8a3b44e620~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
On the seller side, you have the option to attach your TT profile during the campaign creation flow
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a8b89c3832ed4f1eaf298bae3ebf2a6f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Seller will be able to see your TT profile under Campaign details
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1cb8ac07b1634ce7beb9dec5cea5ced0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: Partner Campaign- Ads Commission
detail.content:
# Key Mechanisms Partner Campaigns Ads Commission Dual Attribution is a new update for TikTok Shop Partner (TSP) . This enables sellers to set a campaign total **shop ads commission rate** for products in partner campaigns, while automatically distributing commissions between partners and creators based on attribution results. Here's the key mechanisms in Affiliate partner Shop Ads. * Currently, the affiliate partner Shop Ads function is available in the US region. * Sellers can set the rates in new or ongoing campaigns from Agency campaigns, Seller campaigns and Tiktok Shop Exclusive campaigns. The rate cannot be changed after setup. * Only when sellers set the Shop Ads commission rate for products in campaigns, can partners see this rate in Campaigns and Product pools in Partner center. * If sellers set the Shop Ads commission rate for products, when a partner sets the affiliate commission rate, the ads commission distribution ratio between the partner and the creator is the same as that of the affiliate by default. The system calculates and automatically displays the ratio accurately to two decimal places. * If the seller does not set the TAP campaign ads commission rate and runs ads, the advertising orders will be settled according to the TAP campaign affiliate commission rate. * Attribution logic for affiliate and ads commission: Essentially the same as open collaboration. In summary, if the affiliate and ads attribution are to the same creator, the settlement will be based on the ads commission rate; in other cases, it will be settled based on the affiliate commission rate. # Step by Step guide ## Check the shop ads commission rate of partner campaigns in TTSPC **On Partner Campaign page** Through **"My campaigns" - "Campaign info"** and **"Seller campaigns" - " Campaign performance"**, partners can view comparison information for total standard commission rate and total shop ads commission rate.
"Seller campaigns" - " Campaign performance"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/218b5d8eae43497fbaeda166290f949a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
"Seller campaigns" - " Campaign performance"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/600de5d8484147f892ad5d7b34f4f493~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
**On Products Management page** * Through "**High opportunity product pool**" , partners can also view Shop Ads commission rate, via cursor, select button or filter.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5dee4519a69e44939a15899d8cd62a67~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ee5670ab48df4aae93c78490f470ee53~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
* Through "Selected products", partners can also view comparison information for total standard commission rate and total shop ads commission rate ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8c72f577777f40928f0b587cbf67842b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) *Select product in* *High* *opportunity pools*
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a154e43ec15a45948a10e71c80bf91c4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d02ae03321274db1a004731d34a66fec~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Set affiliate commission rate and Shop Ads commission rate distribution ratio between the creators and partner **Check the default commission distribution ratio** * When adding products to the Product list in the above Campaign products and Selected products, when setting the shop ads commission rate for the creator, the default ads commission ratio for the partner and the creator are displayed respectively.
enter "Create a product list"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2e1a5d6d8a5849e9aaf33843aec08a6f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Check in "Create a product list"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1bf4204539ca4f1782e2de4f0abab9cc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
* When sharing the product link in the above campaign products and selected products, when setting the commission rate for the creator, the default shop ads commission ratio for the partner and the creator are displayed respectively.
Click 'Copy link' in Selected products - product list
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9514f249b06b47d694812a8a909a3399~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Click 'Share' in product lists of Campaign details in Seller campaigns and My campaigns
## Check the shop ads commission cost in affiliate order Partners (Seller Service - Product Distribution) can view itself & creator's shop ads commission cost in **affiliate order.** For example, one **** seller provided 25% shop ads commission rate to partners, where partners got 5%, creator got 20%. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c7b231a20e89435187e11cbeb6619528~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Note：* *Creator Service Partner (MCN) view shop ads commission cost in* ***affiliate order,*** *and final earnings after revenue sharing. For example, Creator gets 20% shop ads commission, but shares 50% with partners.*

📌 **This feature is only available for**[ ](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/YVSSdFlS4olNfdxSPjecs8kYnOg)TAP **partners on TTSPC.** ## Affiliate Partner Introduction ### **What is Affiliate Partner ？** Affiliate partner can connect scalable creators with merchants/supply chains to help both parties improve efficiency and optimize creator level up. Affiliate Partner is Identified as **" Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up"** category on TTSPC ### **What's the benefits of Affiliate Partner？** 1. You can use it as a tool for product-based collaborations with sellers and creators. A replacement for offline collaboration/ target plan with full visibility on operational workflow of the collaboration for product/seller-based collaboration. 2. You can effectively reach a large number of sellers and product resources through campaigns, helping you quickly and quickly discover new products and popular products. 3. A more flexible way of cooperating with creators, you can generate exclusive product links and distribute them to a large number of creators, helping you to earn commissions according to the sales of all products sold by creator. ## Partner Settle in guide Entrance：[https://partner.tiktokshop.com/](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/) Affiliate partner will be open to register in the following markets： For local Partner: Support partners located and service in **Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore and Vietnam.** **Please** choose "Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up" **on the category selection page** ### Documents to be prepared before settling in: [Partner self-onboard guide](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/RHwGdhlRCoThRwxsRXwch0Jdnlg?from=from_copylink) If you already have an Affiliate Partner role on[ TikTok shop partner platform](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/partner/auth/welcome), you can log in with your previous accounts and refer to [Affiliate Partner Migration playbook](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/UZhzdEsxio708Zx03LVc8SDrnCg?from=from_copylink) ### Settle in process **Case 1 If you do not have a TikTok Partner Center account, please follow the**[ Partner self-onboard guide ](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/RHwGdhlRCoThRwxsRXwch0Jdnlg?from=from_copylink)**. Please** choose "Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up" **on the category selection page** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9b56ad4d2f9c426db40a287749677c38~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Case 2 If you have a TikTok Partner Center account but without "**Seller and Scalable Creator Match- up **"category certification, you can add a category application** You can add **"**Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up " category through Profile➤my category&market➤Add category&market After clicking Submit, you need to supplement the Affiliate Partner information (including :**Company information &Contact information, and Proof of partner operating capability)** refer to [TikTok Shop Partner Center Guide](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/doxcnpxGEdlf0MHDcH7N88ZBhkc?from=from_copylink) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8ac114c7b2df40f5829bc1f9288ded32~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9578c8ed606e44adaaf1194df66e764d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Case 3 If you** already have Affiliate Partner accounts on [TikTok partner platform](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/partner/partner-creator/link?tab=all) You can log in with your existing account on [TikTok partner platform](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/partner/partner-creator/link?tab=all) with Email/ Phone number and password. After logging in, you will have the certification of **"**Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up**"** category automatically. ## **Introduction of product features** ### 1.Active account and links bank account #### Activate Account If you have already activated your account previously, i.e. on any other service category on TTSPC, you can skip this step. Your account will be activated automatically. You can go to [finance]-[payment account] to active account for each category. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cecc7e38b4f444bdb9c654b81c89d4fd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2ed3f1df44b34907a2ce56b54c6631ef~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) After clicking active account,you can check the results(including: active/failed/pending)
#### **Link bank account (SEA)** **After active account, you need to link bank account(s).**
Please provide the relevant information about the bank card . Click continue after completion Note：The bank name of the bank card must be consistent with the entity name of the partner ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3fc1799b7c9f4cfcb4ed77747dc6fc20~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0f13c0a95cb7485ba650e514de0fec41~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) You can check the link bank information and change account after successfully linking. **How to change account？** After clicking**[Change account]**, you can click **manage** and choose a bank account to set primary. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/09909d5fdc3946a2971194b766046628~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b7f28be3a0fa4bea850e70c5bacea526~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### **Link bank account (UK)**
* After the account has been activated successfully, users could click ‘Link bank account’ and it will redirect to PIPO's cashier for adding payout method. * Users could click Bank Transfer to add a new bank account. The minimum payment amount is 1 GBP and maximum is 250,000 GBP. * Add payout information: * E-mail address：type with own e-mail address * Routing Number: 9-digit numbers provided by bank. * Accounting Number: 3-17 digit bank account number. * Account type: Saving account/Checking account. * Billing address: could be autofilled when click 'same as business registered address' or entered independently. * Confirm the bank account information. * Receive OTP at the e-mail address and complete OTP process. * Bank accounts will be linked and shown as masked account in payment method. ### 2.Partner Collaboration #### Partner ##### Scenario 1: Create Partner Collaboration Partner creates collaboration, and reporting items through **[TTSPC] ➤[Creator Matchmaking] ➤ [Create collaboration]**.
* Please refer to Collaboration Information instructions and fill in the collaboration information，After checking, click [Submit] to go to the collaboration list. * **After submiting the collaboration, please wait sellers registration or approve product:** sellers select the campaign from campaign marketplace on seller center, register for products, and define the product commission rate (commission should be a package); | | File | Explanations & Requirements | Screenshot | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Basic Information

Campaign performance page | #### #### Creator ##### Scenario: Creator adds products **Support adding affiliate partner products through Product List Link** Once creators have received product list link(s) from agencies, they can start adding products. There are 2 ways to add products: 1. **Adding single products**:Simply tap "Add" 2. **Adding all products:** Simply select "Add all to showcase" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f82494fa20784f2ca94f50ee4656ad45~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) After adding product to showcase, creator can sell products through live stream /short video/showcase to sell products ## [IMPT] Commission Calculation Logic There are three partnership models and each has its own commission calculation logic. Below are illustrations of how they operate. 1. **Affiliate Partners** > Partnership with Non-binding creators. Commission Calculation: All commission rates of products will be calculated based on the commission split setup during link creation by the agency before sharing it with creators 2. **Agencies functioning as both Creator Management Agency (MCN/CAP) and Affiliate Partners (TAP)** > In this scenario, creators are bound with a MCN/CAP Agency, and add Campaign Product links from the same agency who also works as a TAP partner to their showcases. Commission calculation: The agency takes both the TAP commission from Campaign Commission, as well as the CAP/MCN commission based on the Commission Sharing Agreement signed with the binding Creators. > What this means: If a creator has a commission sharing relationship with MCN/CAP Agency, the commission for the creator will be shared with MCN/CAP Agency based on the commission sharing rate with MCN/CAP Agency. > *For example: If a* *Seller* *sets a total commission of 20% for a product, dividing it as 10% for the affiliate partner (as a TAP Agency) and 10% for the Creator, and the Creator has a 50% commission-sharing arrangement signed with the same affiliate partner (as a MCN/CAP Agency), the Creator will effectively receive 5% commission.* ### **3.Check Earnings and payment** How can I view the commission and payments after the campaign? Please refer to the following process: **Click Finance- Earnings,you can enter the Earnings page to view the detailed data of the orders** | workflow | Screen shot | | --- | --- | | You can check the overview of the orders, including paid orders and not paid orders(orders have not yet been completed)

Support export order data. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1ee29f8288634a039ed7d99953c82a1a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b40b1c8f367f44b48ada7e1ac74d7544~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### 4.Creator marketplace #### Introduction to creator marketplace creator marketplace will support you viewing the list of creators and creators' information . We support you contacting creators through contact information or sending an invitation to creators Note: creator marketplace is only available for qualified partners, if you have no permission to see creator marketplace, please contact your account manager. #### Step 1 Check the creator list **Click TikTok Shop Partner → Find creator→ Creator Marketplace to check creator marketplace** support the following functions: 1. Search for creator: Search by username/nickname 2. Filtering : Supports filtering by creator's e-commerce categories, followers etc. 3. Set sorting: support sorting by GMV/followers/video release magnitude/average short video playback times What type of creator can be seen on creator marketplace？ ✅ creators who have e-commerce permissions ✅ the creator who were bound by other MCNs ❌ the creator who were official or marketing accounts
If you have **"creator management"** category at the same time, you can switch roles on page to use the creator 's marketplace. After switching roles, the current invitation and application will belong to the current identity. #### Step 2 Creator details page On the creator details page , you can view the detailed information of creators, including: basic information, core data, fan portraits (gender/age), interactive trends ( livestream/videos), and top 3 viewed e-commerce videos .
#### Step 3 Contact and Invite creator #### （1）Check the contact info Click contact on the creator card or the creator details page to get the contact information (including WhatsApp and Email etc)
#### （2）Invite Creator After clicking the invite button, you can send an invitation to the creator with one click, and you can fill in the invitation message (no more than 500 words) and contact information (at least one type contact), After confirming the information, you can click [Send Invitation]. 1. **Invitation message:** Filling in the Invitation Message to show the advantages of the Affiliate Partner will help improve the efficiency of finding products. 2. **information check:** The basic information of the Affiliate Partner will be synchronized to the creator 's side . We suggest Affiliate Partner check the information before inviting creators. > *How to check the information？ > TikTok partner → profile → company information ，you can also click [check information] on the invite creator page to jump directly to the company information page for checking.If there is inaccurate information, you can report to your operator（account manager） to deliver the modification requirement 3. **Contact information:** The contact information that has been filled in automatically based on the existing info provided during registration, you can check and modify if needed. 4. **Invitation limitation:** 1. **Affiliate Partners are allowed to send invitations to a maximum of 100 creators per day, and the same creator can only be sent once within 7 days** *if you have both Affiliate Partner and MCN ： 1. **Invitation limitation:** the total maximum invitation per day is 100, and the same creator can only be sent once within 7 days by both categories. 2. You can choose invitation intention when sending invitation to creators * For MCN: please choose "establish long-term linking relationship with creators" * For affiliate partner： please choose "improve the efficiency of product distribution" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/edae10f35a55418e9194925bd6edb41c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f495c2d1cc604c3aa6eb3a1bb1bb5794~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### （3）Creator receive invitation After the Affiliate partner sending the invitation, the creator is able to check this invitation in the TikTok Shop Inbox—notification, which mainly includes following information: 1. The invitation message filled in by Affiliate partner 2. Affiliate partner existing Information:company name, service, category, introduction, address Those creators who are interested in the Affiliate partner can click "I'm interested" button to get the contact information.
#### Step 4 Check Invitation history Entrance: **TikTok Shop Partner Portal → Find creator→ Invitation history** The historical invitation interface will display all the creators who have been sent invitations by MCN . We support the following functions: 1. Search for creator: Search by username/nickname 2. Filter function: Set the start and end time to filter the invitations within the time period 3. View invitation: View the latest invitation information (including invitation information and contact information) through viewing details 4. Resend invitation: support send an invitation to the creator again within one click ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c3456b9dac804171b30cab9f056e6fde~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/473ae65be91446d6a87c237fc18671d7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Note： You can switch the invitation intention if you have both MCN（creator management）and affiliate partner（Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up）role * Link creator ：MCN role * Product distribution：affiliate partner role You can switch markets if you are a cross-border partner and have multiple country certification, after switching the market, you can check the related invitation history.
## FAQ Q：if the product registered by the seller has an ongoing promotion (ex. flash sale, etc), will the buyer that buys via the affiliate partner product campaign get the promotion as well? A：yes, campaign is not conflict with ongoing promotion Q：Could seller registers the same product to 2 different campaigns? A：yes, Sellers can register the same product for different campaigns. Q：If the campaign period is over,what happens to the video that the creator created? A： it won't affect the video, the product link will be invalid and would not generate sales. Q：Will seller be able to contact creator directly and check creator's data? A：seller will not able to check creator's data and contact information on seller center. Q：could seller modify the commission rate during the campaign period？ A：no,sellers are not able to modify the commission rate during campaign period Q:How can i check the contact information of sellers？ You can hover on the profile icon to check the contact information of sellers. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0ca824304afb46b88b3d751418b3264c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Q：If a seller registers the same product to 2 different campaigns, and then both Affiliate Partners share each of their links to the same creator, what will happen? A：Creator can choose the most appropriate product with preferential commission.(If commission rate of this new link is higher than previous link, the product will be successfully added,if commission rate of this new link is lower than previous link,there will a notification for creator to double check.) Q: Could creator replace the product link with Affiliate open or target plan during the campaign period? A. During the campaign period, the sales generated by affiliate partner product link will be calculated as commission based. Creator will not be able to be deleted and replaced by open plan until the link expires. For example, if the creator adds an open or target plan product and deletes the product links of affiliate partners, they will still add the commission rate of affiliate partners and can't be replaced. Q: What is the threshold of payments? What happens if the withdrawal amount does not meet the required threshold ? A: The threshold of payments is different based on region. Please refer to the following instructions. It will remain unpaid until it meets the required threshold . > CB：1.00USD > ID:10000DR > TH: none > MY:0.01 MYR > VN:10000 VND > PHP:0.01 PHP **Q：How long will I receive the commission payment?** * Indonesia：The order is calculated from the date of delivery, and the payment will be settled one day after the end of 6 days after the sale (the payment will be made on the 7 day after delivery). * Malaysia: The order is calculated from the date of delivery, and the payment will be settled one day after the end of 6 days after the sale (the payment will be made on the 7 day after delivery). * Thailand: The order is calculated from the date of delivery, and the payment will be settled one day after the end of the 7-day post-sales period ( the payment will be made on the 8 day after delivery). * Vietnam: The date of delivery of the order is calculated, and the payment will be settled one day after the end of 6 days after the sale ( the payment will be made on the 7 day after delivery). * Philippines: The order is calculated from the date of delivery, and the payment will be settled one day after the end of 6 days after the sale (the payment will be made on the 7 day after delivery). ***In special circumstances, the settlement cycle may be extended, and we will notify you and complete the payment as soon as possible.* Q: Can Affiliate partner link with multiple bank accounts? Affiliate partner can only link to one bank account and the name of the bank card must be consistent with the entity name of the partner. Q:How does the affiliate partner withdraw their earnings to the bank account that they already linked ? A：After the order is paid successfully and meets the threshold of payment, commission will automatically withdraw to partners linked bank account. Q: How to settle the Affiliate Partner commission? A: it will be based on the commission rate set by sellers,if seller sets 15%for affiliate partner,10%for creator. Then the affiliate partner will get 15% of sales generated by product link,creator will get 10%*sales. note:if creator has commission sharing relationship with MCN,the commission of creator will be shared with MCN based on the commission sharing rate with MCN. eg.++ If seller sets 20% commission in total, set 10% for affiliate partner and 10% for creator, if creator has commission sharing relationship with partner and the commission rate is 50%，then the creator will get 5% commission.++
Q: for creator, how to check if my commission is shared by MCN？ A：if creator is not bound with MCN, on the order page, there will be affiliate partner name, if creator has commission sharing relationship with MCN, there will be a note on besides of commission：**shared with partner** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e32c2aec913f40669321b2ec29b86c9b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Q：what could I do if there are failed payments？ A：you can click "request payment" to apply for payment. You can check the results after clicking. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/81f4127994354e3894d4bc4a19c30fb3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2544bc98050f4bbda95a166d5a569dd7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Q: Why is the commission for some of the products on the Finance page zero even though we have fee management setup, which is more than zero? A: Creators have used your campaign links for these product(s). This means that only the commission that you have indicated before generating the link for your creators will prevail. You may check the commission in the "Affiliate Partner" page on the Earnings tab.

detail.content:
As a TikTok Affiliate Program (TAP) agency, finding products that are likely to perform well across different campaign types takes time. The High opportunity product pool helps solve this problem. ## What It Is The High opportunity product pool is an aggregator tool that brings together products with strong sales and commission potential from all campaign types - Seller, Agency, Exclusive TikTok shop, and more. ## Key Features and Benefits 1. **Find Products That Perform**: Access carefully selected products from all your campaigns in one tab. Instead of searching through multiple campaign types separately, you'll spot promising products quickly. 2. **Choose Products With Confidence**: See products from different campaigns side-by-side and easily identify ones with attractive commission rates. Add them to your campaigns with just a few clicks. 3. **Run Better Campaigns**: Focus on products chosen for their performance potential. Add them to your campaigns easily and spend less time searching for good options. 4. **Work Well with Creators**: Give products to creators and set their commission rates in one place. Create and share product lists directly through the platform instead of sending individual links from different campaign types. ## How it works **Step 1:** If you already have a TikTok Shop Partner Center account, navigate to Product Management and select high opportunity products. You will be able to search for products by name/id/shopname/shopcode/campaign name/campaign id. And it supports batch search by Product id.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d074efb18f814328bc677443f860f099~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 2:** Use the advanced filters for more granular results. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b7b7de1290264a8195ff22a7930a2235~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 3:** A product could belong to multiple campaigns, choose the campaign you would like to join and click "Select"
> How to view Removed Products & Status? > **Step 4:** Once you have selected the product and joined the campaign, the product will appear under Selected Products and you can set your commission ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/40772885cf05414c8decb9fd8a3f4464~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/dd0dd143b14a48949eeaa79a97296605~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 5:** You can create a product list by selecting multiple products and copying the link and sending it to creators ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/99ccf715689645f0bdb5219387ccf017~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1b22dfe9d9e84a8182e874a187750c31~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Creator's Experience:** If you send the creator a product list, they will see a list of products. If you send them just one product, they will see that single product. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e1abe350426a4c658aa6541cbfaefa5c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/02121d5cf4e84df29f383ddfec012a76~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Q&A ### How to view Removed Products & Status? 1. When go to the Product Pool page, I can see products that have been removed. 1. Product Unavailable in All Campaigns: Then its status is shown as “Unavailable” directly on the list. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3fbb58d9a0304b70962524a53b5b7b10~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. detail.content:
# Overview Agencies can now request samples on behalf of their linked creators for Partner Campaigns. Once an agency gets creator authorization, they can review the number of samples a seller has allocated for an SKU and determine which creator they want to share that sample with to create a streamlined experience in product. # How to Request Samples ## Agency Experience **Step 1**: Navigate to [TikTok Shop Partner Center](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/account/login?) and log in with your credentials. **Step 2:** Under the "**Partner Campaigns**" section, select "**View Details**" for the campaign you would like to request samples for.
**Step 3**: Navigate to the "**Sample Management**" tab and select "**Creator Authorization**" where you are able to see a list of creators and their current authorization status. Before you can request samples for a creator, a creator must first agree to your authorization request to let you pass along their preferred address to sellers to receive a sample. **Sample Status:** **Unauthorized**: You have not requested authorization from the creator yet **Pending**: The creator has not responded to your request **Authorized**: The creator has responded and agreed to your authorization request **Ended**: The creator was previously authorized **Rejected**: The creator rejected the previous authorization request ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2a1c6d5226c14a899a6489f494d5495b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Note**: In order for a creator to be eligible and show up on the Creator Authorization tab, they must add a product from the Partner Campaign to their product showcase. **Step 4**: You can individually request authorization from a creator by selecting the "**Request Authorization**" to the right of their name under the "**Action**" column. If you would like to bulk request authorization for creators, make sure to select all of the creators first by clicking the box to the left of their name and then select the "**Request Authorization**" button at the top of the creator list.
**Step 5**: After a creator approves your authorization request, you can now request samples on their behalf. Select the "**Available Sample**" tab to see a list of creators that you can request samples for. Then select "**Order Samples**" for the specific creator you would like to order samples for.
If you would like to filter the creator list, you can do so using the "**Filter**" option and selecting the relevant fields you would like to filter by. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5fa3ce427c8b4dd19969ac0c99a05aef~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 6**: You will now be able to see what samples this creator is eligible for. Under the "**Available Sample**" section, you will see the total available samples for this product. Once you know which sample, you would like to order, select "**Order**" under the "**Action**" column. If the "**Available Sample**" is 0, you will not be able to order any additional samples for this product on behalf of the creator. This is because of one of the reasons below: 1. The seller listed product is out of stock 2. You have run out of available samples to share with creators. However, you can reach out to the seller to see if they are willing to update the number of samples available for this campaign. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0380260f470b4670bf7abcced875bc83~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 7**: Confirm the product details and select "**Order**". You will see a confirmation once you have successfully ordered a sample and it will be shipped directly to the creator. | Place order | Success | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6fb17a4b31c04b35b22fdded04b404b7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b2687350991d448783d89f195b6316d6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ## Creator Experience **Creator Authorization Request** When an agency requests authorization from a creator, the creator will receive a notification. The creator will then be able to see the "**Authorization Request**" details and decide if they want to accept or decline the request. If the creator wants to accept the request, they will need to provide their preferred shipping address and then select "**Accept**". If the creator wants to stop being eligible to receive samples on behalf of an agency, they can view the authorization details and select "**End this authorization**". | Notification for the creator | Details about the authorization request | Input the shipping address | End this authorization | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/796be8eab2c942379bf7ceac93fe3b13~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d26a77674c2c4dc0b8099fe40f9b9dcd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/049a3701451445febded909ef03e2fb3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/28344ea8ae2944f982cd29b156f4e2c2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | If a creator wants to update their default sample address, they will need to navigate to the original "**Sample Authorization Request**" and tap on the shipping address. From there, they can select "**Edit**" to change their shipping information. After they have updated their shipping information, they can then choose to "**Use For This Agency Only**" or "**Use For All Agencies**" in the event that they have multiple authorizations with different agencies. | Sample Authorization Request | Edit | Authorization with agencies | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4b15243f9cfd4d01a5c54c0438109835~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/089d9dfb57be42b3bf484dadc210c032~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fe63b64e0f1e485d83bede4bbec83526~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Agency Ordered a Sample for a Creator** When an agency orders a sample on behalf of a creator, the creator will be able to review the order details. Once the sample arrives, the creator will be able to review the sample details and also encourage the creator to post a Video or LIVE with the sample link. | View all samples | Samples in progress | Pending content | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/215f2f090e67454f87a112e722dceb5a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1fd6d49a1a954191a17da31695747ef6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/089d8aec0a9441aeb02ec8c52ae6f23b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | # How to track Existing Sample Requests ## Agency Experience **Step 1**: Navigate to [TikTok Shop Partner Center](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/account/login?) and login with your credentials. **Step 2:** Under the "**Partner Campaigns**" section, select "**View Details**" for the campaign you would like to review existing samples requests for.
**Step 3**: Navigate to the "**Sample Management**" tab and select "**Sample Tracking**" where you are able to see a list of creators and their sample status. **Sample Status** **Ready to Ship** - Sample is waiting to be picked up by the carrier. **Shipped** - Sample is currently being shipped to the creator. **Delivered** - Sample has been delivered to the creator. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1b0d570fc05446a3abed025199d7ef11~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 4**: Under the "**Ordered Samples**" section, you can see a list of creators who have "**Not Yet Posted**" and "**Posted**". Under the "**Posted**" tab, you can get a quick view if the creator posted a Video or LIVE under the "**Content**" column. detail.title: [User guide] TAP Profile displayed to Creators
detail.content:
The agency profile will display key information and data, allowing both existing and potential creators to evaluate and review your collaboration. This will be featured across various sections of the TikTok Shop App for creators. * The profile will appear across multiple entry points, including the linking page, IM, and TAP product list, to enhance the agencies' credibility and increase acceptance of binding agreements. * Main process: 1. TAP/CAP upload the basic info and authorize TikTok Shop sharing operation data in TTSPC(TikTok Shop Partner Center) 2. Creator can browse and send messages to TAP/CAP in EC center(TikTok Shop Creator Center)
## Benefit With this feature, creators can now assess the suitability of an MCN/TAP partner by reviewing details such as the categories and products they promote, as well as key performance metrics like data and commission rates. This will help to: 1. Strengthen trust in MCN/TAP partners, as the data is directly pulled from the platform. 2. Improve matchmaking by empowering creators to evaluate partners using relevant data, while aligning with their specific needs.
