detail.title: TAP Data Overview
detail.content:
## High level overview TikTok Affiliate Partners need the ability to monitor and analyze the performance of their campaigns to improve their collaboration with creators, so they can continue to improve operations and drive GMV goals. This phase of the TAP Data overview feature is intended to provide TAP agencies with their core business performance, creator diagnosis with respect to high-potential and attention-needing Creators, and top rankings across important business metrics for their agencies. The functionality aims to give Affiliate Partners the right set of summary and drilldown data easily and in a customizable manner. ## Feature value proposition 1. **Overview of core business metrics as well as trend comparisons between the same** that allows for drill-down looks into the core data related to revenue, creator and content performance 2. **Creator performance diagnostics** that denotes key collaborated creators who need attention or have high-potential. 3. **Access top performing campaigns, creators, sellers and content** that allows for prioritization of resources as well as drilldown views and export capabilities of the same ## Salient use cases The following use cases will be the most relevant only for TAP agencies in performing continuing Affiliate Creator management and operations ### Use Case 1: I want to get an overview and understand trends across my Affiliate Partner (TAP) business performance * View core performance metrics for your affiliate partner (TAP) performance over the selected time frame * The list of metrics include * Revenue * Estimated commissions * Estimated commissions base * Orders (SKUs) * View and compare trends across these core data metrics for the selected time period (more details in "Feature walkthrough" section below) * View available tooltips next to each metric for a definition and significance of the metric itself ### Use Case 2: Among all creators who have generated sales in my campaigns, who should we follow up on issues and who have some potential? * This diagnosis scope includes creators who have made sales in the current and previous period. "Attention" creators have been selected from the top 50% of revenue generators but whose contributions have dropped recently. "Potential" creators are medium-sized and longtail creators who have seen an increase in contribution to your agency’s revenue. * The diagnosis is considered over the selected date rage. For each of the "Attention" and "Potential" creators, users can click to view and export the creator handle name and the attention/potential category like low/high content created, number of products added, Video Views. ### Use Case 3: I want an overview on metrics related to Creators and contents along with trends for the same * In addition to core data metrics, users will have the option to view aggregate metrics related to Creators data and content data over the selected time frame * Users can toggle between the available "Creators" and "Content" tabs to view each of these metric sets * Similar to core data section, users can choose to view trends across pairs of these metrics in each tab, allowing for comparison across trends to view underlying drivers of metric movement (more details in "Feature walkthrough" section below) ### Use Case 4: I want to easily access and identify top performing campaigns, content, creators and collaborated sellers along with associated information * In order to enable TAP users, to understand the leading contributors to their business goals, this section will allow them to easily navigate aspects related to campaign, content, creator and other data attributes * At this time, the top ranking list will include top 20 of the leading campaigns, creators, products, collaborated sellers and videos. * For each of these top ranking lists, users will not only be able to rank and identify by GMV but also toggle the rankings based on estimated commissions, orders completed by orders (SKU orders) and top views (more details in "Feature walkthrough" section below) * For each of the ranking outputs, users can export the comprehensive data for rankings lists for offline analysis and viewing. * Further, users can also click 'View all' to view the entire list in Custom Report for TAP. ## Access and data scope The feature will be available to all TAP users registered in their particular country. Data for all active Affiliate Creators within that particular country ***Note #1***: If a TAP agency is registered across multiple countries, they will have to toggle and select a particular country of operation to be able to view data for that country at a time. At the present moment, agencies cannot view data for multiple countries aggregated at the same time ***Note #2***: If an agency is registered as a CAP and TAP, they will have to toggle and select a particular partner type to view the data for a specific country at a time. ***Data timeline note*: **It is to be noted that due to Data Infrastructure restrictions, data in this module will be limited to ++Calendar Year 2024 and beyond++. ## Overall feature interface Presented below is the interface for this functionality in TTSPC for TAP. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b8f5628e30524981aa52a2843c12101d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Entrance TAPs can navigate to the functionality within TTSPC by navigating to **Analytics > Overview** They can then select the particular country (if they are registered as TAP in multiple countries) to view that country's particular affiliate creator data. No further action is needed if the agency is only registered as TAP in only one country as that will be selected by default ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5b3442c27a194352a419546211c522c6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Feature walkthrough ### Date filter | Functionality/Component | UI interface | Key functionalities/capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | Date range selection | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fccfc809c1da40218e123357d6e9d5bc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | Users, upon logging into the interface, will have the option to select a date range against which to view TAP campaign data.
**Note**: By default, the last 7 days will be selected by default. All data in 2024 will be available.
All following data elements will have data against the selected date range and any exceptions to that will be pointed out explicitly in the respective section of the "Feature walkthrough" | ### Core data | Functionality/Component | UI interface | Key functionalities/capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | Core data metrics | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3e8bfb84b6b5454083ad0533805c7b14~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. The core data metrics will display the most critical GMV/product metrics related to the TAP's affiliate performance
2. Each metric will have the aggregate value within the selected date period
3. Additionally, users will also be able to see the % deviation of the metric (color coded to easily understand the deviation trend) over the selected date range. | | Core data metrics comparison | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4f04eabb239547de80f34afe980e8647~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. Additionally, users can toggle the "Compare trends" radio button at the top right of the core data card to visualize trends in the data for selected range.
2. Users can select two metrics, at a time, and the trends of these two selected metrics will be displayed simultaneously over the selected date range.
3. The goal of the trend comparison is to allow finding correlations between pairs of metrics as well individually analyze these salient trends | ### GMV performance diagnostics | Functionality/Component | UI interface | Key functionalities/capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | GMV performance diagnostics overview | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/88c274dc1d11455c91818482fd757232~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| The goal of the diagnostic section is to provide TAPs with more action-oriented prescriptive insights so that they may be able to easily identify
Broadly, diagnostics will be classified as either a

1. Potential creator diagnostics are intended to provide a summary of key GMV performance fluctuations within the TAP's collaborated Creator set and pinpoint the main drivers of said fluctuation.
2. Attention creator diagnostics are intended to alert TAP partners of followup attention needed when their top 50% creators have some GMV decrease. | | Creator performance diagnostics deep-dive | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eff4caaaaf19456d968a41efdfd73a6e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

2. Accompanying data at the Creator level, will be tags for the particular diagnostic category classification for each individual Creator. These category tags are intended to help TAPs easily identify why a particular Creator is linked with attention or potential. A few representative diagnosis categories include:
* Product Added to Showcase, Content created
* Video Views/ Video Anchor Show Rate / Video Product CTR/ Video C_O, Video AOV
* Live Views/ Live Product CTR/ Live C_O/ Live AOV | ### Creator/content data metrics | Functionality/Component | UI interface | Key functionalities/capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | Creator data metrics | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8cfc6b2f69054f4d863c9581481f96a5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. Users can view the most salient data metrics related to their collaborated Affiliate Creators within this section
2. Each metric will have the aggregate value within the selected date period
3. Additionally, users will also be able to see the % deviation of the metric (color coded to easily understand the deviation trend) over the last 7 days | | Creator data metrics trends | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/00ff5691a75d47e781c9747b45f01aee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. Additionally, users can toggle the "Compare trends" radio button at the top right of the creator card to visualize trends in the data for the selected date filter range.
2. Users can select two metrics, at a time, and the trends of these two selected metrics will be displayed simultaneously over the last 7 days
3. The goal of the trend comparison is to allow finding correlations between pairs of metrics as well individually analyze these salient trends | | Content data metrics | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/81ae71d976684331b3f7425b75b7d181~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. Users can view the most salient data metrics related to the content posted by their collaborated Affiliate Creators within this section
2. Each metric will have the aggregate value within the selected date period
3. Additionally, users will also be able to see the % deviation of the metric (color coded to easily understand the deviation trend) over the last 7 days | | Content data metrics trends | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f3b7fdc7d37a4fd3a5a02f5325620b71~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| 1. Additionally, users can toggle the "Compare trends" radio button at the top right of the content card to visualize trends in the data for the selected date filter range.
2. Users can select two metrics, at a time, and the trends of these two selected metrics will be displayed simultaneously over the selected rage.
3. The goal of the trend comparison is to allow finding correlations between pairs of metrics as well individually analyze these salient trends | ### Top Ranking lists | Functionality/Component | UI interface | Key functionalities/capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | Top 20 campaigns (default view) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/856bace454c34d36bbbc2e24bbfc998e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

2. In using these other ranking criteria, users will similarly see an absolute value of the criteria, % contribution to the criteria and % deviations
3. Users will be able to similarly export and view all values in the list

**Note**: For the "Top views" ranking parameter, cards for ONLY Top 20 videos will be displayed as other cards will not make logical sense | ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Do I need any special access or permissions to access this TAP Data overview interface?** TAPs do not need any specialized access to access this functionality and should be able to access this functionality. **Can I customize the metrics I see for the core data and creator/content metrics sections?** In this phase of the launch we have included the most critical metrics for TAP consideration based on conducted user research. In a subsequent phase of the launch, we can incorporate the ability to include/exclude specific metrics upon user research and usability validation.

Click continue after completion **Note：The bank name of the bank card must be consistent with the entity name of the partner** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c31d4b2343e143c291ad1703dd3e1bda~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/432af3cdbb5d49cf9caebac9bf7adc99~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) You can check the link bank information and change account after successfully linking. **How to change account？** After clicking **[Change account]**, you can click **manage** and choose a bank account to set primary. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fad5c7c7ff0d430a9dd7a8e557409ef4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/911ebbe365c249468e8be98bab51254b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## 【Earnings】Check Commission Order You can check commission order under **[earnings]** tab Note: **[earnings]** tab will show all the commission orders from **the creators who have a commission settlement relationship with MCN**

-You can click live room/ short video to jump to the detailed page
-You can check the promotion ID (which is video id/live room id）after downloading the data. | | Commission Rate | Commission rate set by seller | | Commission bonus rate | Rate of the commission bonus funded by TikTok | | Est.Commission Base | The estimated commission base is the product sale price multiplied by the number of products sold when the order is created.

The actual commission base= product price*（Order Quantity - Refund Quantity）(excluding refund orders) | | Agency commission | The actual commission is the amount of actual commission base multiplied by the commission rate | | Agency commission bonus | Actual TikTok-funded commission bonus paid to MCN | | Returns&Refunds | Returns & refunds quantity | | Plan ID | The plan ID of the product | | Time Created | Order creation time | | Time delivered | Order Confirmation Delivery Time | | Time commission paid | The time when the order commission is settled to the bank card | | payment ID | Payment ID can help you with each order to help you to match this order with the payment id on the payment bill page.
**Note： if there is no payment ID,that means this order is still in progress to be paid** | | Payment method | --- | | Payment account | --- | ## 【Payment bills】**Check Payment Bills** Click payment bills to check the payment details of each order. You can filter order by commission paid time
You can click [export] to export bills

detail.title: UK MRDP TAX Compliance
detail.content:
## **What is the UK MRDP Compliance?** **UK MRDP,** which is short for **UK Model Reporting Rules for Digital Platforms,** is a tax regulation requiring partners on digital platforms to report specific tax information. Complying with the UK MRDP helps you avoid penalties, payout blocks, and potential account deactivation. But not to worry, we are committed to providing you with all the essential tools and information to navigate the process effortlessly. --- ## **Do You Need to Report?** If you have received any commission as a TikTok Shop e-commerce partner, you are required to comply with the UK MRDP. **Tip:** Make sure you understand the reporting requirements and deadlines. Staying informed will help you navigate compliance smoothly and avoid any issues with your account. ## **What Information is Required?** Here's a summary of the different requirements for **UK TTS Partners:** | **Requirement** | **Partners** | | --- | --- | | **Basic Information** | - Primary address
- Legal name | | **Tax Identification Number (TIN)** | - TIN number required (company registration number) | | **VAT ID Number** | - VAT Registration Number if VAT-registered
- Option to select "No" if not registered | | **Additional Details** | - Company registration number required | **Tip:** **Prepare your VAT and TIN documents** to ensure quick and easy submission. ## Stay up-to-date, stay compliant If you have earned commissions as a partner, you will be prompted to submit (via e-mails and notifications) your UK MRDP information. **Here's a visual guide to know how:** * Step 1: Connect to your TikTok Shop Partner Center * Step 2: Follow this path Finance>Tax Information>For MRDP * Step 3: Click on update and fill out all necessary information by following the form * Step 4: Submit and Await Verification ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a9a5f2ce30ac4a4d8efb7db1ebc10bed~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## **Yearly Confirmation Requirement** * **Annual Confirmation:** Starting next year, partners must confirm the accuracy of their UK MRDP information each year by December 31. * **Penalty for Non-Confirmation:** Payouts will be blocked if confirmation isn’t completed for three consecutive years. **Action Required:** Review and confirm your UK MRDP information annually to maintain uninterrupted payouts. ## **Summary Checklist for UK Partners:** 1. **Verify Eligibility:** If you received any commission, you need to comply. 2. **Prepare Documentation:** Ensure TIN and VAT details are ready for submission. 3. **Respond to Notifications:** Act on reminders to avoid enforcement actions. 4. **Confirm Yearly:** Starting next year, Review your UK MRDP details by December 31 each year. 5. **Keep Information Updated:** Stay on top of submission and verification deadlines to ensure continued access to payouts. As required by UK implementation of model reporting rules for digital platforms (UK MRDP), TikTok Shop provides you with a copy of the information submitted to HMRC. This report includes your total TikTok Shop earnings for the reporting year and key tax details. ### Where to find it Go to the **Partner Center**, navigate to the Finance tab, and locate the new **MRDP** section. There you can: * Select the **reporting year** * View the **TikTok Shop entity** that submitted the report * **Download the report** in Excel format * Use filters or batch download if needed
> Your MRDP tax report will be available for download starting **around January 31** each year. ### Notes: * This report is provided for **reference only** and reflects the same data TikTok Shop submitted to HMRC. * If your tax information (such as your NINO or business address) was missing at the time of submission, those fields may appear blank in your report. * Please consult a tax advisor to verify your filings and ensure compliance. ### What’s in the report? | **Name** | **Explanation** | | --- | --- | | **ID** | A unique reference number automatically generated by the system to identify you in this report | | **Individual/Entity** | Indicates whether you are an individual or a company | | **Residence country code** | The country code where you are considered a tax resident for this report. If you are in the EU, this includes: 1. Any EU member state that issued your TIN 2. The member state where you have a permanent establishment 3. Any EU member state where your primary address is For example, if your company is incorporated and has a primary address in Ireland (country code IE), a TIN in France (country code FR), and a permanent establishment in Spain (country code ES), this field will list "IE, FR, ES". For UK, your residence country is the country in your primary address (for corporations) and residence address for individuals or sole traders. | | **TIN** | Your tax identification number | | **TIN issued by** | The code of the country that issued your TIN | | **Entity identification number** | Your company’s registration number | | **VAT** | Your Value Added Tax (VAT) identification number | | **Entity name** | The legal name of your company or entity | | **Individual’s last name** | The last name of the individual or sole trader | | **Individual’s middle name** | The middle name of the individual or sole trader | | **Individual’s first name** | The first name of the individual or sole trader | | **Individual prefix** | The prefix, such as Mr, Ms, or Dr of the individual or sole trader | | **Birth date** | The birthdate of the individual or sole trader | | **Birth place country code** | The country code of the place of birth for the individual or sole trader | | **Permanent establishments** | The address of your permanent establishments. It is a place where a business has ongoing operations and is required to pay corporate income tax. | | **Address country code** | The country code of your primary address (for corporations) or residential address (for individuals or sole traders) | | **Primary address** | The primary address for corporations, or residential address for individuals or sole traders | | **Relevant activities** | The type of activities generating income. For example, PersonalServices for creators and partners or SaleOfGoods for sellers. | | **Consideration** | Consideration is the net of any fees, commissions or taxes withheld amount credited or paid to you in connection with the relevant activities. Check detailed data in the report for more information. | | **Consideration currency code** | The currency code for the consideration amount | | **Fees withheld** | For sellers, this is the amount shown on TikTok Shop invoices. For creators and partners, this amount is 0. | | **Fees withheld currency code** | The currency code for fees withheld | | **Taxes** | The taxes withheld from your sales or services on TikTok Shop | | **Taxes currency code** | The currency code for the withheld taxes | | **Number of activities** | The number of transactions corresponding to consideration each quarter. Check detailed data in the report for more information. | The report reflects the **calendar year** data that was available in your account before TikTok Shop submitted it to the relevant tax authority.

detail.title: [CAP/TAP] Finance guide (US only)
detail.content:
# Finance The finance feature allows partners, including **Creator Agency Partner (CAP)** & **TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP)**, to review and export orders and bills after sharing commissions with Creators. ### Payment Accounts The **Payment Accounts** section allows partners to set up and update bank accounts to receive payouts. First, partners need to activate their payment accounts for the relevant market. After activation, you must link your bank account and successfully pass verification to receive payouts. Steps are as follows: | Step 1 | Go to Finance -> Payment Account and click on 'Activate Account.' | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/364fed6638c146ffae21f97bc6174581~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | --- | --- | --- | | Step 2 | Fill in the required information. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/737d4716117d400caea6f67f473de885~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Step 3 | Wait for the results of the payment account review. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cba215e5dfed4a28af03bbd7ca7bb81a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Step 4 | If the review is approved, you can proceed to link your bank account. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c03a8c1bb1d14a82847b5351ece2873f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Step 5 | Enter the bank account information. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a5f828eb5435438b8ec70e89c5f2eaa5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Step 6 | The bank account has been successfully linked. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3e82a02e2086455b97938ac2b8a85409~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ### Earnings The **Earnings** section lists all commission orders from creators who have a fee agreement with the partner. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ae9cb7f114a0419c842709ac1862de46~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) At the top of this page, you can view an overview of your commission data, including: * **Not Paid**: This represents the amount has not yet been transferred to your bank account. Possible reasons include: * Orders are not yet completed. * The payout failed due to errors in your bank account details. Please verify your information and click '**Request Payment**' to retry. If it still fails, submit a ticket for assistance. * Your earnings have not yet reached the payout threshold, which is $1.00 for US local partners. You can go to the '**Pending payment**' and '**Payment failed**' tab to check details. * **Paid**: this amount reflects the funds that have been successfully transferred to your bank account. You can check details under the '**Paid**' tab. You can also export the commission order details to an Excel file for easier reconciliation. ***Note:*** *due to US data compliance, when the market is the US, US CB partners can only export the earnings data of Carved-Out creators* ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/797cd07daebb4c72baee29c95db47fc1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### 2.1 When will I receive the commission? Starting **April 15, 2025(UTC+0)**, you will receive commissions based on the following rules: * You will typically receive commission **15 days** after the order delivery date. * Some orders may take longer due to: * Commissions are paid only after the seller's orders are settled. Therefore, if the seller's settlement period is longer, such as Delivery + 31 days, commissions will also be paid to you 31 days after delivery. * Commissions can't be paid until the dispute, refund, or return requests are resolved. #### 2.2 What is the impact of the creator settlement rule change effective April 15, 2025? Prior to the change, you typically receive commission **within 15 days** (which could be 1, 5, 8, or 15 days) after the order delivery date, up to 31 days after delivery. Under the new rules, you will typically receive commission **on the 15th day** after the order delivery date, up to 31 days after delivery. For orders created after April 15, 2025, commission will be paid following the new rules. You may experience a temporary earnings dip for about half of the month post-change, but cash flow will normalize over time. ### Payment Bills The **Payments** section displays the records of successful payouts, which you can use to reconcile with your bank statements.
If you want to view the commission details for each payment ID, go to the **Paid** tab on the **Earnings** page to export the commission order details. You can use the payment ID column to locate the corresponding orders.
TikTok Shop automatically initiates **daily** payouts to your selected payout method once your earnings reach the minimum payout threshold. The minimum payout thresholds for local and cross-border partners are as follows: | Type | CAP & TAP Region | Payout Method | Minimum Payout | Payment Currency | Time of Fund Arrival | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | L2L | US | Bank account | 1.00 | USD | 1-7 business days | | Cross-boarder | CN | Bank account | 0.01 | CNY | Generally 1-7 business days. Overseas issue banks may need extra processing time | | | | Lianlian | 0.01 | CNH/USD | 1 business day | | | | PingPong | 0.01 | CNH/USD | 1 business day | | | | Airwallex | 0.01 | CNH/USD | 1 business day | | | HK | Bank account | 0.01 | USD | Generally 1-7 business days. Overseas issue banks may need extra processing time | | | | Lianlian | 0.01 | USD | 1 business day | | | | PingPong | 0.01 | USD | 1 business day | | | | Airwallex | 0.01 | USD | 1 business day | | **Please note that online settlement is not yet available for US cross-border CAP, so the information above does not apply to it.* | | | | | | ### Tax Information CAP and TAP must submit a **W-9** form (for US local partners) or a **W-8** form (for cross-border partners) to start a campaign.

# Finance The finance feature allows partners, including **Creator Agency Partner (CAP)** & **TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP)**, to review and export orders and bills after sharing commissions with Creators. ### Payment Accounts The **Payment Accounts** section allows partners to set up and update bank accounts to receive payouts. First, partners need to activate their payment account for the relevant market. After activation, you must link your bank account and successfully pass verification to receive payouts. Steps are as follows: **Step 1: Activate Your Payment Account** 1. Navigate to **Finance** > **Payment Account**. 2. Click on the **'Activate Account'** button to begin the process.
**Step 2: Provide Required Information** Fill in the necessary details in the form to complete your account activation request. Ensure all information is accurate and up to date. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8fccb53a491b43c39fa4f30ed7d7ba05~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Step 3: Await Account Review** Once submitted, your payment account will be reviewed. Please allow some time for this process to complete. You will be notified of the results. **Step 4: Link Your Bank Account (Upon Approval)** If your payment account is approved, proceed to link your bank account by selecting the **'Link Bank Account'** option.
**Step 5: Enter Bank Account Details** Carefully input your bank account information, including account number, routing number, and any other required details. Double-check for accuracy. **Step 6: Confirmation** Once the information is submitted and verified, your bank account will be successfully linked. You’re all set to manage your payments seamlessly! ### Earnings The **Earnings** section lists all commission orders from creators who have a fee agreement with the partner. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0f2a329cd5714317aa57d0fb92fdf824~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) At the top of this page, you can view an overview of your commission data, including: * **Not Paid**: This represents the amount has not yet been transferred to your bank account. Possible reasons include: * Orders are not yet completed. * The payout failed due to errors in your bank account details. Please verify your information and click '**Request Payment**' to retry. If it still fails, submit a ticket for assistance. * Your earnings have not yet reached the payout threshold, which is 1 GBP for UK partners You can go to the '**Pending payment**' and '**Payment failed**' tab to check details. * **Paid**: this amount reflects the funds that have been successfully transferred to your bank account. You can check details under the '**Paid**' tab. You can also export the commission order details to an Excel file for easier reconciliation. ### When Will I Receive the Commission? Starting April 1st, 2025 (UTC+0), commissions will be paid based on the following rules: * You will receive commission **15 days after the order delivery date**. * Some orders may take longer due to: * **Seller settlement periods:** Commissions are paid only after the seller’s orders are settled. If a seller has a longer settlement period (e.g., **Delivery + 31 days**), your commission will also be paid 31 days after delivery. * **Refunds or disputes:** Commissions cannot be paid until any product disputes, refund requests, or return requests are resolved. ### What Is the Impact of the Commission Payment Rule Change Effective April 1st, 2025? Before the change: * You could receive commission as early as **3 days after delivery** and up to **31 days**, depending on various factors. * Commissions were **non-refundable**, even if a refund occurred shortly after payment. * Payment timelines were unpredictable, varying between **3 to 31 days**. After the change: * **Fixed timeline:** You will typically receive commission **15 days after delivery** (unless the seller’s settlement period is longer). * **Refund adjustments:** Commissions are refundable to sellers if a refund occurs before your payment is processed. * **More predictable cash flow:** A standard 15-day payment period ensures better visibility into commission payouts. ### 2.3 Example of the Commission Payment Timeline Change Let’s say a product is delivered on **April 5**: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0fc8b999e6084d0ba8d7b7e84697d93e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Payment Bills The **Payments** section displays the records of successful payouts, which you can use to reconcile with your bank statements.
If you want to view the commission details for each payment ID, go to the **Paid** tab on the **Earnings** page to export the commission order details. You can use the payment ID column to locate the corresponding orders.
### Tax Information The **UK MRDP** compliance requirement must be completed as a requirement to start a campaign.

detail.title: [US] 1099-K and Tax Form FAQs
detail.content:
## 1099-K
### **What is Form 1099-K?**
Form 1099-K is a report of payments processed for you for goods or services during the year. It reports the gross amount of all reportable payments received through payment settlement entities (PSE). For the 2025 calendar year, TikTok, Inc. will issue you a 1099-K **if your gross payment volume on the platform exceeded $20,000 in more than 200 transactions.**

### **Will I receive a Form 1099-K?**
If you are a TikTok Shop Partner (U.S.) and your gross payment volume over the 2025 calendar year on the platform exceeded $20,000 in more than 200 transactions, you will receive a Form 1099-K. TikTok, Inc. will send copies to you and the IRS by January 31st of the following year. If you did not exceed the threshold, you will not receive a 1099-K. If you meet the criteria, you can find your 1099-K in Partner Center > Finance > Tax Information.

### **Why do I need a Form 1099-K?**
The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) requires U.S. payment processors, including TikTok, Inc., to file and send you a Form 1099-K if the payment processor has processed more than $20,000 of your earnings in more than 200 transactions during the calendar year. Your earnings associated with online marketplaces such as TikTok Shop are considered reportable income.
For additional information regarding Form 1099-K, please visit the [IRS website](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/understanding-your-form-1099-k).

### **What is included in Form 1099-K?**
The 1099-K form will include the total (unadjusted) amount of payments you received for services through the platform. It is broken out by month based on when payments are processed.

It is effectively the total amount sellers/creators/affiliate partners or the platform have paid, but is not adjusted by the following:


* Refunds or cancelled orders after payment is made
* Commission sharing
* Or any other adjustment

## **Providing your Tax Information**
### **Where can I find my tax information?**
For businesses, the EIN can be found on your IRS notice with assigned EIN, or prior tax forms such as a 1099-K.

### **How is my tax information reviewed?**
The tax information provided to complete the tax interview is compared to the information you provided when originally creating the account. Please ensure that the tax informaiton provided matches with the information provided upon onboarding.
If the tax information is valid, a W9 is created per IRS requirements.

### **Why do I need to provide my Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)?**
The IRS requires TikTok to obtain your tax information prior to making any payments to you. Failure to provide required information triggers mandatory withholding at a rate of 24% on such payments (and may make you ineligible to participate in TikTok Shop).

### **How do I provide my tax information?**
Your tax information is furnished by completing a Form W-9. To complete your Form W-9, please go to Partner Center > Finance > Tax Information. You will be directed to a page where you can enter and electronically certify your business tax information.

### **What tax information do I need to provide?**
As a seller of goods or services, you provide the legal name of your business and corresponding TIN. You must additionally provide your address and federal tax classification. For additional guidance, refer to the specific[ instructions for Form W-9](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/understanding-your-form-1099-k).

### **When must I update my tax information?**
You must update your tax information when the information previously provided is no longer correct such as a change in name, change in TIN, or change in status. Additionally, you must update your tax information if you detect an error in in the information initially provided.

### **How do I make an update to my tax information?**
If you need to make a change to your tax information, please go to Partner Center > Finance > Tax Information. You will be directed to a page to securely enter and electronically certify your corrected information.

detail.content:
# What is settlement report? 
A settlement report is a financial document that provides a detailed breakdown of your account activity for a specified settlement period. This report enables you to reconcile your commission earned.
# How can I download the settlement report?
To download the settlement report, please follow these steps:
Partner Center-Finance-Payment-Earnings-Export orders.
# How do I read the settlement report? 
Below, you can find the definitions of each column.
| **Column** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| Order ID | Unique order identifier |
| Sku id | SKU unique ID |
| SKU | SKU name |
| Product ID | Product unique ID |
| Product Name | Product name |
| Price | Item price |
| Quantity | Item quantity |
| Creator username | Creator Username |
| Tag id | Third-party linkshare creator identifier, visible for SEA agencies only. |
| Shop name | Seller shop name |
| Shop code | Seller shop code |
| Currency | Transaction currency (for example, USD, MXN). |
| Order type | Channel that attributed the order, for example affiliate or shop ads. |
| Order Settlement Status | Settlement status of the order with the platform (for example, settled or pending). |
| Content Type | Type of content that generated the order, such as video, live,showcase. |
| Content id | Content unique ID |
| Attribution Type | Attribution type, for example: direct, indirect |
| Commission model | Commission model applied to this order, such as tiered or fixed rate based on order volume. |
| Standard commission rate | Standard base commission rate applied to commissionable GMV, expressed as a percentage. |
| Shop Ads commission rate | Commission rate for shop ads traffic, expressed as a percentage. |
| TikTok Commission bonus rate | TikTok commission bonus rate, expressed as a percentage of the commissionable base. |
| Partner Commission bonus rate | Partner commission bonus rate, expressed as a percentage of the commissionable base. |
| GMV | Buyer paid amount for the order (GMV). |
| Est. commission base | Estimated commissionable amount before settlement, used as the base for calculating all commission components. |
| Est. standard commission | Estimated standard commission portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing while the order is not yet settled. |
| Est. shop ads commission | Estimated shop ads commission portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing while the order is not yet settled. |
| Est. TikTok commission bonus | Estimated TikTok commission bonus portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing while the order is not yet settled. |
| Est. Partner commission bonus | Estimated partner or agency-funded commission bonus portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing while the order is not yet settled. |
| Actual commission base | Final commissionable base amount after settlement, used to compute actual commissions. |
| Actual standard commission | Final standard commission portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing after settlement. |
| Actual shop ads commission | Final shop ads commission portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing after settlement. |
| Actual TikTok commission bonus | Final TikTok commission bonus portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing after settlement. |
| Actual partner commission bonus | Final partner or agency-funded commission bonus portion before creator–MCN revenue sharing after settlement. |
| creator tax | Total tax withheld and paid by the platform on behalf of the creator. |
| Actual Commission Earnings before split | Total commission earnings attributable to the creator before sharing with the MCN, net of creator tax. SUM(AB+AC+AD+AE-AF) |
| Agency commission sharing portion | Contracted MCN revenue share percentage applied to the creator's commission income. |
| Total creator earned commission | Final commission income paid out to the creator after MCN share. |
| Total agency earned commission before tax | Total commission allocated to the MCN before agency-level taxes. |
| Agency Tax - ISR | Income tax (ISR) withheld and paid on behalf of the agency in Mexico. |
| Agency Tax - IVA | Value-added tax (IVA) withheld and paid on behalf of the agency in Mexico. |
| Total agency earned commission | Final commission income received by the MCN after agency taxes. |
| Total agency earned commission after FX | Total agency commission converted to the settlement currency after applying the foreign exchange rate. |
| FX Rate | Foreign exchange rate used to convert commission amounts to the settlement currency. |
| Invitation ID | Identifier of the invitation or recruitment campaign associated with the creator or order. |
| Time order created | Timestamp when the order was created. |
| Time order delivered | Timestamp when the order was delivered, if available. |
| Payment ID | Payout transaction ID, (for successed payment only). |
| Payment status | Payout status |

detail.title: Create and publish a service
detail.content:
# What is a TikTok Shop Service?
A TikTok Shop Service is an offering created by a partner through TikTok Shop Partner Center. It serves as an introduction to the partner's capabilities and acts as an online service invitation extended to TikTok Shop sellers. These services can be made public, available for all sellers to see and authorize (Public Service), or they can be shared privately with specific sellers the partner has already connected with (Custom Service).
There are two types of services.

* **Public:**
   * Intended for services that partners want to showcase on the **App & Service Store**, allowing them to be browsed and authorized by any seller.
   * To publish a "public" service, partners must provide additional service information and pass a review process because it will be displayed on the App & Service Store.
* **Custom:**
   * Designed for services that partners specifically want to offer to a particular client with whom they have an established connection.
   * Publishing a "custom" service does not require a review process before it can be authorized by sellers.

In short, TikTok Shop Services provide partners with a flexible way to present their service offerings and invite sellers to utilize their services, either publicly or through private channels. The choice between "public" and "custom" services depends on the partner's target audience and authorization preferences.
# Publishing a public service
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/38f450916ded4974a55db6dfe62c3e94~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Publish a custom service
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/090f3684bff14f3bac458a6bae0f7ca8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Steps to create a service
Click "Create app&service" to create your first service
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a9d0d530c98846ac91a9737d1c60a81f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Choose the service type according to your needs and provide related content ( referring to [Listing your service on the App & Service Store](650411a75a12ff0294023d30))
NOTE: Please ensure you select the correct TSP category for publishing your service. You can only publish services under categories for which you have received approved certification, as shown on your account profile page.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/373bc7fced984a4193e425980e01e925~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5e65f98ae6ef473f8014bdbb2061abb8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
After completing all the information needed and the launch checklist, you can click publish to let your service go live.

* If you are publishing a custom service, your service will go live directly and you can share with your sellers with the authorization link
* If you are publishing public service, your service will go reviewing process before publishing, after approval, your service will go live.

detail.title: Seller Leads Pool
detail.content:
# What is Seller Leads Pool? The Seller Leads Pool helps TSP receive qualified seller inquiries and choose which businesses to connect with based on detailed information. TSP can see key business details like company size, GMV, and category to help make informed decisions about potential partnerships. **Key Features & Benefits:** * Quality Leads: Service Partners can review seller business profiles and requirements before deciding to connect * Full Control: Service Partners can choose which inquiries to pursue and access seller contact details once they accept a lead * Easy Updates: Service Partners can track lead status from initial inquiry through to final partnership **Seller Leads Pool Workflows**
# How it Works ## Two types of seller leads | | Open leads | Target leads | | --- | --- | --- | | Seller | When a seller doesn't have a particular TSP in mind for their inquiry, they can opt for "open leads." This choice allows the platform to analyze the seller's needs and recommend suitable TSPs based on the services required. | When a seller already knows which TSP or TSPs they are interested in working with, they can select "target leads." This option enables sellers to direct their inquiries specifically to one or more chosen TSPs. | | TSP | Only the TSP assigned by the platform can check the leads
* Please note: All successfully onboard TSP can be assigned to Seller | Only the TSP chosen by the Seller can check leads
Please note: only TSPs who publish public services can be chosen by the Seller | | Platform | Can assign TSP for seller | --- | ### Step 1 Seller can initiate a request on the TSP portal Sellers can find the request entrance on **Seller Center- TikTok Shop Partner-Request a Partner**, or go to the service details page to click Contact Partners. Home page ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7aca41292602416887d34bf1c1e96b15~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/24b896379d194574b7d8db2cef58d9b0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Detailed page The seller can also initiate requests on the independent TSP portal(https://seller-us.tiktok.com/partners/us). Please note: For those sellers who do not have a TikTok Shop account, sellers can only contact by direct email. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ef82a59546d54af5882dfc66ca458c5a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Step 2 Seller Fill out the request form To let TSP better know about your business, sellers need to fill out the following information on the request form. | | **Field** | **Required** | **Explanation** | Demo | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Contact information | Subject | Yes | Your contact name | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/28583f83d91f4acba60773af9f112f1e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | | Contact email | Yes | Leave your contact email so that TSP can reach out to you. | | | | Location | No | Your desired location for any possible offline collaboration with the partner" | | | Business Profile | Company size | Yes | Choose your company size with dropdown options:

* 0-5 employees
* 5-30 employees
* 30-100 employees
* 100-500 employees
* 500+ employees | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/94282f06f74840e89acc6a064b2f83f1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | | Currency | Yes | Choose your currency with dropdown options | | | | TikTok Shop sales GMV | Yes | Your average monthly GMV on TikTok Shop | | | | Sales GMV from other channels | No | Your total monthly GMV on other channels | | | | Budget | Yes | Your budget to pay TSP per month | | | | Product category | Yes | Your main product category on TikTok Shop | | | | Hot sale product | No | Your best-selling product | | | | Other details | No | Other information you would like to share | | | Request type | Select partners | Yes | 1. If you choose "I know which partner I want to work with" the *partner will receive your inquiry directly*
1. You need to select the partners' service
2. Up to **50 services** can be selected at once
2. If you choose "I want TikTok Shop to refer to me", the platform will assign fit TSP to follow up
1. You need to choose the service type that you want
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f74754cba3de4698aa2d14752b06e2a5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ### Step 3 Seller Check and manage your request After submitting the request, the seller can go to My Request to check and manage the request.
Seller can click **View details - edit request** to edit the current request information. Please note: your contact email and select partners will not be editable.
The seller can click close to close the inquiry, either on inquiry level or partner level. After closing, your inquiry will not be able to be shared with new partner, and existing partner who has claimed the leads will no longer check your contact information.
### Step 4 TSP Receive and check the Seller's request After the seller submits a request, the assigned TSP will be able to receive a notification email and check all new requests on the TikTok Partner Center -Seller Leads Pool- New Opportunities Tab. Email ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bd6b40f77c2b4b95a2ae8b082f22fb3e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a60661cbbce54504b747c38e4a03297c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) TikTok Shop Partner Center ### Step 5 TSP Review leads and follow up Partners can click view details to check the detailed information of the seller. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ba52097f6ea1441eb3ec64e54eeb55f0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/70133fd9441c4050a2f9488487a1cf3e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) If a partner chooses to follow up, seller leads will be transferred to the "following" tab, and the partner can click"view details" to check the **contact information** of the seller.
If the partner decides to reject the request, they will no longer have access to view the seller's information. Partners have the option to select a reason for rejection, which will not be visible to the seller.
### Step 3 TSP Accept or reject cooperation After a discussion with the seller, the partner can go to the following tab to accept the cooperation results.
If a seller grants authorization to a TSP following the lead submission, their collaboration will automatically move to the "Reach a Deal" section. Here, the TSP can view the authorization details under "Reach a Deal - View Details." Additionally, if automatic matching doesn't work (eg, seller authorized before initiating inquiry) , partners can manually enter the authorization ID by selecting "Accept Cooperation." ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/386a3b8e3b934ac6a912419d7b5a2a31~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/711912b6997042a6b7016d8d6e557e86~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) If a partner fails to reach a collaboration with the seller, a partner can choose" unable to reach a cooperation agreement" and this leads will be moved to the "Close" Tab. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2dd41b9370a74c27abf839f9226a01b4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Notes ### If the seller closes the request If the seller closes the inquiry, the inquiry will not be able to be updated. A partner will receive an email and can check the closed inquiry under the" closed" tab. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fb959cfd3d94465486406178bdfdeba6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/acca383eaa0d4eedbefcd666d615d951~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # FAQs ### Q1 Where can TSP find the seller's contact information? You will only be able to check seller contact information after you claim seller leads

detail.title: Steps to Get Service Authorization
detail.content:
# Workflow ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/913e2664b9194fbfba177877bda860c7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Feature Guide ## Step 1 TSP publishes a public/custom service Please refer to the [user guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f198a193f5dc028e35505f) to publish a service before starting authorization ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b96b6e1688ac4c03a66a431df6c2006c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 2 TSP Share the authorization link with Seller Click the active service to go to the detailed page, copy and share the link with your seller and seller can authorize via it. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/637fca7433b04307aa21d77204fefb40~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3f13b786d5934564bddd6f1a2111e539~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) For US L2L&CB, you can also[ create a service proposal/offer to sign with sellers](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/683f1483ffedae049865673e). ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d291367a5ea24f999c96350b7f327af7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 3 Seller opens the authorization link and completes the authorization steps ### For US L2L When the seller authorizes TSP service through an authorization link, the seller can check ALL available unauthorized services belonging to this partner, and the seller can choose multiple services to authorize at one time. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/991435590d5245f994d5264c8d7eaaa5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Sellers can choose the following item to authorize *Note: authorizations will be displayed based on different service qualifications, and the following are examples.* 1. **Authorized object:** it could be Shop&TikTok, Shop, TikTok Account 2. **Shop operation ticket:** After authorizing, TSP can raise tickets on behalf of your shop on the Partner Canter-Tickets page 3. **Seller center access:** TSP can access the specific authorized pages on the seller center after authorization. 4. **Data compass:** After authorizing, TSP can check related data based on authorization ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b358d0551f944fbfae1532601c05a5e0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### For EU + SEA These processes are generally similar, and sellers can authorize all seller center access including TSP access and seller data. **But there is no "Authorized object(Shop&TikTok/Shop/TikTok Account )".** Note: TSP access has been launched in the EU on December, 2025, and SEA will go live subsequently.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eaf9eebb4d5d481bb168e5de2ab978eb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/35d3ace82e6347c9b5c162719c843805~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
### For US CB and other markets These processes are generally similar, but in Seller Center access, there is only "Data Compass authorization" and **no "Permission role authorization"**, which means partner can check seller data but being unable to log in via TSP acess.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/75942f29622041f488a2c6b92f4804ee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/81c958a22b18488b84e1a15c5a6304aa~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 4 TSP and Seller check and manage authorization TSP can access all authorizations on the Seller management page, where TSP can easily check all the authorization details ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a792f12f79304cf2bdbf70195bd9bcac~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Sellers can also go to my service page to check authorizations. By clicking “Edit”, the seller can edit/delete/renew the service as needed. **US L2L:** under "App & service"-"Find partner"
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b2b8b6825313493789cc8457963af8bc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2d1e89c069414d9dba9de6e72615b48a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
**US CB:** under "App & service"-"TikTok Shop partners" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/59b1034eed064a0aba8d9650a2f5c9f5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **EU:** under "App & service"-"Find partner" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8285334c3450418fbda01e239e8969b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Other markets:** under "Growth" - "TikTok Shop partners" ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/635ea643867c4faeb7bfadd4494cf555~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Authorizations status：** | **Status** | **Definition** | | --- | --- | | Active | Authorization with the partner is active. | | Expired | Authorization with the partner has expired. | | Cancelled | You have canceled your authorization with the partner, which means seller cancels binding relationship with its partner. | | Deactivated | Your authorization with the partner has been deactivated. | # FAQ 1. **How to renew the authorization from the TSP Side？** TSP can send the authorization link to the seller again for the seller to renew the authorization ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c58094cebf8a4808b0491afe317362fb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **How to cancel authorization?** At this stage, only the seller can cancel the authorization on my service page. Once canceled, TSP will not be able to access any data or log in with TSP Access. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c4d6659e8c674d0f9637cb06c2cf025e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: Steps to cancel authorization for TSP
detail.content:
# Introduction This tool allows TSPs to request the cancellation of service authorization. If the seller agrees to the cancellation or fails to respond within 72 hours, the authorization will be automatically terminated.
# Step 1: TSP raises a cancellation request TSP can navigate to ++TikTok Shop Partner Center-> Seller Management++ and click terminate++ ++to raise a cancel authorization request. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6ef558997b7f4b6d95f1e7e55dce01dc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a3f7e76f37ce430c99275905d4e76050~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) TSP should fill in the related reason for cancellation and leave a note if needed. Which would make it easier for the seller to check and review. # Step 2: Seller checks and replies to requests. After a TSP initiates a cancellation, the seller can view the request on the My Service page: 1. If the seller chooses "Agree," the authorization will be canceled immediately. 2. If the seller chooses "Reject," the authorization will remain valid. You may contact the seller or resubmit your request after 144 hours. 3. **If the seller does not respond within 72 hours, the authorization will be automatically canceled.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/73a9d868128f4b2687960ab6bde6296e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/25268a3f88b94d138431ae81e94bed2b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Step 3: Check the status of the cancellation request TSP can check the cancellation status on the seller management page, and click view details to check the action records ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6216d460405a4be18fa556597ed6bbbc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6cb80e9bc5a34724a12291aac5fdc5df~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) The seller can check the cancellation record on My Service page.
*Status of authorization: | Status Terminology | Definition | | --- | --- | | Active | Your authorization with the partner is active.
*Including cancellation raised but not approved or pending review in 72h | | Completed | Your authorization with the partner has expired. | | Authorization Canceled | You have canceled your authorization with the partner. | | Cancel | Including seller cancel authorization or partner cancel authorization | | Closed | The partner has been removed from the platform for violating platform policies. Your authorization with the partner has been deactivated. |
# **FAQ** 1. How do I check who canceled the authorization？ You can go to the authorization-detailed page to check the cancellation record. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/96e7effcef594cf2babca15ae3e508bd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3aa604e4bc724609a8212bdcf2bcfc9d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: TSP Access Feature
detail.content:
# **Background** TikTok Shop Partners (TSPs) are e-commerce service providers focused on Seller Service (Shop Management, LIVE Management, Short Video Management, Seller Affiliate Management). They often need to log into the seller center to assist merchants with their daily activities. However, there are a couple of significant challenges. For example, TSPs face the inconvenience of juggling multiple sub-accounts when performing operations on behalf of sellers. To streamline the way TSPs request and log into Seller Center, we are offering the TSP access feature for TSPs to log into Seller Center and start operation with one click. Plus, TSPs can also initiate and manage conversations with creators through Creator IM under TSP Access, facilitating affiliate collaboration on the seller’s behalf. ## Available Market US,UK,EU(DE/IE/FR/IT/ES),ID,MY,VN,SG,PH,TH This feature is only applicable to L2L partners, excluding CB ## Benefits 1. **Simplified Seller Center Access Requests** TSPs can effortlessly share a request for Seller Center access with merchants and obtain authorization with minimal fuss. 2. **Hassle-Free Seller Center Login** With just one click from the Partner Center, TSPs can smoothly log into the Seller Center without creating a new account. 3. **Centralized Seller Account Management** TSPs now can manage all their merchant account access points and seamlessly switching between accounts from a single location on the Partner Center. 4. **Seamless creator relationship management through Creator IM** TSPs can now use Creator IM to communicate with creators on behalf of sellers, ensuring they can fully support affiliate growth strategies. Meanwhile, creators will not perceive the difference between TSP and seller identity. # Workflow overview ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/65f2874303194e8bb3ba547fdf60c09b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Step by Step guide ## Step 1 Get TSP access authorization from the sellers Sellers can authorize TSP access through the TSP portal or authorization request sent by TSP. Please note： 1. Sellers must have already authorized a service with their shop to grant TSP access. 2. TSP access can only be added to services that are currently valid. 3. Only the main account of the seller has the authority to authorize TSP services. 4. During the authorization process, sellers have the option to skip adding TSP access. ##### ### **Option 1: Allow TSP access when authorizes service category** #### **For new authorization** Before starting authorization, TSP needs to publish a service and and share the authorization link with your seller. The interface varies slightly across different markets. For details, please refer to [Steps to Get Service Authorization](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f198a9dc7f3e028d38171a#Back%20To%20Top) - Step 1+2+3. Here, the US is taken as an example. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/919f4eedab2345e4a9c41cf6aa62a9a6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/52752b458ea2458fb89a2d26e7741472~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) When the seller authorizes TSP service through an authorization link, the seller can check all available unauthorized public services belonging to this partner, and the seller can choose multiple services to authorize at one time.

#### For existing authorization For the existing authorization, sellers can go to the "My Service" Page to add TSP access by clicking " Edit" . The interface varies slightly across different markets. For details, please refer to [Steps to Get Service Authorization](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f198a9dc7f3e028d38171a#Back%20To%20Top) - Step 4. Here, the US is taken as an example. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ddda504ff0224f488c7990defdc40ac3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ecd2644a8db84d06ab7180da9f924f16~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8cd20e36584143c09ae6b1b2c6c6c59f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### **Option 2:Authorize TSP access by authorization link sent by TSP** TSP can also copy authorization links on the Partner Center> manage authorization page and send seller links. The seller can open the link to complete the TSP access authorization. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1a17262c43064ea1beddaa3fab97021b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## **Step 2 TSP log into Seller center and** access all features Once the seller finishes the TSP access authorization on the seller center, TSP can log into the seller center with one click on the manage authorization page-TSP access login. TSP will be able to access all Seller center features within the authorized permission role and provide further operation.
## **Steps to use Seller-Creator IM** Please refer to [TSP Access Seller-Creator IM](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/hdcn0oi7) # FAQ **Q1: Can I utilize the sub-account in the seller center and TSP access simultaneously?** In the same Chrome profile, you can either use tsp access or the Seller Center sub-account, which implies that you have to log out if you wish to switch to the other.

# **Steps to use Seller-Creator IM** TSP can utilize the features of Seller-Creator IM if authorized for Full Access or Affiliation. After logging into the Seller Center via TSP Access, on the “Affiliate” page, click the “Go to Affiliate Center Home” button to enter the Affiliate Center.
Once in the Affiliate Center, TSPs can use Creator IM just like sellers do through 5 entrances. Please refer to the [Seller - Creator IM User Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?course_type=1&from=search%7BcontentIdParams%7D&identity=1&is_new_connect=0&is_new_user=0&knowledge_id=2725932827150123&role=1). * **Entrance 1:** In the Affiliate Center, click on Creator messages at the top navigation bar.
* **Entrance 2:** Send IMs to creators directly within Find creators in Affiliate Center.
* **Entrance 3:** Send IMs to creators directly within their detailed profile view.
* **Entrance 4:** Share a specific product via an IM within the targeted collaboration page.
* **Entrance 5:** Send IMs to creators by clicking on the speech bubble icon on the Sample Request page.
## FAQ **Q1: Can I utilize the sub-account in the seller center and TSP access simultaneously?** In the same Chrome profile, you can either use tsp access or the Seller Center sub-account, which implies that you have to log out if you wish to switch to the other.

detail.title: [UK/JP/Latam] TSP Online Signing Process
detail.content:
# Introduction: What is TSP Online Signing? TSP Online Signing is a feature that allows TSPs to establish online signing relationships with sellers. # What are the benefits？ * **Smoother Workflow:** TSPs can initiate a service proposal, which the seller can then review and confirm. * **Official Signing:** By detailing service specifics and related information, TSPs can establish official signing relationships with sellers, ensuring clear communication and agreed-upon terms. # What's the workflow？ ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/41e3a3607af1418b89747e789cd5e2b2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Steps ### Step 1: Create a service proposal To build an official service relationship with the seller, TSP can navigate to the [Seller Management-Create Service proposal](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager?region=US) page to check authorization and create a new service proposal. Note: To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please ensure you have at least one approved service (Status: On) under the related category. TSP can go to the[ APP & Service](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/service/list/?tab=4) page to double-check. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d1d8800b8d4548069b523637065fac3e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) TSP can provide signing information for seller checking and signing off, which includes: 1. **Seller Information:** TSP can select a seller by either **shop name** or **shop code.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a2347edc16d445ca9cb6626aba211978~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Select Service Details:** TSP has the option to select either a single service or multiple service categories, which include Live Management, Affiliate Management, Shop Operation and Management, and Short Video Management. For each service proposal, TSP needs to provide the related information as specified below.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f5e5c0b6d024479997d7b53615265af1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c712d99ef0af494cb3c16de0d0b88f31~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Proposal Details** | Live management | Short Video Management | Affiliate management | Shop operation and management | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Service period:** TSP needs to choose a start and end date for the service that aligns with the actual service cycle. | Required | Required | Required | Required | | **Permission needed:** TSP can choose the permission needed for this service, which includes:
**Shop Ticket** - Enable TSPs to submit a ticket on behalf of the seller
**Shop-level Data analysis**- Enable TSP to check seller shop-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center
**Account-level Data analysis**- Enable TSP to check seller account-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center (*only for Live management or short video management）
**Seller Center Access** - Enable TSP to log into the seller center and take further action
**Seller Center Message** - Enable TSP to check the seller violation message in Seller Center
**Seller Center Analytics Access**- Enable TSP to log into the seller center and check the data compass on TikTok Shop Partner Center | Required
| Required
| Required | Required | | **Seller's TikTok account:** TSP needs to select the serviced seller account by account name | Required | Required | No need | No need | | **Management period:** TSPs are required to select the actual management period for each TikTok account. | Required | Required | No need | No need | | **Affiliate GMV type:** TSP needs to choose their affiliate service type, including target/open/TAP campaign | No need | No need | Required | No need | | **Service details:** Upload various forms of documentation as proof of your service. Acceptable types include official emails from the seller, permits from the seller, service contracts, or seller invoices. | Required | Optional | Optional | Optional | **Please note:** during the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with.
### Step 2: Seller views and signs the proposal After creating a service proposal, TSP can share the proposal link with the seller to sign.
When the seller opens the proposal link, they can view the service proposal, which includes basic information about the TSP and detailed service offerings across various categories. After reviewing, the seller has the option to either reject or accept the proposal. If accepted, the seller and TSP will officially be signed up for the specific service. **Please note:** Sellers are not able to modify the proposal. If there are any questions or concerns about the service proposal, sellers can contact TSP.
### Step 3: Check and manage the sign details After signing, the seller can go to my services page to view all signing details. By clicking View the Details, the seller can check the detailed signing information
TSP can navigate to the [seller management-service proposals](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager?region=US) page to check all signing information ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cb303477177a4e94a113646194a65ae1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***How to renew the signing with the Seller？** TSPs have the option to select the 'Extend' button to create a renewal application. They can then edit the new service period. After making these adjustments, TSPs can share the signing link with the seller for review and approval. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0d39b3a2b27f4028a3800cf3143730a2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/76a989c94bae4d2980e1c8fdb0634a54~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***How to cancel the existing signing with the seller？** TSP can navigate to TikTok Shop Partner Center-> Seller Management and click delete to raise a cancel signing request.
After a TSP initiates a cancellation, the seller can view the request on the My Service page: 1. If the seller chooses "Agree," the authorization will be canceled immediately. 2. If the seller chooses "Reject," the authorization will remain valid. You may contact the seller or resubmit your request after 144 hours. 3. **If the seller does not respond within 72 hours, the authorization will be automatically canceled.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3af05f40627d45d683702b9bab118fac~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9d5ec310383e485b89fe939dca490100~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) *Signing Status | | Definition | | --- | --- | | Rejected | The service proposal was rejected by the seller | | Wait for confirmation | Service proposals are waiting for the seller to review. TSP can cancel the proposal at this stage. | | Partially confirm | Part of the service proposal was accepted by TSP., TSP can check and add a new service proposal if needed. | | Canceled | The service proposal was canceled by TSP/Seller |
# Notes 1. To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please make sure you have at least **one live (Status "on") service** under the related category. TSP can go to the **My service** page to double-check. 2. During the same period, **one** seller shop/account can only be signed with **one** TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with. 3. This new singing process will not affect existing authorization between TSP and the seller, but we recommend TSP to upload service details for existing authorization, especially the Live Management service. # FAQs ### Why does my service proposal show an error？ During the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. Please guide your seller to check on **My service** page to see if there is already an existing signed service proposal.
