Please note: This feature is currently in beta testing and is only available to selected TSPs by invitation. If you're interested in using it, please reach out to your account manager. # Introduction: What is the TSP Company Profile? To improve matchmaking efficiency between sellers and TSPs and help merchants to form a comprehensive understanding of TSPs, the TSP profile feature includes the following key functions: 1. Allows TSPs to manage their company profile information on the TikTok Shop Partner Center. 2. Upgrades the TSP Portal (Seller Center and independent website) from a service-level layout to a company-level layout, accommodating scenarios such as sorting, badging, ranking, etc. # What are the benefits？ TSPs can enhance their visibility to potential clients by effectively managing their profiles and showcasing their unique strengths.
# Steps ## Provide company profile information TSP can find the company profile information entrance on ++TikTok Shop Partner Center - Profile - company profile information++
When TSP publishes a new public service, TSPs will be required to provide company profile information before publishing.
After clicking the company profile card, TSP needs to provide related information. Note: 1. your profile information will be online directly after clicking submit, you can edit that information if needed. 2. Please make sure to provide accurate and appropriate information to help potential sellers better understand your capabilities and strengths. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e662e832cfe34173a1c4d9e7874a606a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Display TSP Profile on the TSP Portal After TSP submits TSP profile information, the Seller will be able to check that information on Seller Center-Agencies&Services. By clicking Learn more, sellers can visit the TSP profile page, where you can check comprehensive information, including: 1. **Partner basic information:** name, logo, company intro, location, contact information, etc 2. **Showcase:** TSPs' previous success stories 3. **Service:** Seller can check all services provided by TSP, and click service to check service details. 4. **Recently viewed companies** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/774fe3f829dd4e449f29bcdd9770b4ca~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8d1a399d9eba4f7e9ee20eabcf5df211~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: [US TSP] TSP Service Offer
detail.content:
# What is the Service Offer？ TSP Service allows TSPs to bundle service lists and offer authorization details for sellers to review and authorize. TSP will have two options to get authorization from the seller. **Option 1: Default authorization application** TSPs can share the “Default authorization application” link with the seller. The seller will need to select authorization details **Option 2: Prefill service offer [NEW]** TSPs can offer authorization details by clicking "pre-fill service offer", allowing sellers to either confirm or modify them as necessary. # Benefits of Service Offer 1. **Enhance authorization efficiency:** TSPs can offer authorization details, allowing sellers to choose without back-and-forth communication. 2. **Authorize multiple services at once:** Instead of authorizing services individually, sellers can now authorize entire TSP service packages through a single service offer. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c507b703e7fc4a3698f8fa0e5a95417d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # TSP Create Service offer TSP can navigate to the [TikTok Shop Partner Center > Seller Management > Create Service offer](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager?region=US) or go to the [APP& Service ](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/service/list/)> service detail page> pre-fill service order to create a service offer. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4fa3df8b773d4c8c8e127246ea10f3b7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d998a0483840474e89a0df77d01c7edb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
After clicking "Create Service offer" and offer the needed authorization, including: 1. **Select authorization service:** TSP can choose multiple services in one service offer(including public and custom service) 1. Note: TSP can only choose up to 10 services in one service offer. 2. **Choose service duration:** service start date and end date 3. **Contact info(optional):** Seller's contact information, can be skipped for the seller to fill 4. **Related authorization:** 1. **Authorize object:** Shop/TTUID or both 2. **Ticket authorization:** whether to enable TSP to raise tickets on behalf of Seller on TikTok Partner **Center** 3. **TSP Access:** whether to enable TSP to log into the seller center and operate related function 4. **Seller Center DATA Compass Auth:** whether to enable TSP to access data compass
# TSP shares the authorization link with the seller After creating a service offer, TSP can go to My service offer to manage all created service offers, and click "copy link" to share the seller with an authorization link
# Seller authorizes via service offer After receiving TSPs' service offer link, the seller can open the authorization link and check all TSP offered authorizations. The seller can choose to authorize with one click or edit based on need. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/216e64b04fa84407b5fdb6e67d5d6835~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/045a817086bd4681be3a01deed91b5ed~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a68a1e7ed1e6494dadc81ce693fa996e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/801c73dc21b445d1a89f7738dcb53149~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **FAQ** ### Q1: Will this service offer replace the existing authorization workflow? No, the service offered was an additional option for TSP to choose from. If TSP chooses the default authorization application, TSP can still share the authorization link with the seller, The Seller will need to authorize it themselves

detail.title: [US] Partner Submitted Seller Leads Pool
detail.content:
# Product Overview The Seller Leads Pool for partners, accessible within the Partner Center, provides a online centralized platform for partners to submit and manage their submitted seller leads. It is designed to streamline the lead validation, matching, and nomination process, enhancing efficiency in strategic key merchant (SKM) recruitment and onboarding. The system supports bulk lead submission, automated pre-validation, and provides actionable feedback for lead management. This system is available for partners which have joined Project Horizon in US. Check more about the project introduction. [[External] Project Horizon-Quarterly Incentive](https://bytedance.larkoffice.com/wiki/MaJZwCy4qi7GzXkL8TEcRGhGnkd) # Product Benefits The Seller Lead Pool submitted by partners provides two primary advantages: * **Enhanced Operational Efficiency and Compliance**: By migrating the lead management process from offline spreadsheets and manual communication to a centralized online system, it delivers significant improvements in compliance, efficiency, and convenience for all parties. * **Partner Empowerment in Seller development**: The system empowers partners by providing a streamlined tool for key seller recruitment and incubation. This enhances their operational leverage and productivity in identifying and onboarding high-potential sellers. # User Guide ## #1 Partner Submits Seller Leads | **Step** | **Process** | **Screenshot** | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | **Function entrance**

* Page entrance: Partner center - Seller management module - Seller leads pool - Partner submitted tab
* Page URL: https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/leads-pool?page=1®ion=US&searchParam=lead_status%3D1%26seller_type%3D2&size=10 | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ac1b8125acaf4e0c94301588b8a77f93~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 2 | **Upload seller leads and start pre-check.**

* Upload seller leads
* Click ‘Upload seller leads’ button.
* In Add seller leads page, click 'Download template' to export Excel file template.
* Fill in seller leads according to template fields and requirements. Upload the Excel file.
* Excel template fields as below. Please follow the definition in Excel file to understand the format requirements. Maximum submit 2,000 leads at a time.
* Lead name (Brand name): Compulsory
* Primary sales channel(eg: Amazon/DTC/others): Compulsory
* (DTC) Domain name
* Amazon seller ID
* Tiktok Shop code: maximum 3 shops
* If has Brand Authorization? Yes/ No": Compulsory
* BA Owner or 1st/2nd Authorization?
* Seller est. onboard date (Format: YYYYMM, eg: 202602): Compulsory
* Special Request for Category/AM
* Proof (e.g. copitch chat screenshot)
* Support needed | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/61e59deb39414ec5b6c3955e50ea0fdc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ab46c77bbf6b4c2594d9fff3cb9958b9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 3 | **Submit pre-checked seller leads.**

* Click 'Pre-check' button and get pre-check result.
* Precheck rules:
* The leads whose lead name is duplicated from previously submitted leads cannot be submitted.
* Compulsory fields cannot be empty.
* Fields values format should follow the rules.
* Check failed leads in the last column of exported excel file.
* Click 'Submit seller leads' button. Only leads passed pre-check can be submitted successfully. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9656dd3b7dfb4b3895b7add29829ad06~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## #2 Partner Checks Lead Match Results and Suggestions | **Step** | **Process** | **Screenshot** | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | **Lead and seller onboard Progress.**

* Check your 2026 cumulative lead and seller onboard progress in product subtitle. Hover to check the progress by quarter. If any question or want to know the onboarded lead and seller list, you can contact your SPM. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d9054f7f73d54b7caeb7ae195f05445c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | 2 | **Seller Lead list.**

* Leads can be filtered by match result status.
* Matched: can be found in Tiktok seller leads pool.
* Unmatched: cannot be found in Tiktok seller leads pool.
* In progress: leads are being matched by the system.
* You can search lead name, lead ID, and filter lead type and lead followup suggestions.
* Click 'Export button' to export info from both lead list page and lead details page. Both lead info and seller info will be exported so the lead info may be duplicated if a lead is associated with several shops.
* Check seller followup suggestions. Below are all lead suggestions.
1. **Matched Type 1: Congratulations. The lead is onboard successfully.**
1. Congratulations, you have successfully brought the official flagship store associated with this lead into TTS.
2. Congratulations, you have successfully brought the brand retailer store associated with this lead into TTS. However, if another partner acquires the brand flagship store associated with this lead to join TTS in this quarter, this lead will not be included in your lead onboard performance for this quarter.
3. Congratulations, you have successfully brought the white-label key merchant associated with this lead into TTS.
1. **Matched Type 2: The lead onboard is not completed yet. You can follow up the suggestion.**
1. This lead has already been successfully acquired by another partner with a brand retailer store joining TTS; you can still work on acquiring the brand official store for this lead.
2. This lead has been successfully matched with a TTS internal lead, but no partner has acquired it yet. You can follow the seller-level follow-up suggestions and continue working on this lead.
3. You have onboarded the lead related seller to TTS but you need to link 3 seller services to the seller.
1. **Matched Type 3: The lead has been onboarded by other partners or was onboarded in previous quarters. No further opportunity.**
1. This lead has already been successfully acquired by another partner and any further follow-up will not be counted toward your lead onboarding performance.
2. This lead has already been successfully acquired by another partner and a white-label key merchant has joined; any further follow-up on this lead will not be counted toward your lead onboarding performance.
3. This lead has already been acquired in previous quarters, and any further follow-up on this lead will not be counted toward your lead onboarding performance.
4. This lead has already been successfully acquired by another partner and is linking seller services to the partner. Any further follow-up will not be counted towards your lead onboarding performance.
1. **Unmatched Type: The lead cannot be found in TTS key seller leads pool.**
1. This lead currently can't be found in the TikTok Shop seller lead list. Contact your agency operation manager (SPM) offline to get it submitted. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/83f6a5753bdf4f36b54126b13b0ad16b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 3 | **Seller lead detail page.**

* Includes 3 parts: Lead info, Submitted seller info, Matched seller info.
* You can check the seller followup suggestions from your submitted sellers and matched sellers.
* Matched shops:
* If the seller lead you submitted is successfully matched with a TikTok Shop seller lead, the system will further identify strategic key merchants associated with each TikTok Shop lead.
* The matched shop names and their followup suggestions are provided. You can contact the shop in Tiktok app or from other offline channels. Shop contact info is not allowed to be shared in the product page.
* Seller lead follow up suggestions.
* **Shop binding subscription suggestions.**
* Congratulations, you have successfully brought this seller on board.
* Please partnership with the seller first then guide the seller on key seller nomination.
* This seller and the lead have already been successfully brought in by another partner. Please focus on other sellers and leads.
* This seller has passed the latest contract signing date defined in the TTS lead onboarding success criteria. You can still sign and cooperate with this seller, but such cooperation will not be counted toward your seller onboarding performance.
* Please link seller service with this seller before {Date}.
* This seller has not generated any sales yet. Please bind with this seller within 60 days after the seller starts generating sales.
* This seller first generated sales on {Date}. Please link with this seller within 60 days after the seller starts generating sales.
* Please complete three services and linking with the seller.
* **SKM seller nomination suggestions.**
* For Brand owner seller
* If the seller wants to become a brand official store, please follow this suggestion: This seller has not yet completed brand authorization for a brand official store. Please guide the seller to submit brand verification in Seller Center; for step-by-step guidance, refer to [How To Apply For Brand Authorization](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2419888845686570#EBCE00CE).
* For Retailer seller
* If the seller wants to become a brand retailer store, please follow the suggestions below:
* Please contact the agency operation manager SPM offline to submit proof that this seller's annual GMV on other platforms outside the site exceeds USD 10 million.
* This seller has not yet completed brand authorization as a retailer. Please guide the seller to submit brand authorization in Seller Center; for operational guidance, refer to [How To Apply For Brand Authorization](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2419888845686570#EBCE00CE).
* This seller has not yet listed products under this brand. Please guide the seller to list products and ensure the brand information in the product details is filled in correctly.
* For 10M+ seller:
* If the seller wants to become a white-label mega merchant, please follow the suggestions below: Please contact the agency operations SPM offline to learn about and submit the proof materials for this seller as a white-label merchant on off-platform channels.
* **Seller activation suggestions.**
* The seller voluntarily closes the shop. You can ask the seller to withdraw the shop closure request.
* You can assist the Seller in appealing the Shop Penalty and then complete seller services linking with the seller.
* The shop is already closed. The seller can only open a new shop.
* The seller’s onboarding application has been rejected. You can ask the seller to resubmit the application.
* The shop is newly created. You can ask the seller to complete the onboarding process.
* The onboarding application is under review; if the review is not completed for a long time, you can contact the corresponding operations to request an expedited review.
* TikTok Shop code is incorrect and cannot be found. Please provide the correct shop code. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ed8d12c6343f4fecbdb07a092773084c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 4 | **Edit seller leads info.**

* Click Edit button in Lead list page and Lead details page to edit a lead.
* You can share additional screenshot of Proof (e.g. Copitch chat screenshot) and Proof of 10M+ GMV. 1 image at most is allowed to upload in each of the 2 fields. You can combine multiple images into one before uploading.

| Edit lead button.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9544c518b14f4436b02169f4d84d14e6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: [US] TSP Service Details
detail.content:
# **Summary** To better measure the actual contribution of TSP to the Seller, the platform is now supporting TSP to upload Service Details. The platform will be able to check your information to verify your service. **Please note:** You can still work with the seller without service details. However, only authorizations with approved service details will be recognized as valid for GMV performance and will qualify for further platform incentives. # **Feature introduction** ## Step 1: Click the "Service Details" after getting authorization After getting authorization from the seller, TSP can visit [Seller management ➤ Service Details](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager/detail/7416067390716577578/contract?region=US) to create a Service Details for specific authorization.
## Step 2: Submit Service Details information To verify your service with a seller, please provide the actual service details, including the **service proof files and the service cycle** For service proof files, you can upload various forms of documentation as proof of your service. Acceptable types include official emails from the seller, permits from the seller, service contracts, or seller invoices. *The proof file uploaded should at least include: * Party names * Period * Service category * Signature from the seller For the service cycle, please match with your proof files and the real service period. By submitting, you confirm your submission is voluntary and your document does not contain confidential, sensitive, or personally identifiable information
## Step 3: Check the review status After uploading the Service Details-related information, TSP can go to the "Service Details" page to check the review status and manage the contract. Including View details, downloading contract files, and deleting and reuploading. Please note 1. Only Service Details in the pending review status can be deleted. 2. The Service Details can not be edited after they are approved.
For rejected service details, you can check "view details" to check the rejection reason and resubmit.
#### Approval status | Status | Description | | --- | --- | | Pending Review | After TSP submits the contract, the Service Details status changes to Pending Review, waiting for the TSP manager to approve. | | Approved | The TSP manager reviews and agrees to the Service Details terms, and the Service Details status is updated to approved. At this time, the Service Details can not be further edited. | | Rejected | TSP manager rejects the Service Details terms after review. Reasons for rejection are usually given, and TSP may need to modify and resubmit the Service Details based on feedback. | | Cancelled | The Service Details were canceled by TSP before or during the review process | | Deleted | The Service Details are deleted **by TSP** | # FAQ ## Q1: If I don't upload the TSP Service Details, will it impact my current authorization with the seller? No, it won't affect your existing authorization. However, it is required to calculate your incentives and assess your performance with TikTok Shop. For more details on the policy, please reach out to your TSP Manager. ## Q2: What would happen to the service details if the seller cancels the authorization or the TikTok shop account is unbonded？ It will not affect the service details, which have already been uploaded. ## Q3: Can I edit the contract after I upload it？ If your Service Details are approved, you can not edit the contract again. If your Service Details is under review, you can delete your Service Details and upload it again.

detail.title: [US] TSP-Seller Service Online Signing Process
detail.content:
# Introduction: What is Seller Service Online Signing? Seller Service Online Signing is a feature that allows TSPs to establish online signing relationships with sellers. # What are the benefits？ * **Smoother Workflow:** TSPs can initiate a **single** or **multiple service** proposal, which the seller can then review and confirm. * **Official Signing:** By detailing service specifics and related information, TSPs can establish official signing relationships with sellers, ensuring clear communication and agreed-upon terms. # What's the workflow？ ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/41e3a3607af1418b89747e789cd5e2b2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Steps ### Step 1: Create a service proposal To build an official service relationship with the seller, TSP can navigate to the [Seller Management-Create Service proposal](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager?region=US) page to check authorization and create a new service proposal. Note: To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please ensure you have at least one approved service (Status: On) under the related category. TSP can go to the[ APP & Service](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/service/list/?tab=4) page to double-check. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/345dcfdc72274f9583463ec2c3379bda~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) TSP can provide signing information for seller checking and signing off, which includes: 1. **Seller Information:** TSP can select a seller by either **shop name** or **shop code.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a2347edc16d445ca9cb6626aba211978~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Select Service Details:** TSP has the option to select either a single service or multiple service categories, which include *Live Management*, Seller *affiliate Management*, *Shop Management*, and Short Video Management. For service proposal details, TSP needs to provide the related information as specified below. TSP also can select service group which includes all 4 seller services. **Option 1: Fill a single service proposal detail**
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f5e5c0b6d024479997d7b53615265af1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
**Option 2: Batch fill multiple service proposal details:** Selecting "Batch fill service proposal details" means uploading a service detail file that covers multiple services, allowing sellers to go through the approval process of proposal signing only once.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b822df182465492d93f3aeb9867c31e9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/962f68cfd8454a5caa827fc6c7d37993~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Proposal Details** | LIVE management | Short Video management | Seller affiliate management | Shop management | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Service period:** TSP needs to choose a start and end date for the service that aligns with the actual service cycle. | Required | Required | Required | Required | | **Permission needed:** TSP can choose the permission needed for this service, which includes:
**Shop Ticket** - Enable TSPs to submit a ticket on behalf of the seller
**Shop-level Data analysis**- Enable TSP to check seller shop-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center
**Account-level Data analysis**- Enable TSP to check seller account-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center (*only for Live management or short video management）
**Seller Center Access** - Enable TSP to log into the seller center and take further action
**Seller Center Message** - Enable TSP to check the seller violation message in Seller Center
**Seller Center Analytics Access**- Enable TSP to log into the seller center and check the data compass on TikTok Shop Partner Center | Required
| Required
| Required | Required | | **Seller's TikTok account:** TSP needs to select the serviced seller account by account name | Required | Required | No need | No need | | **Management period:** TSPs are required to select the actual management period for each TikTok account. | Required | Required | No need | No need | | **Affiliate GMV type:** TSP needs to choose their affiliate service type, including target/open/TAP campaign | No need | No need | Required | No need | | **Service details:** Upload various forms of documentation as proof of your service. Acceptable types include official emails from the seller, permits from the seller, service contracts, or seller invoices. | Optional | Optional | Optional | Optional | **Please note:** during the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with.
### Step 2: Seller views and signs the proposal After creating a service proposal, TSP can share the proposal link with the seller to sign.
When the seller opens the proposal link, they can view the service proposal, which includes basic information about the TSP and detailed service offerings across various categories. After reviewing, the seller has the option to either reject or accept the proposal. If accepted, the seller and TSP will officially be signed up for the specific service. **Please note:** Sellers are not able to modify the proposal. If there are any questions or concerns about the service proposal, sellers can contact TSP.
### Step 3: Check and manage the sign details After signing, the seller can go to my services page to view all signing details. By clicking View the Details, the seller can check the detailed signing information
TSP can navigate to the [seller management-service proposals](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/order/serviceMerchantManager?region=US) page to check all signing information ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cb303477177a4e94a113646194a65ae1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***How to renew the signing with the Seller？** TSPs have the option to select the 'Extend' button to create a renewal application. They can then edit the new service period. After making these adjustments, TSPs can share the signing link with the seller for review and approval. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0d39b3a2b27f4028a3800cf3143730a2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/76a989c94bae4d2980e1c8fdb0634a54~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***How to cancel the existing signing with the seller？** TSP can navigate to TikTok Shop Partner Center-> Seller Management and click delete to raise a cancel signing request.
After a TSP initiates a cancellation, the seller can view the request on the My Service page: 1. If the seller chooses "Agree," the authorization will be canceled immediately. 2. If the seller chooses "Reject," the authorization will remain valid. You may contact the seller or resubmit your request after 144 hours. 3. **If the seller does not respond within 72 hours, the authorization will be automatically canceled.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3af05f40627d45d683702b9bab118fac~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9d5ec310383e485b89fe939dca490100~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) *Signing Status | | Definition | | --- | --- | | Rejected | The service proposal was rejected by the seller | | Wait for confirmation | Service proposals are waiting for the seller to review. TSP can cancel the proposal at this stage. | | Partially confirm | Part of the service proposal was accepted by TSP., TSP can check and add a new service proposal if needed. | | Canceled | The service proposal was canceled by TSP/Seller |
# Notes 1. To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please make sure you have at least **one live (Status "on") service** under the related category. TSP can go to the **My service** page to double-check. 2. During the same period, **one** seller shop/account can only be signed with **one** TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with. 3. This new singing process will not affect existing authorization between TSP and the seller, but we recommend TSP to upload service details for existing authorization, especially the Live Management service. # FAQs ### Why does my service proposal show an error？ During the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. Please guide your seller to check on **My service** page to see if there is already an existing signed service proposal.

detail.title: [US]Expand to All 3 Partner Services to Unlock Tier Growth & Benefits
detail.content:
Dear Partner,
We encourage you to expand and activate all three partner service categories in Partner Center: **Creator Matchmaking, Seller Service,** and **Creator Service.** Doing so allows you to unlock more collaboration opportunities and can help you grow your business more effectively.

By offering more comprehensive services, you not only provide end-to-end support to sellers and creators but also improve the chances of reaching a higher TSP Tier. 
Partners offering a single service have their final score calculated with a 90% service weight, while those offering multiple services benefit from an average score across services, multiplied by a higher weight of 110% to 130%. This increased weight gives multi-service partners a stronger advantage in tier evaluation, unlocking higher ranking, operational protection, marketing support, and more collaboration opportunities. 
*For more details on tier calculation and benefits, please refer to the information provided here: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/68411b45314d2504a1a7c407

To activate new service categories:
Go to Partner Center > My Account > Service Category and register the services you'd like to provide.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d2dd422441834328b9a57b88ade776dc~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
If you have any questions, feel free to raise a ticket through[ Partner Center > Tickets](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/contact-us).

detail.content:
> More guidance for TSP in TTSPC: [Guide for TSP on TikTok Shop Partner Center](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/Tkjtdv9Hxo3cIuxJHjic3GNQnof) > If you have an MCN Role, Data Authorization process can refer to this Doc: [【MCN SEA+UK】TTSPC Data Compass Playbook](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/PZYFdWlAeoYLtyx1NvgcuHsJnsf) # What ability can be provided by data compass? ## Product Feature ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1ec1ee679e84062879b5cac0d2dd51c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # ❗️Important Notice for New TTSPC Users： ## Data Authorization ： For agencies, please note that in order for you to view this data, the seller has to authorize this service. This means that the seller must authorize their shop or TikTok account **(only official or marketing accounts)** with you. However, if the seller chooses to authorize the [Shop Management] service only, you will not be able to view the data of the whole shop or official or marketing accounts. Only when sellers select the [content management], can the TSP view data of official or marketing accounts. After using the New TTSPC, we regard the bound time as data authorization time, if the seller hasn't authorized data to the TSP but is already bound with TSP, or the authorization date is later than the bound date, the data time range the TSP can view begins from the bound date. No other data authorization process is needed. ### 1、Guide Seller to authorizes the service For seller's guidebook:[Service Market Guide](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/WWkAdTCRDoqLzZxsrZ7cR7g9nTb) How to get a service from seller side？
#### Step 1 Choose a service ① For Public service Seller can go to **[ Seller Center] ➤[Services] ➤ [Services Market] to view public service published by agencies.** * Seller can search for service by(service name,category, or description)and filter service by service category. * Seller can also find service through most popular services and recommended services (listings with stars). ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f5fc8e844aec4febaca84acf019a3325~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/501c8d3eee35415d9bdab076c9b2ee20~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) After clicking the service, the seller can go to the service detailed page to check your service.
② For custom service and public service shared by authorization link After you share the authorization link with sellers, by clicking the authorization link, seller can login to the seller center and will be directed to the your service detail page. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7646e127dfec481493e30c3a785b7d28~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/47385249bb444e218a8146994234458c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/03c00873e6024ddab53088fb17e4ee37~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### Step 2 Authorize service Seller can start to using your service and authorize data by authorize feature. 1. Seller can click "Authorize" button on the service detail page after they settle down to use your service. 2. Seller needs to fill in the required information, including: 1. Authorize duration ( maximum duration is one year） 1. Note：The authorization date can only be counted from the day of authorization. if the seller authorization on Nov 3, they cannot choose the authorized time starting from Nov 10. 2. Based on the corresponding authorization needs of category. Seller needs authorized shop or TikTok accounts**( only official or marketing accounts) and** also necessary data **** with TSP. 3. Contact email and phone number(optional) 3. By clicking "Confirm" and the authorization is completed and you can start to provide service to seller and track the data. Note： ① After seller authorizes the service, the service authorization will be valid immediately ② if seller wants to modify the authorization information, they need to deauthorize the current service and then reauthorize this service again ③ During the valid authorization date, sellers cannot authorize the same service once more. ④ Seller can't authorize same Shop ID nor same TT UID to different agencies. Eg. If seller has already authorized the A UID with agency A, then this UID can't be authorized by other agencies. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/598041db19e14f39a54ae8153b450451~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b9773e6db48044e69fc3f9275a444b36~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ac4219c2af89477a86575f5dad69032d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) #### Step 3 Seller manages the authorizations Seller can go to **[ Seller Center] ➤[Services] ➤ [Manages authorizations]** to manages the authorizations.
Authorizations status | Status terminology | Definition | | --- | --- | | Active | Authorization with the seller is active. | | Completed | Authorization with the seller has expired. | | Authorization Canceled | You have canceled your authorization with the seller. | | Closed | The seller has been removed from platform due to violation of the platform policies. Agency authorization with the seller has been deactivated. | Note ： The seller can deauthorize with agencies during the authorization period, before deauthorizing, *After deauthorizing, agencies will receive an email outlining that they will not be able to access data under this service.
### Partner Manage the authorization You can go to [Authorization management] to check authorization details. * You can search for authorization by authorization ID * Click service . You can go to the detailed service page * Click "view details" and you can go to the order detailed page.
Different status of authorization | Authorized | Completed | Cancelled | Banned | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Service was authorized by sellers and is not expired | Authorization time expired | Authorization canceled by sellers | Service was closed by system | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6b85ecaf35d4470a876571409f36aaa1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/775c09da5445447abf259c7d91165259~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0fb5141bb93541f5838c05504562a857~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fb62354882874c5ca1872e1cced53555~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## History Data in old Partner Platform: 1. For sellers who already authorized the service and data to agency, the available time period of data will be same as the old platform. 2. For seller accounts which have been bound with the agency, these seller accounts data will be moved to the new TTSPC. 3. If the bound relationship expires when the TSP move to the TTSPC, the TSP can't view the data of this seller. ## Change between different agency roles and markets * If an agency has both TSP and MCN dual identities, the agency can click on the name logo in the upper right corner and click on it to switch to TSP/MCN identity, while the devolved data, too, will change according to the account data bound to different identities. * For agencies who operate in different markets, the agency can click on the name logo in the upper right corner and switch to different markets to check market performance. * Notice: the agency can only check one role performance in one market at one time.
(Note: All screenshot is for reference only and uses a test account with mock data. The actual interface and features may differ.) # Data Function Introduction: **++Shop vs Account level data++** For all Partners that are **++not++** under the Shop Management category, you will notice differences in GMV data between Partner Centre and Seller Centre. This is because, as a TikTok Shop Partner (TSP), when you bind to a seller, the GMV data displayed to you in the Partner Centre is only at **++Account++** level. However, the GMV data displayed on Seller Center is at **++Shop++** level. **++What are the differences in calculation between Account level and Shop level data?++** A seller can have up to 5 accounts: 1 Official Account + 4 Marketing Account Therefore Shop level data includes GMV from **++all the accounts++** associated with the seller, including the Shop Page. However, as a TSP, you might only bind to the sellers Marketing Account, which means in the Partner Centre you only see Marketing Account level data. ++For example (see image below):++ You are a TSP operating under the Content Management service category and are interested in Seller A who has 1 Official Account and 2 Marketing Accounts. However, you only bind to the 2 Marketing Accounts of Seller A. Therefore, you will see differences in GMV data between Seller A's Seller Centre data (where total GMV will include GMV from the 1 Official Account and 2 Marketing Accounts) and the GMV data you see on Partner Centre (which only includes GMV from 2 Marketing Accounts). # **Data Overview** How to use Data Overview? * To understand the overall transaction performance and sales rate of the seller related accounts, and to see the percentage of sellers with sales, to determine the activity of its sellers and their ability to sell goods. * Analyze the live/video content channels to analyze the ability of the seller to sell goods, the number of content releases and the CTR conversion rate. **++Content Type GMV Attribution++** GMV for sellers will be calculated based on 3 content types, which means now: **** * **100% GMV (Direct GMV) = Live + Video + Product Card** This means that for sellers, GMV will be attributed to the last content type that a buyer clicked on when checking out a product. *(Reminder: Product Cards are cards that display everything a customer needs to know about a product, like its title, image, and price).* All Seller Transaction related metrics such as GMV, C_O, GPM on every module are calculated using this Content Type GMV Attribution. ++For example:++ Buyer A watched a LIVE session promoting an iPhone 15 and adds the iPhone 15 to cart > Buyer A checks out the iPhone 15 from the cart 2 days later > GMV from the iPhone 15 goes to **LIVE**. *Please note, there will be no changes to how Affiliate GMV is calculated, which means that there will be no changes to how commission paid to Affiliates.* ## Core Data * **Livestreaming Partners:** The number of partners that have livestreamed during the selected period * **Active Rate:** (Active Live Partners/ Partners) * 100% * **Partners with Sales:** The number of partners that generated in revenue during the selected period * **Sales Rate:** (Partners with Sales/ Partners) * 100% ## GMV trend * **Direct GMV:** This is the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from LIVEs + Videos + Product Card, including returns and refunds. * **LIVE Direct GMV:** LIVE direct GMV is the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from LIVEs, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is calculated based on the last clicked livestream and excludes any form of attributed GMV * **LIVE Avg. Direct GMV**: LIVE Direct GMV/ LIVE stream * **Direct Refund GMV:** The cumulative amount refunded to buyers during the selected period based on Direct GMV achieved. This means that the Refund GMV only calculates GMV from refunded orders based on buyer's last clicked content type and excludes any form of refunded orders from attributed GMV. * **Video Direct GMV:** Video direct GMV is the total amount paid for orders placed directly from videos, including returns and refunds. This means that GMV is only calculated based on the last clicked video and excludes any form of attributed GMV ## Livestream * **LIVE Orders:** The number of orders created and paid by users from partners LIVE streams * **LIVE Product Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from Live streams by partners during the selected period * **Livestreams:** The number of in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * **LIVE Duration:** The cumulative duration of in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * **LIVE Avg. CTR:** (Number of product clicks / number of livestream views) / livestreams ## EC video trend * **Video Orders:** The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from partner videos * **Video Product Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from partner videos during the selected period * **Videos**: The number of videos posted by partners during the selected period * **Avg. CTR:** (Number of product clicks / number of video views) / number of videos
## Q&A 1. Will I see a change in GMV if I use this as a performance metric? Yes, you might see changes in the GMV values for LIVE and Video because of the way the GMV is attributed with the Content Type GMV Attribution. # **Shop Analytics** This tab is visible to TSPs operating under the Shop Management category ++only++. ## Shop Analytics In the Shop Analytics section, you will be able to get a breakdown of the metrics shown in the below image. The Direct GMV figures listed here mirror the ones displayed on the Seller Center. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fb35d50d49b347ed9d3880916cf7d3ab~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/68766f6ce7c541b4b6e464c5c254afac~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **Livestream analytics** Use cases * Partner portal live screen: support to view live & real-time data of multiple sellers at the same time * Review the live data: support viewing the historical live data of its sellers * Authorization of the seller data: Only after the agency obtains the permission of the seller data, can it check the data of its sellers ## **Ongoing livestreams** There are sellers on LIVE：
* **For agencies that have obtained data authorization**, you will be able to see the following metrics for the chosen seller: * **Direct GMV:** This is the total amount paid for orders that are placed directly from LIVEs including returns and refunds. * **Viewers:** The number of viewers watching the LIVE stream * **Sales:** The cumulative number of products sold from seller LIVE stream during the selected period * **Orders created:** The number of SKU orders created by users from LIVE stream * **Product Clicks:** The number of clicks to the promoted Product * **Order paid:** The number of SKU orders paid by users from LIVE stream * **Product Impressions:** The number of views to the promoted Product * **For those who have not obtained data permission**, the button to apply for permission will be displayed for you. However note that regardless of the data permission, agencies can view the seller's live page, comments and commodity since this information is already displayed publicly during the LIVE.
When you click on any live card, more detailed information will be displayed as shown below.
If you click on the LIVE screen button (as displayed on the green background), you are able to to get more information about the creator via the Live Dashboard. ## **Live Dashbaord** We have 2 versions of Live Dashboard available - Basic and Advanced. Here you can monitor real-time live performance of live as it's happening or monitor performance of historic lives you have hosted.
* Core transactions and traffic metrics are outlined in the below image
* You can also view the breakdown information for every product's sales & conversion rate
* Traffic source
After live ends, you can also replay livestream to recap live comments and host performances.
## **All livestreams** Under the **All livestreams** option, you can select a seller to view their **current and historical livestreams.** * The new direct logic is applied when calculating the following: Direct GMV, Items Sold.
## Q&A 1. Why are the common data indicators in the live room floating? * Each data indicator will be compared with the last five minutes and updated every minute 2. How many sellers can get onto the live screen at the same time? * Max 5 3. What is the query range of the historical live room data? * The live room which is after signing the contract can be found, and the live room data during the contract time will be provided. * Example: Seller A signs a contract with the an agency on May 1, 2020, then seller A terminates the contract on October 1, and finally re-signs on July 1, 2021. This way the agency can apply for 01/04/2020 - 01/10/2020 time period and 01/07/2021 - current time period for data permissions. # **Creator analytics** Use cases 1. **Master the content production ability of sellers** By intuitively showing CTR、CO、RPM indicators, seller analysis can help agencies analyze the content output quality of the sellers. 2. **Analyze the performance of sellers** Showing the exposure, conversion and transaction efficiency of all sellers in both live/video can help agencies quickly grasp the content attractiveness and the ability to monetize the goods of the sellers, so that determines the long-term cooperation strategy of the talents and agencies. 3. **Tracking commission income** Seller analysis can help agencies understand the commission income of different sellers to get out the total income of the agencies. ## Creator data In the Partner Centre, go to **Analytics**, then **Creator Analytics.** Data of all authorized sellers will be shown here. If you go to **Metrics**, you can select what you would like to view for all sellers who have authorized data. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/66d055e4f5b3433b823c45dcef636150~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/aebdee67f9444f62b822bb3fa16290ad~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # **Video Analytics** The new video analytics on the [partner platform](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/partner/partner-settle/welcome?type=register) helps agencies get a comprehensive view of the video performance of managed sellers, measure their diligence, content creativity, content popularity and ability to deliver products. This feature is built to enhance seller management efficiency. Use cases 1. **Mastering the overall performance of seller videos** Agencies can view the amount of transactions, commission income and video releases brought by videos in any period of the last 3 months, and also support viewing the trend of transactions and video releases in the period to help agencies grasp the diligence and ability of the seller to sell products. 2. **Understand the number of videos posted and the video carrying capacity of each seller** Agencies can filter by account to view the video posting of different sellers and their performance in bringing products, and at the same time, they can view the performance of the daily videos of the sellers, so that they can promptly explore the explosive videos for marketing promotion. 3. **Understand the content of each video/ deal performance and closing/ watching user profile** Understand the transaction/attraction revenue and promotion effect of the short video channels of the sellers within the statistical time, conveniently learn the similar short video production experience of the excellent sellers, understand the video's viewer and transaction user profile, and the difference between different people. ## Core Data | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | 1. When you select a seller, you can view their performance
1. Core Indicators you can view are:
1. Direct GMV
2. Product Sales
3. Videos
2. You can select 2 indicators and compare the metrics' trends. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/aa323b2b00ff4fb4b09e04e29378e7a7~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## **Video list** | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | 1. In the Videos list, you can view individual videos for the seller you have selected
2. You can view the **Start time** and **Duration** of the videos as well as the following:
1. Views
2. Direct GMV
3. Product Sales
4. Completion rate
5. RPM (Revenue per 1,000 videos)
3. On the right hand side of each video, you can view the product that is being promoted in the video
4. You can select **Export** to download the information listed on this page
5. For ease, you can also **search** by **video name** or **product name** to quickly find a specific video you might be searching for
6. If you click on **Video detail** (highlighted in green), you can further details for each video as explained in the below section | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b7db980024e04eecab4acd6fdbab1e08~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## **Video Detail** ### Transaction Analysis | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | * The basic information of a short video includes:
* Release time
* Duration
* Music info
* Video labels (hastags, titles etc)
* Click the video picture/ play button to play the video | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6ee7369f08a246ae8fea89990e2ae760~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | * Select **All/ Individual product** to view the following metrics:
* Direct GMV
* RPM
* Product Sales
* CTR
* C_O (click to order)


To view the graph, you can select up to two metrics at the same time | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/95117f2d77a442b48dd134b198240c57~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | * At the bottom of the page, you will see the section: **Videos of the same product with higher revenue**
* This showcases **popular videos of the same product** published on TikTok
* These videos are displayed in this section as they have the highest revenue among all videos selling the product (including the short videos of the seller and all other creators)
* The aim is to allow the Merchant to learn how to make excellent videos with the same product
* The metrics you can see are:
* CTR
* Views
* Likes
* Comments | | ### Content Analysis | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | The content analysis section includes the following metrics:

* Video view (VV)
* Finish rate
* New followers
* Shares
* Comments
* Likes


To view the graph, you can select up to two metrics at the same time | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/71c153b2f3964cf1b321dd91d6feaa90~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ### Audience Analysis | **Details** | **Product display** | | --- | --- | | * User Profile
* Shows the age, gender, country & region distribution of users watching the video within the selected time range
* New followers profile
* Show the age, gender, country & region distribution of new followers from the video within the selected time range | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1658283a1a24fe6acbd2002ef841b3e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ## Q&A 1. Why is it impossible to see video details for some video? * Videos, whose status are set to private or deleted, do not support playback and cannot display video pictures; * Videos, whose status are set to private and have never been made public, have no transaction or content data; 2. Why are the recommended videos with high revenue not shown in the transaction analysis in the video detail page? * For videos with multiple product links, you need to select one product in the video detail page-transaction analysis, and the video of the TOP3 revenue amount in all videos (including the sellers own short video and creators short videos) with the same product will be displayed below the transaction analysis. # [Product Analytics](https://bytedance.feishu.cn/docx/JpKndokROoqcR0xVbJwcWwH3nVe) Use cases **🔥Scenario 1: Monitor every seller's product sales performance** Partners can view the overall sales, commission income, and sales trends of specific accounts for the selected time period by selecting different accounts. By viewing the sales trends of products, you can understand the changes in a specific account's output and ability to sell goods. You can also spot accounts which are displaying a significant decrease in their ability to sell goods
**🔥Scenario 2: View the sales performance of sellers contributing to different shops** Agencies can view the sales performance of different accounts for different stores. If there is a GMV target for the sales performance of different accounts when cooperating with a shop, you can check whether a seller has reached their target by filtering by the corresponding store **🔥Scenario 3: Find the best selling product of a specific account** You can view the performance of all the products sold by each account in terms of transactions, impressions, clicks, conversions, negative reviews, complaints, refunds, and so on, to find the most suitable types of product sold by that account and help them to optimize their product selection strategies ## Select time period You can choose to view data from the previous 6 months, the last 28 days, the last 7 days, specific days, weeks or months, and custom time periods Notes: 1. When a custom time period is selected, UV indicators (Buyers and Viewers) are not displayed 2. If the account has not been authorized to view the data for the selected time period, the data cannot be viewed when the time period is selected
## Core data You can select an account and view the performance over a set period of time. The metrics you can see are: * Direct GMV = LIVE + VIDEO + Product Card * Product Sales * Orders Select up to 2 indicators at a time to view the trends
## Metrics If you click on **Metrics**, you can select different metrics to see the performance of different products. You can select from various filters as highlighted in the screenshot below ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5b8a88cffb634fed96a77ac448235932~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5523234ba93049e5abbb129e975344ec~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## 6.4 Product Details If you click on **View details** (highlighted in green), you will be redirected to the **Product Details** page which provides the breakdown of individual products and provides information on **Product** **Performance, Channel Analytics and User Analytics.** Please note all transaction related metrics under the [Product Details] section are calculated using the old Commission Based Attribution logic. However, this logic will be updated at a later date to ensure consistency with the other metrics. * **Product Performance -** this supports agencies in gathering more detailed data of the product:
* **Channel Analysis** * By splitting the merchandise transactions according to the Creator dimension, you can view the individual Creator's: * Revenue, Percentage of transactions（*The proportion of the transaction amount of the goods delivered by the person in the selected time period to the total transaction amount of the goods*）, Orders, Item Sold, Buyers * Split the product transaction by transaction channel, you can view the product in different channels: * revenue, Percentage of transactions, Orders, Item Sold, Buyers,CTR，C_O * Support to view the video with the most transactions for the product, click on the video details to jump to the video analysis page * revenue, orders, item sold, buyers * Support viewing the livestream with the most transactions for the product.： * live-stream room name, start time, creator name&picture of this livestream, revenue, orders, item sold, buyers
```Plain * User Analysis - you can use the information in this section to identify the types of people that are likely to purchase the product and identify the demographics of the product. ```

detail.title: [TSP US]TTSPC Data Compass Playbook
detail.content:
### Update Table | **Date** | **Updates** | | --- | --- | | 2024.6.13 | **Simplified and streamlined Seller Center Access:** TSPs can effortlessly share a request for Seller Center access with sellers and obtain authorization. **** After authorization, TSPs can access Seller Center directly from the Partner Center ++with just one click.++
TSPs are allowed to access up to **six months** of historical data now. | | 2024.05 | Launched **Shop Analytics** to provide shop overall metrics and GMV attribution analytics for shop-level bound TSPs | | 2024.04 | Launched **Video Inspiration** for TTSPC brings agency partners relevant data and tons of ideas for creating highly engaging content and optimizing video creation strategy. | | 2024.3.20 | GMV attribution logic changed to the new one:
**100%GMV(Direct GMV)=Live +Video Product Card** | **For an overview of the changes in how Shop GMV is calculated, please refer to the link:** [GMV Refactoring One Pager](65f9d64a8de0b902be263a5c) # 🔥🔥What ability can be provided by Data Analytics? ## Product Feature ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/736af43823b1419dabf7eb62595b149c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Service Category x Data Analytics Feature Map | **First Category** | **Partner Role** | **Secondary category** | **Service Description** | **What Analytics modules can partner access？** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Creator Service | Creator Service Partner | Creator Management | Emphasizes deep creator relationships through:
- Educational support, resource provision, and hands-on guidance for SV and live - streaming (especially live sessions).
Responsibility for creator incubation, upgrading their level from novice to top-tier. | Data Overview, Live Analytics, Video Analytics, Product Analytics, Creator Analytics, Custom Report | | Seller Service

GMV (Livestreams): GMV (Livestreaming) / Livestreams * GMV (Refunds): The cumulative amount successfully refunded to buyers during the selected period 3. **Show the live sales & conversion trend** * Livestreams: The number of in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * Duration: The cumulative duration of in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * Orders: The number of orders created and paid by users from all partners' in-house livestreams/livestreams * Product Sales: The cumulative number of products sold from in-house livestreams/livestreams by partners during the selected period * Avg. CTR: (Number of product clicks / number of livestream views) / livestreams 4. **Show the video sales & conversion trend** * Videos: The number of videos posted by partners during the selected period * Orders: The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from partner videos * Product Sales: The cumulative number of products sold from partner videos during the selected period * Avg. CTR: (Number of product clicks / number of video views) / number of videos

We have updated the Shop Analytics tab to provide you with a new GMV section. This will show the overall GMV for all sellers who have authorised you to view their data. The Direct GMV figures listed here mirror the ones displayed on the Seller Center. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/51a9c967d12445bdae35a312c960a757~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Aggregated Metrics** Under the GMV overview section you will see the following aggregated metrics. 1. **GMV:** This will display total GMV aggregated from all accounts. 1. *Definition: Total amount paid for orders during the selected period, including cancelled and refunded orders.* 2. **LIVE GMV:** This will display the LIVE GMV at a shop level aggregated from all accounts and sources. 1. *Definition: The total amount paid for orders placed directly from LIVEs, including returns and refunds.* 3. **Video GMV:** This will display the Video GMV at a shop level aggregated from all accounts and sources. 1. *Definition: The total amount paid for orders placed directly from shoppable videos, including returns and refunds.* 4. **Product Card:** This will display the Product Card GMV at a shop level aggregated from all accounts and sources. There are several sources of Product Card GMV: Search, Recommendations, Shop Tab, Showcase, Store. 1. *Definition: The total amount paid for orders placed directly from product cards, including returns and refunds.* When you click on a metric you will see the corresponding trend data for that metric being reflected in the graph. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/137fb4d80f7d49f5bb149b4afd3d06ea~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Period Comparison** You can enable the **[Compare with previous period]** button which will display % comparisons for each data metric and will compare to previous period. If your **current date range** was for **Q1 2024**, the **comparison period** will be **Q4 2023**

If the account has not been authorized to view the data for the selected time period, the data cannot be viewed when the time period is selected. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6ec568ba3e574430bd6222e0fc81d236~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. **Select account** Agencies can select different accounts to view their performance over a set period of time and compare the previous cycle's indicator fluctuations, with the following core indicators. * Revenue * Products：the number of products with sales during the selected period * Items sold * Orders 3. **Select up to 2 indicators at a time to view the trends.**
4. **Product sales performance** Partners can view the transaction performance of different products across different channels, the overall conversion performance, the negative review rate, number of refunds and complaint rate. * Transaction performance: Revenue, Refund, Commission, Buyers, Orders, Items Sold, Refund unit sales for all channels * LIVE: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Video: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Showcase: Revenue, Buyers, Items Sold * Traffic and conversion performance: Views, Viewers, Product clicks, CTR, C_O * Product quality performance: Return rate, negative review rate, complaint rate NOTE: Newly added the "Export" function right after the button "Metrics". ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/671d0bce733d426c92fcbf479971e085~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9ab365cad8274fcf9a7f35af9cf78f92~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 5. **View product transaction, channel and user analysis** Organizations can click on the product's [Details] to enter the details page to view the performance of individual products. * **Transaction Analysis** * Support agencies to view the effect data of commodities: * Transaction performance：Revenue, Orders, Item sold, Buyers * Refund performance：Refund revenue, Refund orders, Refund item sold * Traffic performance：Views, Viewers, Product Clicks, CTR, C_O * Product quality：Return rate, Negative review rate, complaint rate
* **Channel Analysis** * By splitting the merchandise transactions according to the Creator dimension, you can view the individual Creator's: * revenue, Percentage of transactions（*The proportion of the transaction amount of the goods delivered by the person in the selected time period to the total transaction amount of the goods*）, Orders, Item Sold, Buyers * Split the product transaction by transaction channel, you can view the product in different channels: * revenue, Percentage of transactions, Orders, Item Sold, Buyers,CTR，C_O * Support to view the video with the most transactions for the product, click on the video details to jump to the video analysis page * revenue, orders, item sold, buyers * Support viewing the livestream with the most transactions for the product.： * live-stream room name, start time, creator name&picture of this livestream, revenue, orders, item sold, buyers
* **User Profile** * Show the conversion rate between Product viewers-Product click user \ Product click user-Buyers \ Product viewers-Buyers respectively, and show the trend of this User by day in the selected time period on the right * Support viewing user portraits by product impression, product click, and product buyers： * Age: 18-24, 25-34, 35+, Unknown * Gender: Male, Female, Others **ONLY** show profile when the total group users are over 1000
# Video inspirations ## High level overview Ready to be inspired? Video Inspiration for TTSPC brings agency partners relevant data and tons of ideas for creating highly engaging content and optimizing their video creation strategy. 📈 Visibility on **critical metrics and data from top ranked videos, music and hashtags** to help you understand successful content trends. 💬 **Identifying drivers** for fostering engagement and transaction and **recommendations** on how to make your videos more engaging. 🔬 Drilldown on interaction patterns for top ranking videos to **understand detailed trends in user engagement.** ## Feature value proposition Video inspirations within TTSPC are intended to provide users with the insights and recommendations required to produce highly engaging and shoppable content. Users can benefit from: 1. Insights and metrics from high-performing videos across categories and date ranges that allows TTSPC users to benchmark their own content against performant and successful shoppable videos. 2. Recommendations and inspiration for scripting and conversation points that can unlock higher engagement and ultimately boost conversion. 3. Visibility on other aspects of high-performance content (e.g. music, hashtags) that will increase are likely to increase impressions and conversion for published shoppable videos. Ultimately, Video Inspiration for TTSPC aims to empower TTS partners with deriving insights and understanding the drivers behind creating content that will foster engagement and conversion for their managed creators and sellers.

detail.content:
For other languages, please see below: MY: [[User Manual] Analitik Live TSP & MCN - MY](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/NgDkdWxrZovLROxeC2Pl4qpVgRh) VN: [[User Manual] Phân Tích LIVE dành cho TSP & MCN](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/ZJF3dtz6NouEKYxcDeTlMfTcgHb?from=from_copylink) TH: [[User Manual] การวิเคราะห์ไลฟ์สำหรับพาร์ทเนอร์ TikTok Shop (TSP) และเครือข่ายหลายช่องทาง (MCN)](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/KWqLdbNvcoiqjkxOVOvlN6hlgzf?from=from_copylink) ID: [[User Manual] Analitik LIVE TSP & MCN](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/Ob14d0B6Fola8ExAgD6l0U2UgRg?from=from_copylink) # **Overview** For **CAP Agencies** managing multiple LIVE simultaneously, it is essential to have a clear and streamlined way to monitor all creators' LIVE performances at a glance. The new **LIVE Analytics** feature with upgraded **LIVE Dashboard** page on TikTok Shop Partner Center, enables CAP Agencies with **an overview of all ongoing and completed livestreams**, helping them quickly identify any livestreams or creators that may need support. Navigate to: [Partner Center > Analytics > LIVE Analytics](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/compass/live-analysis) # **What is LIVE Analytics?**
**LIVE Analytics** is a one-stop hub where CAP Agencies can: 1. View all sellers and creators' ongoing livestreams and get a high level overview of each LIVE's performances 2. Filter by LIVE status, Creator type, or LIVE starting time to zoom into specific LIVE's that you'd like to focus on 3. Quickly identify LIVEs that are in Violation or Need Attention 4. Access all livestreams and export a custom report ... and more! Read on to find out.
# **Monitoring Ongoing Livestreams** At **Ongoing LIVEs**, there are a couple of ways you can fully maximize the available features on this page.
### **Filter by LIVE status, Creator Name, or Start Time** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fde7642057c945a983ce39e9220d5a0d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | | | --- | --- | --- | | **LIVE Status** | **Creator Name** | **Start Time** | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c92818f5532e41a7929e38ac9fbaf16a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fa66024d064841988be770a3f6a7de7b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/049122e706644de699a3cb5e21480f1a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 1. Filter LIVE Status by:
1. All LIVEs
2. LIVEs in Violation | 2. Filter by Creator Name for Creator's you'd like to analyse | 3. Filter LIVE Start Time by:
1. Earliest
2. Latest
3. Lowest to highest affiliate GMV
4. Highest to lowest affiliate GMV | | **Tip #1:**
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a5785be4f8264f6e976239359a801b46~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Hover over the "Violation" tag to understand the reason for violation. | **Tip #2:**
Filter by creator to assess the performance of individual creators, making it easier to identify top performers and those who may need support. | **Tip #3:**
Filter by 'Latest' to access the latest livestreams and quickly address any emerging issues or negative feedback in real time. | ### **Refresh the list of ongoing LIVEs with just 1 click** Keeping the list updated ensures that agencies can monitor current trends and audience interests, allowing for timely adjustments in strategy.
### **Customize metrics shown on each LIVE card** Tailoring metrics allows Agencies to focus on the specific objectives of each campaign and analyze metrics that align with your unique strategies to make more informed adjustments and optimizations to future livestreams. Hover over the "?" icon to see the metric definition.
### **Access the LIVE Dashboard for each LIVE** On the LIVE card, click onto "**LIVE dashboard**" to deep dive into more details on the specific LIVE performance ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e8f8beef56634ee3bcf897cc79499e0c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ba4cb04368e14ab58d167b286b87b624~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Click on the **User Profile** carousel section to access the LIVE viewer analysis.
### **View customer engagement in real time** On the LIVE card, you'll be able to see the **creator's name, read comments** and **view the pinned product**. This allows you to address the topics being discussed in the comments and easily track which product the creator is promoting.
### **Pin up to 3 livestreams you'd like to focus on** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/34775a87224b4ae9832f18edf2a800ca~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3d69e99b00fb48629e222f6aa73332b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/70be213d4ccf4428bdf08afad9d07d05~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | --- | --- | --- | | **Tip #1:**
Pin the top 3 performing livestreams to set a clear benchmark for performance, making it easier to measure success against these standards. | **Tip #2:**
Pin livestreams with the Violation label to easily identify livestreams requiring attention. | **Tip #3:**
Easily unpin livestreams upon improvement and re-pin another livestream that you'd like to focus on. |
# **Reviewing All Livestreams** ### **Access performance data for all LIVEs** At **All LIVEs**, you can select or search for a specific creator and view the list of livestreams that the creator has completed. This allows you to strategize with the respective creator by analysing the variance in performances between different LIVE sessions and identify what works well, or what can be improved.
### **Customize metrics shown for all LIVEs** Customize **up to 9 metrics** for viewing in the list of Livestreams shown. Hover over the "?" icon to see the metric definition.
### **Access the LIVE Dashboard for each LIVE** Click onto **"LIVE dashboard"** at the end of the LIVE list to see more details on the specific LIVE performance. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/92060a8b90154d6cb9dcc6ecdf621889~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e68bc79f7c514dde93e6e700069f3e69~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Use the "**Performance trends"** module to understand deviation patterns of important LIVE trends during and after the LIVEs, and click onto "Product", "Promotion" and "Violation" tabs to find product lists, violation records, and promotion giveaways associated to a LIVE. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fd87215aad00424d9fcddfb9c6bdab14~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bee3865446d2467e92fd0db1b1435f57~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### **Export LIVE Reports** Use the **"Export all LIVE data"** button to download a list of livestreams and get a report featuring LIVE performances based on the metrics you had customised for viewing.
# **FAQ** 1. **I'm unable to see any LIVE cards on the Ongoing Livestreams page. Why is that?** * This is likely because you do not have any bound sellers, or there are no ongoing LIVEs happening at the moment. 2. **I'm unable to see any livestreams on the All Livestreams page. Why is that?** * This is likely because there were no historical livestreams created by sellers or creators.
