detail.title: [TSP] Affiliate Analytics
detail.content:
For other languages please see below: MY: [[User Manual] Analisis Affiliate untuk TSP - MY](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/JmT6dgGeooCoilx81pqlMu7GgBU) VN: [[User Manual] Tiếp Thị Liên Kết Analytics for TSPs - VN](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/H9Z1dogM7oxQJUxR3CrlB9UHg9f) TH: [[User Manual] การวิเคราะห์แอฟฟิลิเอตสำหรับพาร์ทเนอร์ TikTok Shop (TSP) - TH](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/Woq4d2CzeoNF8Jxgr8plFokjgij?from=from_copylink) ID: [[User Manual] Affiliate Analytics for TSPs - ID](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/CiQjdylJFodizUxwdTDlkw5Hgqh) We have introduced a new section within the **Analytics section** of the Partner Centre called **Affiliate Analytics**. This is available for all TSPs who have signed up under the following categories (these are also known as **Affiliate Management services**) and these TSPs can bind with their sellers at a shop level: | **Category** | **Sub-category** | | --- | --- | | **Shop Management** | Shop Management | | **Shop Management** | Shop Registration | | **Shop Management** | Integrated Marketing | | **Shop Management** | Logistics Management | | **Operation Tutoring** | Operation Tutoring | Previously, TSPs were unable to provide adequate support and guidance for sellers to grow their business through their affiliate marketing channel due to this data not being visible to them. Therefore, this new section will allow TSPs to access detailed affiliate performance insights to support sellers' growth and help them identify which creators they should work with. **How can TSPs work with sellers to provide Affiliate Management services?** 1. Seller and TSP bind at shop level to provide Affiliate Management service. 2. TSP reviews seller's product, product category, brand and target customer segment and then starts searching for creators that will help seller to promote their products. 3. TSP contacts creators to gauge their interest in promoting sellers' products. Based on the creator's interest, TSPs connect the seller and creator to discuss the opportunity. 4. The seller or TSP sends a product sample to the selected creator and tracks product views, GMV and other metrics from the sample. 5. Based on the performance of the sample, TSP and Seller align on whether they want to further invest with the creator. 6. After alignment with the seller to continue to work with the creator, TSP discusses the channel for promotion - LIVE, Video, and Showcase and negotiates the commission. 7. After the alignment in the above step, creators can create content (Live or Video) and promote the products via their Showcase. 8. The TSP can monitor the GMV from the creators that the seller is working with and confirm if the creator is the right fit for the sellers' products. # **What's New on the Partner Centre?** * [For UK] Navigate to: [Partner Centre > Analytics > Affiliate Analytics](https://partner.eu.tiktokshop.com/compass/affiliate-analysis?biz_role=1&market=United+Kingdom) * [For SEA] Navigate to: [Partner Centre > Analytics > Affiliate Analytics](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/compass/affiliate-analysis) You will find the following x3 new modules within Affiliate Analytics tab: 1. **Overview data:** This provides aggregated Affiliate data for all shops that TSPs have an active binding with at a Shop level.
2. **Shop level data:** TSPs will be able to see the key affiliate data metrics for all the shops that they have an active binding with. You can select **[View creators]** to find the creator level data.
3. **Creator level data:** TSPs can use this section to understand the performance of all creators that are associated with that shop, uncover any areas of improvement, and help sellers make the right investment decisions for selecting creators they can collaborate with in the future.
You can use the [**Export]** button to download the **++shop level data++** and **++creator level data++** for offline analysis. ## **Overview and Shop level data metrics** Under the **Overview** and **Shop level data** sections, you will have access to 10 metrics which are: 1. **Affiliate GMV**: The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed from clicking product links in this affiliate's content (including LIVEs, shoppable videos, and showcase). 2. **Affiliate LIVE GMV**: The total amount of orders attributed to LIVEs, including returns and refunds 3. **Affiliate Video GMV:** The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed from this affiliate within 14 days of clicking product links in their content (including LIVEs, shoppable videos, and showcase). 4. **Affiliate Showcase GMV**: The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed to creator's Showcase during the selected period. 5. **Items Sold:** The total number of items sold, including returns and refunds. 6. **Estimated Commissions:** Total estimated commission paid to creators, including COD (paid and unpaid) and non-COD orders, and refunds 7. **Affiliate LIVEs:** The total number of affiliate LIVEs that feature the seller's product. 8. **Affiliate Shoppable Videos:** The total number of affiliate shoppable videos that feature the seller's product. 9. **Affiliate Refunded GMV:** The amount of order refunds generated from this creator during the selected period. 10. **Affiliate Items Refunded:** The total number of refunded items generated by this creator during the selected period. You can use the **metrics** button to add or remove these metrics. ## **Creator** **level data metrics** Under the **Creator level data** section, as well as the above 10 metrics, you will have access to the following metrics for creators who have worked with your sellers: 1. **Affiliate Products Sold:** The number of products sold attributed to affiliates, including returns and refunds. 2. **Avg. Order Value:** The average amount paid by buyers for each order. 3. **Affiliate Orders:** The total number of paid SKU orders attributed to this affiliate. 4. **CTR**: The percentage of viewers who saw your product link in your LIVEs, shoppable videos, and showcase and clicked through to your product detail page during the selected time period. 5. **Product Impressions:** Each time a product link appears in your Lives, shoppable videos, and showcase, it counts as 1 impression. Viewers can click these links to visit your product listings. 6. **Buyers**: The total number of buyers who placed orders directly from the creators' content, including buyers who made returns or refunds. 7. **Affiliate Followers:** The current number of followers the affiliate has. 8. **Affiliate Product Showcase:** The total number of products an affiliate has added to its showcase. 9. **Target Collaboration GMV:** The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed from affiliate target collaborations during the selected period. 10. **Target Collaboration Est. Commission:** Total estimated commission paid from target collaboration, including COD (paid and unpaid) and non-COD orders, and refunds 11. **Open Collaboration GMV:** The total amount of paid orders (including returns and refunds) attributed from affiliate open collaborations during the selected period. 12. **Open Collaboration Est. Commission:** Total estimated commission paid from open collaboration, including COD (paid and unpaid) and non-COD orders, and refunds # **FAQs** 1. **How much historical Affiliate data will TSPs have access for sellers that they have a binding relationship with?** TSPs will have access to Sellers' historical data from up to six months in the past to the current day as long as the seller and TSP binding is valid and data authorisation is approved.

detail.title: [TSP] Shop Analytics
detail.content:
🌍 For other languages, please see below: [[MY] User Manual - Analitik Kedai TSP.pdf](https://p16-arcosite-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-10qhjjqwgv-us/a2ca6c6afedc42128fbe4d0b2e2db172~tplv-10qhjjqwgv-image.image) [[TH] User Manual - การวิเคราะห์ร้านค้าของพาร์ทเนอร์ TikTok Shop (TSP).pdf](https://p16-arcosite-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-10qhjjqwgv-us/c31d69ad02684da0981f9280935db71a~tplv-10qhjjqwgv-image.image) [[VN] User Manual - Trang Phân tích Cửa hàng cho TSP.pdf](https://p16-arcosite-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-10qhjjqwgv-us/539351b5c93340f790df91701448dec5~tplv-10qhjjqwgv-image.image) [[ID] User Manual - TSP Shop Analytics.pdf](https://p16-arcosite-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-10qhjjqwgv-us/ebe99bb4f3ec444682045cceeb82be6c~tplv-10qhjjqwgv-image.image) # TSP Shop Analytics ## Summary For TSPs that provide Shop Management services, it is important that they can monitor their sellers' shop performances in order to compare top performing shops, review product performances, identify shops that need attention, and more. The **Shop Analytics** page is a one-stop hub that gives TSPs the convenience of accessing all those insights and more via 3 performance modules: 1. Overview 2. Your Sellers 3. Shop Tab By using Shop Analytics, TSPs no longer need to login to various sellers' accounts via Seller Center to analyze various shop performances separately. Read on to learn how to utilise Shop Analytics, or **visit Shop Analytics by navigating to:** [Partner Center > Analytics > Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/compass/shop-analysis) *Note: All images shown below are for example purposes only and may not represent the final product.* ## Overview The Overview tab provides you with comprehensive insights into all your managed shops' performances and is broken down into 4 sections: * Key Data * Shop Ranking * Product Ranking
### 1.1 Key Data
Here, get a birds-eye view of all your managed shops key performance metrics and toggle on the Trend button to easily analyze a comparison of 2 key metrics on the trendchart above. * Data shown here is based on the time period selected * Review Total GMV with a breakdown of GMV attributed from LIVE, Video, Product, Affiliate, and Ads * View indicators of metric performance % versus the same period prior by looking at the green arrows (uptrend) or red arrows (downtrend) * Hover over the "?" to understand the metric definition ### 1.2 Shop Ranking Easily identify your top ranking shops sorted by: * Highest to lowest GMV * Highest to lowest GMV change (how much GMV had changed versus the prior period) * Highest to lowest Shop Tab GMV | **View Shop Ranking by GMV** | **View Shop Ranking by GMV change** | **View Shop Ranking by Shop Tab GMV** | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8075e1ac15014405b3008f87eae4af32~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/fe16bdb31973418e80cf260f94d3b8cf~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b4a2794be6b44a4ebdc683bb0e58755c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | * Click View All to open the "My Sellers" page for the full list of shops
* Click Export to download the list for an offline analysis | | | *Tip: Review the GMV distribution % to identify shops or products that have a high GMV attribution within your total managed seller pool. Deep-dive into why these shops are performing well and replicate the strategy onto other lower-performing shops.* ### 1.3. Product Ranking Easily identify your top ranking products sorted by: * Highest to lowest GMV or, * Highest to lowest Items sold | **View Product Ranking by GMV** | **View Product Ranking by Items Sold** | | --- | --- | | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6a4597ea06004a399123c8475933bf76~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cb8cf2ff6f604fa8a32213a1f15208af~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Click Export to download the list for an offline analysis | |
Click here to go to Shop Analytics
## Your Sellers Here you can access the full list of all your managed sellers and analyze shop-level performance metrics by sorting the table according to the metric you'd like to focus on. For example, sort from highest to lowest GMV, or Items Sold, and so on.
If you have particular shops that you would like to zoom into, simply key in the Shop Name or ID in the search bar. The search bar allows you to search and select up to 3 shops at a time. Upon filtering to 3 shops, it will be reflected on the table below. If you'd like to download a list of all your shop performances, click on the Export button.
You can also Pin or Unpin up to 5 shops, which allows you to easily focus on these shops without needing to search for them each time.
Upon scrolling the table to the right, you will be able to see "Seller Opportunities".
Clicking on "Opportunities" will open up a tab that gives you **3 actionable suggestions you could take to improve the shop's performance.** Each suggested action comes with an estimated potential sales increase % that helps you identify which action you can take first for the highest chance of sales improvement!
Click here to go to Shop Analytics
## Shop Tab Through the Shop Tab module, TSPs can now evaluate how Shop Tab contributes to a seller's overall shop performance. Get a breakdown of Shop Tab performance via these 2 sections: * Key Data * Sellers you manage
### 3.1 Key Data Similar to the key data section under Overview, you can view Shop Tab performance metrics here and toggle on the Trend button to easily analyze a comparison of 2 key metrics on the trendchart below.
Click on the pencil icon to customize the metrics shown under Key Data: * **Shop Tab GMV:** The average amount each buyer paid for orders, including refunds and returns, during the selected time period. * **Orders:** The total number of SKU orders placed from the Shop Tab during the selected time period. * **AVG. GMV per buyer:** The average amount each user paid for products after having visited the product details page from the Shop Tab during the selected period. * **Impressions:** The total number of times your product card was displayed to viewers in the Shop tab. The Shop tab is the entry point from the TikTok app. * **Product Clicks:** The total number of users who clicked your shop's products from a second-level Shop Tab page during the selected period. * **Buyers:** The number of unique users who successfully paid for a product after having visited the product details page from the Shop Tab during the selected period. * **CTR:** The percentage of users who clicked a product after having an impression of it in a second-level Shop Tab page during the selected period. * **CTOR:** The percentage of users who bought a product after having clicked it in a second-level Shop Tab page during the selected period. * **Conversion rate:** The percentage of users who bought a product after having an impression of it from this page in the Shop Tab during the selected period. * **Add-to-cart users:** The number of users who added items to their shopping cart via the current channel. * **Refunded Orders:** The number of refunded or canceled orders for products purchased after having visited the product details page from the Shop Tab during the selected period. * **Refunded Amount:** The amount refunded or canceled for products purchased by users who visited the product details page from the Shop Tab during the selected period. ### 3.2 Sellers you manage
Similar to Your Sellers tab, here you can: * Zoom into specific shops performance by keying in the Shop ID in the search bar * Click Export to download a list of all your shop performances for offline analysis * Pin up to 5 shops that you would like to focus on * Click on Metrics to customize the metrics you'd like to view on the table
Click here to go to Shop Analytics

detail.title: Dec 2025 Product Innovation
detail.content:
Below are this month’s new Creator Center features and enhancements. Each section explains what the feature is, why it matters from an agency POV, and what actions to take with creators. These updates are designed to help your agency better coach creators, increase content output, reduce friction, and ultimately drive more GMV. ## 🎬 **Video Assistant: Improve Your Video Skills**
**📌 What it is:** A new education experience built directly into Video Assistant that teaches creators what high-quality videos look like and helps them create one immediately. Creators can watch short explanations, view real creator examples, and then go straight into making a video—all in one flow. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps newer creators understand video quality standards more clearly * Reduces back-and-forth coaching on “what good looks like” * Supports higher-quality content without slowing down output ⏩ **Agency action:** Recommend this to creators who need more structure and guidance, and encourage more advanced creators to use it to level up quality and consistency. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1144590806566702&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- ## 🔴 **LIVE Tab**
**📌 What it is:** A centralized learning hub for creators focused on improving LIVE performance. The LIVE Tab surfaces prescriptive guidance, tools, and educational content to help creators programmatically run LIVEs and drive more sales. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Creates a single place to direct creators who want to improve LIVE results * Makes LIVE best practices easier to understand and repeat * Helps creators optimize sales, traffic, and engagement over time ⏩ **Agency action:** Point LIVE-focused creators to the LIVE Tab as their primary learning hub, use the content to reinforce LIVE playbooks and performance reviews, and encourage creators to revisit the tab regularly as they scale LIVE output. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=5071654582060813).

detail.title: Feb 2026 Product Innovation
detail.content:
Below are this month’s new Creator Center features and updates. These are designed to help your agency drive more content output, improve creator monetization, and scale performance more efficiently. --- ## 💸 Refundable Sample at Checkout
**📌 What it is:** Creators can now turn a self-purchase into a Refundable Sample directly at checkout. If eligible, they can toggle “Refundable Sample,” purchase the product, post content, and receive a refund after hitting required sales goals - no seller approval needed. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Removes friction in securing products for content * Speeds up content production (no waiting on approvals) * Increases creator participation in affiliate content * Improves conversion by aligning creator intent with product selection ⏩ **Agency action:** Encourage creators to use this for products they already plan to buy, use for fast-turnaround content or trending products, and incorporate into creator workflows to reduce delays 👉 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6918873955796749&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- ## 🚀 TikTok Shop Creator Pilot Program Update
**📌 What it is:** Creators in the program can now post significantly more shoppable videos. * <5K followers: up to 3/day (21/week) * 5K+ followers: unlimited shoppable posts **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Unlocks higher content volume and faster testing * Enables rapid iteration on hooks, formats, and products * Increases chances of finding winning content * Supports scaling high-performing creators **⏩ Agency action:** Push creators to increase posting frequency, test multiple variations of content quickly, and identify top-performing formats and double down. 👉 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7264111224227597&lang=en). --- ## 👀 Growth Actions in Creator Center
**📌 What it is:** A new personalized recommendation system in Creator Center that suggests next steps based on performance, with clear explanations of what to improve and why. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Makes coaching more data-driven and targeted * Helps identify blockers to growth faster * Reduces guesswork in content and strategy decisions * Supports consistent performance improvement **⏩ Agency action:** Review Growth Actions during creator check-ins, use insights to guide content and posting strategy, and prioritize actions that unlock GMV growth. 👉 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=4459774766876447). --- ## ✨ Discover: What to Promote Next
**📌 What it is:** An improved discovery experience in Creator Center that helps creators find products to promote through: * New Arrivals * Curated Choices * Rankings (personalized recommendations) **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Reduces time spent searching for products * Surfaces high-potential and trending SKUs earlier * Improves product-market fit for creators * Supports more consistent content pipelines **⏩ Agency action:** Guide creators to check Discover regularly, align product selection with creator niche and audience, and use insights to plan upcoming content 👉 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2448311311435551&lang=en). --- ## 📌 **TLDR;** This month’s updates focus on: * Increasing content velocity (Pilot Program, Refundable Samples) * Improving creator decision-making (Growth Actions, Discover) * Reducing friction in workflows (faster product access, better guidance) 👉 Focus on helping creators post more, test faster, and choose better products. ---

detail.content:
Below are this month’s new Creator Center features and enhancements. These updates are designed to help your agency better coach creators, increase content output, reduce friction, and ultimately drive more GMV. --- ## 🔗 Product Relinking
**📌 What it is:** Creators can now replace unavailable product links without deleting or reposting their videos. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Prevents loss of GMV when products go out of stock or are delisted * Keeps high-performing content active * Reduces creator downtime or manual content fixes ⏩ **Agency action:** Encourage creators to check their relink alerts daily and replace unavailable SKUs immediately. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?from=feature_guide&identity=1&knowledge_id=3759443559679790&role=2). --- ## ⏰ Showcase "Post Suggestions"
**📌 What it is:** Showcase now includes post suggestions, surfacing the most beneficial products to promote right now. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps creators focus on SKUs with the highest earning potential * Improves conversion and GMV * Makes daily content planning more strategic ⏩ **Agency action:** Use this feature during creator check-ins to guide what should be posted next. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?course_type=1&from=search&knowledge_id=5640959860098862&role=1). --- ## 🎁 Increased Free Sample Requests
**📌 What it is:** GMV-generating creators now have access to more simultaneous sample requests, with even more unlocked as they scale. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Supports multi-product testing for sellers * Enables faster content turnaround * Helps newer creators experiment and find winning products ⏩ **Agency action:** Encourage creators to request samples early, especially for seasonal or trending SKUs. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?course_type=1&knowledge_id=5764641632306946#EAC300D6). --- ## ⭐ Spotlight Creator Program
**📌 What it is:** A new growth initiative for Bronze-Platinum creators, offering additional reach, commissions, and sample benefits. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Provides a structured path to scale mid-tier and rising creators * Makes creators more attractive to sellers * Enables your agency to pitch stronger creator value ⏩ **Agency action:** Identify eligible creators and guide them on how to maximize program perks. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?course_type=1&from=search&knowledge_id=7699130216220471&role=1). --- ## 👀 Brand Check for IPR Safety
**📌 What it is:** Products more prone to IPR issues now show no brand name under "About the Product" in the PDP. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps prevent creator violations * Reduces violation warnings and penalties * Saves your team time spent on appeals or escalations ⏩ **Agency action:** Have creators quickly review PDP details before filming or linking. --- ## 🎥 Video Assistant: AI-Powered Content Creation
**📌 What it is:** An AI-powered tool that guides creators through scripting, filming, editing, and posting, all in one simple workflow. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps creators produce more content with less effort and support * Improves quality and consistentcy * Great for scaling creators efficiently ⏩ **Agency action:** Recommend Video Assistant for creators who need help ideating or scripting. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?from=feature_guide&identity=1&knowledge_id=1144590806566702&role=2). --- ## 💡 Good Content Performance Insights
**📌 What it is:** The Good Quality Video Guide now has enhanced performance insights and guidance to help creators improve their video performance faster. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Clearer guidance for coaching creators * Helps sellers understand what's working and why * Identifies performance gaps quickly ⏩ **Agency action:** Use insights in weekly reviews to refine content strategy with creators. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2512242345133837). ---

detail.title: Dec 2025 Product Innovation
detail.content:
Below are this month’s new Seller Center features and enhancements. Each section explains what the feature is, why it matters from an agency POV, and what actions to take with sellers. These updates are designed to help your agency better coach sellers, increase content output, reduce friction, and ultimately drive more GMV. --- # Shoppable Videos ## 🎥 **Image-to-Video Tool** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/045d2a1653734a87bb16925352aaa076~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **📌 What it is:** A tool that automatically turns product images into shoppable videos. Sellers receive two video versions per creation and can retry with different images at no cost. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Enables faster content production for sellers with limited video resources * Increases shoppable video output without heavy creator reliance * Makes it easier to maintain consistent posting **⏩ Agency action:** Encourage sellers without regular video output to use Image-to-Video weekly. Test different image sets to identify higher-performing video styles. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?identity=1&role=1&knowledge_id=7203789379143437&from=feature_guide). --- # Working with Affiliates ## 🤝 **Sample Workflow Improvements**
**📌 What it is:** New auto-approval options for creator sample requests, allowing sellers to define criteria (e.g., GMV, posting rate) and automatically approve qualified creators. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Saves significant time managing sample requests * Accelerates creator content production * Improves creator experience and response times **⏩ Agency action:** Help sellers configure auto-approval rules Set quotas and price limits to manage inventory risk 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=442899025315639&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Promotions ## 🚀 **Smart Promotion Program** **📌 What it is:** A fully managed promotion program that uses Seller Center tools (coupons, subsidies) to improve product visibility and GMV. TikTok Shop manages promotion strategy and execution. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Reduces operational burden on agencies * Provides a turnkey way to test promotions * Increases visibility without manual setup **⏩ Agency action:** Identify eligible sellers (SPS ≥ 3.5). Recommend the program for sellers seeking hands-off promotion support. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=4827354015483691&course_type=1#EC2500CB). --- # Merchandising ## **🛍️ Product Opportunities**
**📌 What it is:** A discovery tool that surfaces trending products, keywords, hashtags, subcategories, and product themes on TikTok. Sellers can also match existing catalog items to trending demand signals to improve visibility and sales. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Helps you guide sellers toward higher-demand products * Supports better product naming, PDP optimization, and assortment strategy * Reduces guesswork when advising sellers on what to launch or promote next **⏩ Agency action:** Review Product Opportunities with sellers during assortment or growth planning. Use insights to recommend keyword updates, hero SKUs, or new product tests. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=4371484668528427&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Logistics & Fulfillment ## **🚚 Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) Onboarding Experience** **📌 What it is:** An improved onboarding experience for new FBT sellers, including a redesigned Homepage and Analytics view that highlights logistics, traffic, and GMV impact, plus FBT vs. seller-fulfilled comparisons. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Makes FBT value clearer and easier to explain * Helps sellers understand logistics performance without deep analysis * Supports higher FBT adoption **⏩ Agency action:** Walk new sellers through the updated FBT dashboards. Use comparisons to recommend fulfillment strategy shifts. ## **📦 2025 FBT Storage Rate Card Update** **📌 What it is:** An update that keeps the 60-day free storage period and further reduces storage fees for inventory stored up to 270 days (14%–43% discounts). Rates beyond 270 days remain unchanged. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Lowers fulfillment costs for long-term inventory * Makes FBT more attractive for higher-SKU or seasonal sellers * Improves seller margins **⏩ Agency action:** Revisit inventory and storage strategy with sellers. Encourage sellers holding stock elsewhere to re-evaluate FBT. --- # TikTok Shop App Store ## **⭐ Loox App Launch** **📌 What it is:** A customer review app that syncs Shopify reviews (including photos) into TikTok Shop automatically and updates daily. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Strengthens PDP social proof * Improves shopper confidence and conversion * Keeps reviews consistent across Shopify and TikTok Shop **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend Loox to Shopify sellers. detail.content:
Below are this month’s new Seller Center features and updates. These are designed to help your agency drive stronger campaign performance, improve operational efficiency, and scale seller growth more effectively. --- # TikTok Shop Campaigns ## 🛍️ Buy More Save More (BMSM) + Buy X Get Y (BXGY)
**📌 What it is:** BMSM and BXGY promotions are now unified into a single setup flow in Seller Center. Sellers can easily configure bulk discounts (e.g., spend more, save more) or bundle offers (e.g., buy one, get one) from one streamlined interface. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Makes it easier to launch and test different discount strategies * Drives higher AOV through bundling and upsell mechanics * Reduces setup friction when managing multiple promotions * Enables more flexible campaign planning across SKUs **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend BMSM for increasing basket size, use BXGY for inventory clearing or bundle strategies, and incorporate into campaign and promo calendars 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7160023202432811&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Seller Growth ## 📈 Growth Benefits Center
**📌 What it is:** Sellers can now replace unavailable product links without deleting or reposting their videos. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Prevents loss of GMV when products go out of stock or are delisted * Keeps high-performing content active * Reduces creator downtime or manual content fixes ⏩ **Agency action:** Encourage sellers to check their relink alerts daily and replace unavailable SKUs immediately. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?from=feature_guide&identity=1&knowledge_id=3759443559679790&role=2). --- ## 🎥 Video Assistant: AI-Powered Content Creation
**📌 What it is:** A new centralized hub that shows sellers their current growth tier, benefits, and recommended actions to scale. It connects with Growth Opportunities to provide a full view of how to increase GMV and unlock rewards. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Gives a clear framework for seller growth planning * Helps prioritize highest-impact actions * Makes performance gaps and next steps more visible * Aligns seller efforts with TikTok Shop growth incentives **⏩ Agency action:** Use this as a baseline for seller strategy conversations, align monthly goals to tier progression and recommended actions, and track progress and adjust plans based on insights. --- ## 🔁 Product Subscriptions – Modify Discount
**📌 What it is:** Sellers can now reduce subscription discount rates for future subscribers while maintaining the original discount for existing subscribers. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Provides more control over margins * Enables seasonal or promotional pricing adjustments * Protects existing subscriber relationships * Supports long-term subscription strategy **⏩ Agency action:** Review subscription pricing strategies with sellers, adjust discounts based on seasonality or performance, and balance growth vs. profitability. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=437903906653998&course_type=1#EBA300CF). --- ## Shoppable Video ## 🎥 Shoppable Video Content Management Upgrade
**📌 What it is:** An upgraded content management hub in Seller Center that allows sellers to view, filter, and take action on all shoppable videos. Replaces the previous “Manage Content” page with improved tools. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Makes it easier to monitor content performance at scale * Speeds up identification of high- and low-performing videos * Improves workflow for optimizing and promoting content * Reduces manual tracking across multiple videos **⏩ Agency action:** Use this to audit seller content regularly, identify videos to boost, iterate, or replace, and build content optimization workflows around this dashboard. --- ## 🎬 Shoppable Video Creation Entry Upgrade
**📌 What it is:** An improved entry point for creating shoppable videos within Seller Center, designed to make content creation more accessible and intuitive. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Reduces friction for sellers starting content creation * Encourages more consistent posting * Supports scaling content output across accounts **⏩ Agency action:** Encourage sellers to adopt this new flow, use it in onboarding for new sellers or content teams, and pair it with content planning and posting cadence. --- # Partner Apps ## 🧰 Zendesk for TikTok Shop **📌 What it is:** A new integration that centralizes customer support within Zendesk, allowing sellers to manage communication, support tickets, and insights in one place. **💡 Why it matters** **for agencies:** * Improves customer experience and response time * Centralizes support operations for scaling sellers * Provides better visibility into customer issues * Reduces operational fragmentation **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend for sellers with higher order volume, integrate into customer support workflows, and use insights to identify recurring issues. --- # 📌 **TLDR;** This month’s updates focus on: * Driving higher AOV (BMSM, BXGY) * Improving growth visibility and planning (Growth Benefits Center) * Scaling content operations (Shoppable Video upgrades) * Improving operational efficiency (Zendesk, subscription flexibility) 👉 Focus on helping your sellers optimize promotions, scale content, and align to growth tiers. ---

Below are this month’s new Seller Center features and enhancements. Each section explains what the feature is, why it matters from an agency POV, and what actions to take with sellers. **📌 What it is:** A new LIVE selling experience that allows sellers to run real-time auctions where shoppers compete for products. This adds urgency and interactivity to LIVE sessions. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps increase LIVE conversion through urgency-driven buying * Creates more engaging LIVE formats for hosts and creators * Provides a new tactic to move inventory quickly * Differentiates LIVE sessions from standard product selling **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend Countdown Bidding for sellers with strong LIVE traffic, test with limited inventory or promotional SKUs, and integrate into LIVE strategy planning for key events. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=8427133325330222&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Campaigns ## **📊 Campaign registration enhancements**
**📌 What it is:** New improvements to campaign enrollment, including: * Best-selling products auto-surfaced at the top * “Key product” labels for eligible SKUs * Pre-filled Excel templates for large catalogs * Clear error reporting with actionable guidance **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Reduces time spent managing campaign enrollment * Helps prioritize the right SKUs faster * Makes it easier to support large-catalog sellers * Lowers friction and setup errors **⏩ Agency action:** Guide sellers to prioritize best-performing SKUs for campaigns, use Excel workflows to manage bulk enrollment more efficiently, and help sellers resolve eligibility issues quickly using error insights. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7702279240042295&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). ## **🔁 Flash Sale Auto-Restock**
**📌 What it is:** Auto-restock monitors inventory hourly and automatically replenishes Flash Sale stock based on recent sales to prevent campaign interruptions. Enabled by default. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Reduces risk of campaigns stopping due to stockouts * Maintains momentum during high-traffic sale periods * Saves manual inventory monitoring time **⏩ Agency action:** Ensure sellers understand the setting and how to manage it and recommend keeping it on for high-volume SKUs. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?course_type=1&from=search&identity=1&is_new_connect=0&is_new_user=0&knowledge_id=7691250170332942&role=1). --- # Seller Tools ## **📧 CRM Email Channel**
**📌 What it is:** A new CRM email channel that allows sellers to send targeted emails to specific audience segments using templates and customizable messaging. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Unlocks a new owned channel for retention and repeat purchases * Supports lifecycle marketing strategies * Makes it easier to segment and target high-value customers **⏩ Agency action:** Help sellers set up basic email campaigns for repeat buyers and new followers, and align CRM messaging with promotion and campaign moments. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=5403048260945710). ## **🗂️ Product Collections**
**📌 What it is:** Sellers can group products into themed collections like “Best Sellers” or “Discount Series” and showcase them in Shop Design or share via chat. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Improves storefront merchandising * Makes product discovery easier * Supports promotional storytelling **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend collections aligned to campaigns or seasons and use collections to highlight hero SKUs. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=3029412015458091#EB1800D5). ## **🧾 CRM Entrance in Promotions Tab**
**📌 What it is:** Sellers can now create CRM plans directly from the Promotions page. The system auto-selects audiences and pre-fills messaging to speed setup. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Simplifies campaign + CRM coordination * Reduces manual setup time * Helps sellers activate CRM more consistently **⏩ Agency action:** Encourage sellers to pair promotions with CRM outreach and use this for quick activation during sales events. --- # Seller Marketing ## **🛍️ “Available on TikTok Shop” Creative Assets**
**📌 What it is:** Official brand assets sellers can use to promote their products across the Americas (US, Mexico, Brazil) in multiple styles, colors, and languages. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Supports off-platform marketing efforts * Helps reinforce brand presence across regions * Makes promotional content easier to standardize **⏩ Agency action:** Incorporate these assets into creative and campaign planning and use for paid and organic promotional materials. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2985859637593869). --- # Finance ## **💼 2025 1099-K Form Update**
**📌 What it is:** For 2025, TikTok Shop will issue Form 1099-K to sellers with over $20,000 in gross sales and more than 200 transactions to support tax compliance. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Important for operational and financial planning conversations * Helps agencies prepare sellers for reporting requirements * Reduces confusion during tax season **⏩ Agency action:** Flag this to high-volume sellers early and encourage sellers to track sales records and prepare documentation. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=80339993577259). ---

**📌 What it is:** An AI dubbing tool that translates and lip-syncs seller videos into multiple languages. It matches lip movement automatically, adds translated voiceover, and generates localized scripts, allowing sellers to repurpose one video into different markets without reshooting. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Quick way to localize or upgrade content * No need to reshoot videos in different languages * Improves engagement and conversion ⏩ **Agency action:** Recommend to sellers expanding across regions or repurposing content. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1401044627343118&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- ## 💡 Good Content Performance Insights
**📌 What it is:** The Good Quality Video Guide now has enhanced performance insights and guidance to help sellers improve their video performance faster. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Clearer guidance for coaching sellers * Helps sellers understand what's working and why * Identifies performance gaps quickly ⏩ **Agency action:** Use insights during content reviews to advise sellers on what to change or scale. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=4963086610204471). --- # Merchandising ## 🧩 Combined Listings
**📌 What it is:** A feature that lets sellers manually create their own "More Choices" or "More Versions" section on a product page. Sellers can now group related products (sizes, colors, flavors) under one listing, rather than relying only on auto-generated combinations. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Improves product discoverability * Consolidates reviews to improve trust * Reduces duplicate listings that confuse shoppers ⏩ **Agency action:** Audit seller catalogs and combine duplicate or related SKUs to strengthen conversion. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6102275286288183&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- ## 📈 Hero Program: 7-Day Ads Challenge
**📌 What it is:** A built-in 7-day guided ads challenge for scaling a hero product. Sellers receive step-by-step directions on how to invest in ads and can earn up to $1,000 in TikTok Shop-funded bonuses if they hit the weekly performance target. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Teaches sellers how to use Shop Ads in a structured way * Reduces setup complexity for agencies * Provides seller motivation through guaranteed bonus incentives ⏩ **Agency action:** Select proven hero SKUs for entry and support sellers with daily check-ins to hit targets. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=3775315155355438&course_type=1#EB1300D3). --- # **ACE Framework** ## ⭐ Creator Exclusive Price Enter Point
**📌 What it is:** A simplified promotion setup where sellers can create special discounted prices visible only to selected creators for LIVE or video promotions. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Makes it easier for sellers to run reator-friendly promotions * Encourages more creators to feature seller products * Increases reaching during events, launches, or LIVE sessions ⏩ **Agency action:** Help sellers set Creator Exclusive Prices for high-impact SKUs during campaigns. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1363152974169870). --- # ACE Framework ## 📊 ACE Module in Analytics
**📌 What it is:** A new Analytics module that organizes performance into the ACE framework—Assortment, Content, Empowerment. Sellers can click into each area to see detailed breakdowns and diagnostics. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Provides structured, easy-to-understand performance analysis * Helps pinpoint exactly where sellers need support * Makes reporting and reviews more strategic and streamlined ⏩ **Agency action:** Use ACE to prepare weekly/monthly insight reports and set priority actions. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2165215329748791&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Agency ## 🧭 Enhanced TikTok Shop Partner Service Portal
**📌 What it is:** A revamped portal inside Seller Center that helps sellers find vetted TikTok Shop Partners. It includes clearer service categories, verified performance data, case studies, and easier contact options. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Increases visibility to potential clients * Helps sellers understand agency capabilities * Establishes trust through verified metrics **⏩ Agency action:** Update your agency’s profile, specialties, and success stories to attract more sellers. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1777027175974698&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- ## 💸 Shop Ads Commission Rate Recommendations
**📌 What it is:** A data-based system that recommends commission rates by analyzing the top-performing 30% of products in a category. Sellers can use these recommendations when setting Shop Ads affiliate rates. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps sellers offer competitive commissions * Increases creator uptake and content volume * Reduces guesswork and misaligned rates ⏩ **Agency action:** Review recommended rates with sellers and adjust to drive creator participation. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1629118999545613&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). --- # Working with Affilifates ## 📉 Shop Ads Commission Threshold
**📌 What it is:** A minimum required commission rate that must be met when setting Shop Ads commissions. If a seller sets a rate below the allowed minimum, the system flags it and prompts an adjustment. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Prevents campaigns from underperforming due to low commissions * Ensures creators earn fairly * Maintains strong ecosystem health for affiliate promotions ⏩ **Agency action:** Confirm that seller campaigns meet the threshold before launching. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7057402168084270#EB4500D2). --- # Logistics & Fulfillment ## 🧮 Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) Cost Calculator
**📌 What it is:** A calculator that estimates per-unit FBT costs, like inbound fees, storage, and fulfillment, based on product size, weight, and volume. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Helps sellers understand real margins * Supports decisions on switching to FBT * Prevents unprofitable promo planning ⏩ **Agency action:** Use the calculator during pricing discussions and new product launches. --- ## 🚛 Non-Compliant Instance (NCI) Fee Waiver for First Inbound **📌 What it is:** A one-time waiver that removes all NCI fees on a seller’s first inbound FBT shipment. **💡 Why it matters for agencies:** * Lowers risk for first-time FBT users * Encourages sellers to try TikTok fulfillment * Simplifies onboarding **⏩ Agency action:** Recommend new sellers test FBT using their free first inbound. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://scm-us.tiktok.com/merchant-university/course-details/26939242246). --- # Partner Ecosystem ## 🖥️ Shopify Web Design Integration
**📌 What it is:** A feature in the TikTok for Shopify app that automatically syncs a seller’s storefront design (UI/UX, layout, branding) into TikTok Shop. **Why it matters for agencies:** * Keeps brand presentation consistent * Reduces manual storefront adjustments * Improves shopper trust and conversion **⏩ Agency action:** Help Shopify sellers sync their design and optimize their TikTok Shop layout. 🧠 Learn more in this [Feature Guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7805772936890126&role=1&course_type=1&from=search). ---

(b) Encryption protocols applied as necessary under various circumstances;

(d) Appropriate destruction and disposal of documents;
(e) Physical destruction processes in place of industry standards;
(f) Secure communication session established via TLS or similar protocols across core applications/services; and
(g) Encrypted certificates utilized for authentication between core web client and core web server.
**V. Input Control**
Developer shall take appropriate technical and organizational measures in order to ensure that it is subsequently possible to verify and establish via log files whether and by whom personal data has been entered into data processing systems, altered, or removed.
**VI. Framework Control**
Developer shall take technical and organizational measures in order to ensure that any personal data transferred under these Developer Terms can only be processed for the purposes specified in the Developer Terms including, at a minimum:
(a) Clear and binding internal policies contain formalized instructions for data processing procedures;
(b) Clearly articulated contractual protections in place as appropriate in underlying contracts;
(c) Regular staff training on the proper use of the computer security system, the security backup and disaster recovery procedures, and the importance of security to ensure compliance with contractual arrangements and maintain awareness regarding data protection requirements;
(d) Secure destruction processes in place to industry standards;
(e) Periodic access reviews that monitor employee access controls; and
(f) Developer’s corporate network is separated from its user services network by means of complex segregation devices.
**VII. Availability Control**
Developer shall take technical and organizational measures in order to protect the data from accidental destruction or loss, including, at a minimum:
(a) Appliances for the monitoring of temperature and humidity in data centers;
(b) Fire/smoke detectors and fire extinguishers or fire suppression systems in data centers;
(c) Use of mature and appropriate anti-virus software that includes e-mail filtering and malware detection;
(d) Data recovery measures and emergency plan in place and regularly tested;
(e) Implementation of mature and appropriate backup methods including physical separation of the backup data and storage of data stored in a redundant archive;
(f) Use a combination of full, differential, and cumulative backups to ensure data integrity and timely restoration for core data, as appropriate;
(g) To ensure an uninterrupted supply of power to the system, redundant power supply units are built into the systems wherever possible;
(h) Integrity of stored data regularly verified using checksums;
(i) Processes in place to move data traffic away from affected areas to uncompromised areas in case of failure;
(j) Preventative maintenance is performed to ensure continued operability of equipment; and
(k) Appropriate Denial of Service and Distributed Denial of Service technology in place to defend against network and systems-based resource starvation attacks.
**VIII. Minimum Security Standards**
You must document, implement and maintain an information security program that meets the standards of best industry practice, which will include:
(a) Information Security Policies
(i) Approved security policies aligned to industry standard-ISO27001 or NIST 800-53
(ii) Industry standard certification such as ISO27001 or SOC2
(iii) (At a minimum) annual review of information security policies
(iv) High level conceptual data flow diagram
(b) Organization of Information Security
(i) Dedicated information security function responsible for security initiatives and operations
(ii) High level description of roles and responsibilities within the security organization
(iii) Dedicated information security risk management function
(c) Human Resource Security
(i) Signed non-disclosure agreements by all personnel handling confidential data
(ii) Annual security awareness, education and training
(iii) Background checks for corporate users
(iv) Background checks for contractors
(v) Disciplinary process for policy violations
(vi) Documented management responsibilities for security
(vii) Termination or change of employment controls
(viii) Dedicated HR governance and technology systems
(d) Asset Management
(i) Management oversight of assets and data
(ii) Assigned ownership for all assets
(iii) Classification and handling of assets
(iv) Process for management and disposal of removable media
(e) Access Control
(i) Least privilege, segregation of duty and need to know basis security concepts are embedded into the access management process
(ii) Access assurance control program
(iii) Periodic access review (at least annually)
(iv) Access termination within 24-48 hours for separated users
(v) Management of privileged access rights
(vi) Use of multi-factor authentication (MFA) and/or single sign-on (SSO)
(vii) SAML 2.0 or SCIM integration readily available to TikTok
(viii) Password complexity/configuration requirements in accordance with TikTok standards

detail.title: Operation Assessment Standard for Cross-Border Partners
detail.content:
| | | | --- | --- | | **Type** | **Assessment criteria** | | TSP | Starting from the 31st day after TSP onboard, the partner must meet the following **monthly** requirements:

* Complete at least 10 valid LIVEs under one account connected with merchants, or post at least 10 valid e-commerce short videos under one official account connected with merchants, and

* Have a total GMV of more than 0 among all connected accounts.

Related definitions:
* Valid LIVEs:

1) The LIVE is e-commerce related with a yellow shopping cart, and the products are uploaded to TikTok Shop;

2) The LIVE is more than 1.5 hours with more than 6 products included;

3) The host will need to present products and guide customers to make orders.

* Valid e-commerce short videos: the content is in accord with the platform rules.

*If the partner does NOT meet any requirement above, the partner shall be removed from the TTSPC, and the partner can re-apply in 60 days. However, if the partner fail again, the same partner shall not be able to re-apply once again. | | MCN | * Assessment method:

* Institutional background account number binding > 3 (Note: The account number is the self-incubated account individual approval number actually operated by the institution, and the illegal binding is regarded as a violation of the platform rules and is not included in the valid bound account data);

* Institution background bound account assessment cycle GMV > 0 dollars ;

* No violation of platform rules (recording and broadcasting, pirated broadcasting) and other underground industry behaviors;

* The relationship between the above three types of assessments is or, that is, one of them does not meet the assessment standards, and the institution is approved.

* Institutions that do not meet the requirements of the assessment can apply again after 60 days. If they are dismissed again because the assessment does not meet the standards, the same subject can not apply for admission again. | | Affiliate partner | * Assessment Partners:

The partners who have been qualified to be TAP for over 90 days can participate in the assessment. The partners who have been qualified to be TAP for less than 90 days, including the new TAPs and the ones who have re-registered, are not able to be assessed.

* Assessment method:

On the 1st day of each month, we will assess the amount of crossborder settlement GMV and the number of creators with sales for the sales amount paid in the past 90 days.
During the past 90 days, if the crossborder settlement GMV is equal or over 1000$, and the number of creators with sales is equal or over 5, the TAP eligibility will be preserved. If the TAP doesn't meet this standard, the TAP will receive the dismissal notice and the system authority will be withdrawn on 15th of the month.

* After being dismissed by the platform due to unqualified performance assessment, there are the following tips:

* From the day when the authority of the TAP is revoked, you can not apply for the TAP system again within 30 days. You can apply again after 30 days.

* If the performance assessment fails to meet the standard TWICE, the authority of the TAP will be permanently revoked at the second time, and it will not be possible to apply for activation again. | | Talent Scout | At least one online-anchor uploaded | | Shop On-boarding Service | Starting from the first natural month after the partner onboard, it needs to meet the requirements of relevant performance indicators in each subsequent natural month. If the partner does NOT meet requirements for two consecutive months, it will be removed from the TTSPC,and the partner can re-apply in 60 days. However, if the partner fail again, the same subject shall not be able to re-apply once again.
The partner must meet the following specific requirements:
1) The number of active TikTok Shop sellers recommended by the partner in a natural month is more than 100;
2）The number of active TikTok Shop sellers with paid deposits recommended by the partner in a natural month is more than 30; |

En estos Términos para Desarrolladores, "**Tú**" o "**Desarrollador**" significa la persona o entidad que está suscribiendo estos Términos para Desarrolladores (y "**Tu**", “**Tuyo**” en consecuencia).

En su caso, estos Términos para Desarrolladores también rigen cualquier otro contrato o adenda (en dichos términos y según lo dispuesto por TikTok) realizados en relación con estos Términos para Desarrolladores.
Al aceptar estos Términos para Desarrolladores o al descargar, instalar, acceder, usar u operar los Servicios para Desarrolladores de TikTok Shop, aceptas que has leído y estás de acuerdo con estos Términos para Desarrolladores. Si no aceptas estos Términos para Desarrolladores, no debes acceder o utilizar los Servicios para Desarrolladores de TikTok Shop.
## 1. **Definiciones**
1.1 **Aplicación**: significa las aplicaciones de software, sitios web, canales y otros productos digitales creados por el Desarrollador que utilizan los Servicios para Desarrolladores de TikTok Shop, junto con sus mejoras, actualizaciones, nuevas versiones y otras modificaciones y cambios.

1.4 **Vendedor**: significa un vendedor en TikTok Shop que ha aceptado los [Términos de Servicio para Vendedores de TikTok Shop](https://seller-es.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6946544789522209&article_type=agreement&identity=1).
1.5 **Creador**: significa un creador en TikTok Shop que ha aceptado los Términos de Uso para Creadores de TikTok Shop ([RU](https://seller-uk.tiktok.com/university/essay?role=1&knowledge_id=1748199815857952&from=other&article_type=agreement&identity=1), [UE](https://seller-es.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7201317474797344&article_type=agreement&identity=1)).
1.6 **TikTok Shop API**: significa las interfaces de programación de aplicaciones de TikTok Shop, kits de desarrollo de software, especificaciones, código de muestra, datos, metadatos, tecnología, software y otra información y materiales asociados, así como cualquier actualización de los mismos que TikTok te proporciona a Ti a los efectos de estos Términos para Desarrolladores.
1.7 **Información de TikTok Shop:** significa cualquier dato e información puesta a Tu disposición a través de la TikTok Shop API o por cualquier otro medio autorizado por TikTok, y cualquier copia y obras derivadas de la misma.

<div style="text-align: center"><h2 id="ba3065a3"><strong>ANEXO A MEDIDAS Y CONTROLES MÍNIMOS DE SEGURIDAD</strong></h2></div>

Estas Medidas Mínimas de Seguridad podrán ser modificadas ocasionalmente por nosotros (actuando razonablemente) proporcionando al Desarrollador una sustitución. El Desarrollador deberá aplicarlas en relación con los datos personales tratados en virtud de los presentes Términos para Desarrolladores. El Desarrollador documentará, implementará y tendrá un programa de seguridad de la información que cumpla con los estándares de las mejores prácticas de la industria para proteger dichos datos personales, que incluirá:
I. **Control de Entrada al Sistema**
Establecer, mantener, monitorizar y utilizar las salvaguardas técnicas, físicas, administrativas y organizativas apropiadas de acuerdo con los más altos estándares de la industria para protegerse contra un Incidente de Seguridad incluyendo, como mínimo:
(a) Protocolos seguros de autenticación de usuarios y control de acceso al sistema;
(b) Uso de seguridad física madura y adecuada, software antimalware, antivirus y de seguridad actual que incluya filtrado de correo electrónico y detección de software malicioso;
(c) Utilización de medidas adecuadas de protección de la red;
(d) Durante los tiempos de inactividad, los equipos proporcionados por la empresa (por ejemplo, los ordenadores portátiles proporcionados por la empresa) se bloquean automáticamente;
(e) Fomentar el uso de contraseñas complejas;
(f) Concepto de mínimo privilegio, que permite sólo el acceso necesario para que los usuarios realicen su función laboral. Los accesos superiores requieren la autorización adecuada;
(g) Los privilegios de acceso a TI son revisados periódicamente por el personal adecuado;
(h) Servicios de monitorización de la red implementados 24 x 7 x 365 para detectar actividades no autorizadas;
(i) Exploración y corrección de vulnerabilidades;
(j) Pruebas de penetración, según proceda; y
(k) Protocolos de cifrado aplicados según sea necesario en diversas circunstancias.
II. **Controles de Acceso Físico**
El Desarrollador adoptará, entre otras, las medidas de seguridad oportunas para determinar la identidad de las personas autorizadas e impedir el acceso no autorizado a los locales e instalaciones del Desarrollador en los que se traten los datos.
III. **Control de Acceso a los Datos**
El Desarrollador adoptará las medidas técnicas y organizativas necesarias para impedir actividades no autorizadas en los sistemas de tratamiento de datos fuera del ámbito de las autorizaciones concedidas, incluyendo, como mínimo:
(a) Acceso de usuarios y administradores a la red sobre un modelo de derechos de acceso basado en roles. El modelo de autorización concede derechos de acceso a los datos únicamente en función de la "necesidad de saber";
(b) Administración de los derechos de los usuarios a través de los administradores del sistema;
(c) El número de administradores se reduce al mínimo absoluto;
(d) Realizar las auditorías internas necesarias para evaluar los procesos, tecnologías y personas de alto riesgo;
(e) Prohibir a cada empleado revelar los datos personales a terceros no autorizados o utilizar los datos personales de forma no autorizada.
(f) Cuando se utiliza el cifrado de datos, aplicar prácticas adecuadas de gestión del ciclo de vida de las claves.
IV. **Control de Transferencia de Datos**
El Desarrollador adoptará las medidas de índole técnica y organizativas necesarias para evitar que los datos personales puedan ser leídos, copiados, alterados o suprimidos por personas no autorizadas durante su transmisión electrónica o durante su transporte o grabación en soportes de datos, así como para garantizar que sea posible examinar y determinar dónde se encuentran o han sido transmitidos los datos personales por equipos de transmisión de datos, incluyendo, como mínimo:
(a) El acceso remoto a los sistemas informáticos (incluso durante los procedimientos remotos de mantenimiento o servicio) se realizará a través de túneles VPN, cuando proceda, u otras conexiones seguras y cifradas;
(b) Protocolos de cifrado aplicados según sea necesario en diversas circunstancias;
(c) Los dispositivos de conservación de datos y los documentos en papel se guardan bajo llave cuando no se utilizan (por ejemplo, política de escritorio limpio);
(d) Destrucción y eliminación adecuadas de los documentos;
(e) Procesos de destrucción física según las normas del sector;
(f) Sesión de comunicación segura establecida mediante seguridad de la capa de transporte (“TLS”) o protocolos similares a través de aplicaciones/servicios centrales.
(g) Certificados cifrados utilizados para la autenticación entre el cliente web central y el servidor web central.
V. **Control de Entradas**
El Desarrollador adoptará las medidas técnicas y organizativas adecuadas para que, con posterioridad, sea posible verificar y determinar, a través de ficheros de registro, si se han introducido datos personales en los sistemas de tratamiento de datos, o se han modificado o suprimido, y quién lo ha hecho.
VI. **Marco de Control**
El Desarrollador adoptará las medidas técnicas y organizativas necesarias para garantizar que los datos personales transferidos en virtud de los Términos para Desarrolladores sólo puedan ser tratados para los fines especificados en los Términos para Desarrolladores, incluyendo, como mínimo:
(a) Unas políticas internas claras y vinculantes que contienen instrucciones formalizadas para los procedimientos de tratamiento de datos;
(b) Protecciones contractuales claramente articuladas, según proceda, en los contratos subyacentes;
(c) Formación periódica del personal sobre el uso adecuado del sistema de seguridad informática, los procedimientos de copia de seguridad y recuperación en caso de catástrofe, y la importancia de la seguridad para garantizar el cumplimiento de los acuerdos contractuales y mantener la concienciación sobre los requisitos de protección de datos;
(d) Procesos de destrucción segura según los estándares de la industria;
(e) Revisiones periódicas de accesos que monitoricen los controles de acceso de los empleados; y
(f) La red corporativa del Desarrollador está separada de su red de servicios al usuario mediante complejos dispositivos de segregación.
VII. **Control de Disponibilidad**
El Desarrollador adoptará medidas técnicas y organizativas para proteger los datos de la destrucción o pérdida accidental, incluyendo, como mínimo:
(a) Aparatos para monitorizar la temperatura y la humedad en centros de datos;
(b) Detectores de incendios/humo y extintores o sistema de extinción de incendios en los centros de datos;
(c) Uso de software antivirus maduro y adecuado que incluya filtrado de correo electrónico y detección de software malicioso;
(d) Medidas de recuperación de datos y plan de emergencia implantados y comprobados periódicamente;
(e) Aplicación de métodos de copia de seguridad maduros y adecuados, incluida la separación física de los datos de copia de seguridad y la conservación de los datos conservados en un archivo redundante;
(f) Utilizar una combinación de copias de seguridad completas, diferenciales y acumulativas para garantizar la integridad de los datos y la restauración oportuna de los datos principales, según proceda;
(g) Para garantizar un suministro ininterrumpido de energía al sistema, se incorporan fuentes de alimentación redundantes siempre que es posible;
(h) Verificación periódica de la integridad de los datos conservados mediante sumas de comprobación;
(i) Procesos establecidos para trasladar el tráfico de datos del área afectada al área no comprometida en caso de fallo;
(j) El mantenimiento preventivo se realiza para garantizar la operatividad continua de los equipos; y
(k) Tecnología adecuada frente a denegación de servicio y denegación de servicio distribuida para defenderse de los ataques de inanición de recursos basados en la red y los sistemas.
VIII. **Normas mínimas de seguridad**
Debes documentar, implementar y mantener un programa de seguridad de la información que cumpla con los estándares de las mejores prácticas de la industria, que incluirá:
**(a) Políticas de seguridad de la información**
(i) Políticas de seguridad aprobadas acordes con las normas del sector (ISO 27001 o NIST 800-53);
(ii) Certificación estándar del sector, como ISO27001 o SOC2;
(iii) (Como mínimo) revisión anual de las políticas de seguridad de la información; y
(iv) Diagrama de flujo de datos conceptual de alto nivel.
**(b) Organización de la seguridad de la información**
(i) Función específica de seguridad de la información responsable de las iniciativas y operaciones de seguridad;
(ii) Descripción de alto nivel de las funciones y responsabilidades dentro de la organización de seguridad; y
(iii) Función específica de gestión de riesgos para la seguridad de la información.
**(c) Seguridad de los recursos humanos**
(i) Contratos de confidencialidad firmados por todo el personal que maneja datos confidenciales;
(ii) Concienciación, educación y formaciones anuales en materia de seguridad;
(iii) Verificación de antecedentes de usuarios corporativos;
(iv) Verificación de antecedentes de contratistas;
(v) Procedimiento disciplinario en caso de infracción;
(vi) Responsabilidades de gestión de la seguridad documentadas;
(vii) Controles de terminación o cambio de empleo; y
(viii) Sistemas tecnológicos y de gobernanza de RR.HH. específicos.
**(d) Gestión de Activos**
(i) Supervisión de la gestión de activos y datos;
(ii) Asignación de la propiedad de todos los activos;
(iii) Clasificación y tratamiento de los activos; y
(iv) Proceso de gestión y eliminación de soportes extraíbles.
**(e) Control de acceso**
(i) Los conceptos de seguridad de mínimo privilegio, segregación de funciones y necesidad de conocer están integrados en el proceso de gestión de accesos;
(ii) Programa de control de garantía de acceso;
(iii) Revisión periódica del acceso (al menos una vez al año);
(iv) Terminación del acceso en 24-48 horas para usuarios separados;
(v) Gestión de derechos de acceso privilegiados;
(vi) Uso de autenticación multifactor (MFA) y/o inicio de sesión único (SSO);
(vii) SAML 2.0 o integración SCIM fácilmente disponible para TikTok;
(viii) Requisitos de complejidad/configuración de contraseñas de acuerdo con los estándares de TikTok; y
(ix) Sistema de gestión de contraseñas con controles de seguridad aplicables (en su caso).

detail.title: TSP Certification Program for Local Thailand TSPs
detail.content:
# **What is the TSP Certification Program?** The TikTok Shop Partner (TSP) Certification Program recognizes and rewards top-performing partners who provide excellent services beyond market standards. The program was launched for local TSPs in Thailand in Q1 2024. Under the program, TSPs who provide fulfillment and content management services to sellers can earn points based on good performance. Awards will be given every quarter based on performance in that quarter. There are 2 tiers of award - Premier and Certified given to TSPs who achieve at least 80 points or 50 points respectively. There will be separate awards for shop management and content management. For example, a TSP can be awarded Premier for shop management and Certified for content management.
# **Benefits of Awards** 1. **Recognition** TSPs will receive official badges for use on publicity communications with the approval of the TikTok Shop team.
2. **Customer Acquisition** Premier-tier TSPs will have increased visibility through publicity banners in the Seller Center. 3. **Operations** TSPs will receive monthly aggregated performance reports and increased operations support. The awards and benefits will be valid for the following quarter e.g. awards given for performance in Q1 2024 will be valid in Q2 2024, following which, they become invalid and should no longer be used on publicity communications. # **Scoring Details** Points will be awarded based on performance of your managed shops, using the following metrics: **Shop Management Scorecard as of Q1 2024** | **Metric Type** | **Metric** | **Weight** | **Poor** | | **Good** | | **Excellent** | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | | | | **Criteria** | **Score** | **Criteria** | **Score** | **Criteria** | **Score** | | **Selling Ability** | Total number of TSP sellers for which fulfillment services are provided | 20% | <5 | 0 | 5-15 | 1 | ≥15 | 2 | | | Average GMV per bound seller from Shop Tab in the past 30 days | 20% | <2.4 USD | 0 | 2.4-30K USD | 1 | ≥30k USD | 2 | | **Fulfillment Ability** | Average Seller Fault Cancellation Rate (%) | 15% | ≥0.50% | --- | 0.40-0.50% | 1 | <0.40% | 2 | | | Average Late Dispatch Rate (%) | 15% | ≥1.65% | --- | 1.40-1.65% | 1 | <1.40% | 2 | | | Average Seller Fault Returns and Refunds Rate (%) | 10% | ≥0.10% | --- | 0.08-0.10% | 1 | <0.08% | 2 | | | Average Order Negative Review Rate (%) | 10% | ≥0.35% | --- | 0.25-0.35% | 1 | <0.25% | 2 | | | Total number of severe IPR violations over past 90 days | 10% | ≥1 | --- | --- | --- | 0 | 2 | > For more information on fulfillment ability metrics, please refer to the [TikTok Shop Seller Performance Evaluation Policy](https://seller-th.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6837812376831746). **Content Management Scorecard as of Q1 2024** | **Metric Type** | **Metric** | **Weight** | **Poor** | | **Good** | | **Excellent** | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | | | | **Criteria** | **Score** | **Criteria** | **Score** | **Criteria** | **Score** | | **Content Selling Ability**
| Total number of TSP sellers for which content management services are provided, who are active* in the past 90 days
**Post at least 1 short video or livestream* | 10% | --- | 0 | <10 | 1 | ≥10 | 2 | | | Total number of livestreaming hours over past 90 days*
**Only count sessions >120min* | 15% | <600hr | 0 | 600-3000hr | 1 | ≥3000hr | 2 | | | Total number of videos published over past 90 days | 10% | <100 | 0 | 100-600 | 1 | ≥600 | 2 | | | Total self-sale GMV over past 90 days | 10% | <200k USD | 0 | 200k-1mil USD | 1 | ≥1mil USD | 2 | | | Average GMV per Livestream over past 90 days*
**Only count sessions >120min* | 10% | --- | 0 | <500 USD | 1 | ≥500 USD | 2 | | | Average Live Show GPM over past 90 days*
**GPM = Average GMV per 1,000 views* | 10% | --- | 0 | <5 USD | 1 | ≥5 USD | 2 | | | Average Video Show GPM over past 90 days*
**GPM = Average GMV per 1,000 views* | 10% | --- | 0 | <5 USD | 1 | ≥5 USD | 2 | | **Content Service Ability** | Number of maximum severe* content violations of any 1 seller over past 90 days
**Including reproduced content, underage promotional content, promoting prohibited products.* | 20% | ≥2 | --- | 1 | 1 | 0 | 2 | | | Average content violation points over past 90 days | 5% | ≥1 | --- | 0.5-1 | 1 | <0.5 | 2 | > For more information on content service ability metrics, please refer to the [TikTok Shop Creator Performance Evaluation Guidelines](https://seller-th.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6837794815706882). # **How To Participate** If you would like to register, please contact tts.partner.certification@bytedance.com or your TikTok agency partner manager. You will receive a registration form. To register, you must manage at least 3 sellers on TikTok Shop. For shop management category, please only include the shop if you provide order fulfillment services. For content management category, please fill in all official/marketing creator accounts bound to each seller account. You must update us through your account manager when shops you manage change or when the category of service changes, using the same form. # **FAQs** 1. **Can I participate in the certification program if I only provide content management or shop management services?** Yes, you will still earn points under the content management or shop management categories and be eligible for the awards in that category. 2. **What happens if I make a false declaration of the shops I manage?** You may be excluded from the program and/or forfeit any previous awards received. Shops without a valid record of an authorized relationship between seller and TSP on Partner Center will not be counted toward score computation. 3. **Is it compulsory to join the program?** It is not compulsory, but we encourage all TSPs who are eligible to join the program. 4. **If you bind/unbind with sellers midway through the quarter, how will this be reflected in the score?** Please update us through your AM when shops you manage change or when the category of service changes. The scoring will be based on the list of shops that you manage and bind during the period. 5. **Will appeals against violations be reflected in the score?** We will generate the score on a monthly basis. If appeals are successful and the violation points are revoked before the generation date, they will be reflected in the score. 6. **How will I receive updates on my performance?** An aggregated report with your performance will be sent via email on a monthly basis. 7. **Is there a way to appeal the award given?** The award given is final and at TikTok Shop’s discretion. If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact your AM for further support. 8. **If a seller collaborates with multiple agencies, how is the score calculated?** The score will be attributed to the agency that registers the seller/handle in the form, aligning with the binding data in the system. Each agency can receive the score for one seller/handle at a time.
