detail.title: Edit certification details
detail.content:
## 🔥 **Product Overview** ### **Why do we support partners editing the certification details？** Currently, the partner is required to provide certification details to join TTSPC. Once the platform has reviewed and approved certification details, these certification details cannot be changed. However, there may be instances where a partner needs to update their certification details, such as their name, logo, etc. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/64d2ad25a8e642e3a6299214195d7c94~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2349f12e9f8849e79f3124d231cd8928~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) To streamline this process and improve partners' experience, we are now automating this process and offering partners the capability to edit certification details directly on TTSPC. ## ⭐️ **Feature introduction** ### Step 1 Precondition and entrance of editing certification You can go to [My Account➤Profile➤ My category](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/profile) to view the certification details for each category. For approved certifications, partners can click the **"edit"** to go to the editing page. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/dc0fec3d8a6149b585f9023121b4896a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0704229b6d7d4ea3b402e5861f4e751d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Precondition of editing** 1. Only **Approved** certification details can be edited, which excludes the following scenario 1. When the partner delivers certification details, it is still under review 2. When the partner delivers editing certification details, it's still under review *Uneditable situation demo | | Description | Demo | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | If the certification information is under review, the editing entry will be grey out | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/378de11e278e47ce885197adff5c1975~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | 2 | If the current cert has been approved, but some files are delivered editing requests and haven't been approved | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f0ddba063a364a4681b75d6ab2d0ebda~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ### Step 3 Edit certification details and submit You can edit the files according to your needs and click "Submit" to trigger the review process. **Please note:** 1. There are **certain sensitive files** related to the entity that cannot be changed, including the company's legal name, registration date, business documents, business owner information, etc. 2. Editing and resubmitting these files **will not affect the existing certification information** unless it has been approved. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a68d5590213842a283a013b158ebf143~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f8951f23724146508d4037446dc18c1a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ### Step 3 Check the review status After submitting, the Partner can check the status of the editing under each category: | Status | Status Description | Demo | | --- | --- | --- | | Approved | Editing is approved, and the edited certification details will come into effect and replace the previous ones. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/09cd09b27ceb4e0d977d34dd2fd58a36~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Under review | Editing is still under review. A partner can not edit again until it's approved/ rejected | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9791b9ab86714c239f497af8494abdf6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Not approved | Editing is rejected, a partner can click edit to modify and submit again | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d347b263d34b421e901164edb52c56d8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| ## FAQ **Q1: Why can't I modify some information？** Entity information is sensitive and unique information at the company level that cannot be changed, including the company's legal name, registration date, business documents, business owner information, etc.

detail.content:
For localized version, please visit the links below: 🇹🇭 Thailand: [TH_[คู่มือ] การจัดการบัญชีหลักและบัญชีสมาชิก](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/TctQdJBd3obVedxZlz2lUCN8gob) 🇲🇾 Malaysia: [MY_[User Manual] Mengurus Akaun Utama dan Ahli](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/QkoYdihRJoR2cNxyrtqllXCTgjh) 🇮🇩 Indonesia: [ID_[User Manual] Mengelola Akun Pengguna dan Akun Anggota](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/VPjWdFtJHoqICpxd62Il2zPKgSd) 🇻🇳 Vietnam: [VN TSP_Quản Lý Tài Khoản Chính và Tài Khoản Thành Viên trên TTSPC](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/H68bdPBobojCCDxRY5NlkL7Ng8f) # [EN] Managing Main and Member Accounts In this article, we will give you a quick guide on how to add member accounts and assign different roles and permission to provide you with more flexibility and help you manage different member accounts more effectively.
# Overview Prior to this update, the lack of member account features presented challenges in team operations and scaling up. Taking this into account, we've introduced an account management feature, enabling you to set up the main account and assign roles to team members for enhanced efficiency. * **Main Account:** The main account serves as the administrator, having control over all member accounts. The main account administrator can create, preview, and edit member accounts for any users. * **Member** **Account:** A member account is created by the main account. The main account can generate multiple member accounts and assign different roles to staff, each with unique permissions for daily operations, such as managing data or overseeing creators/sellers.
# Benefits of Adding Main and Member Accounts * **Improved Security:** Assigning member accounts and roles enhances security by granting limited access on a need-to-know basis, reducing the risk of unauthorised use and data breaches. * **Streamlined Workflow:** By assigning specific roles, team members can focus on their specific responsibilities and partner roles, promoting efficiency and preventing confusion over tasks. * **Enhanced Flexibility:** By assigning roles, team members can work independently using individual member accounts, helping you manage your business more efficiently.
# How to Add Member Accounts and Assigning Roles To create and assign member accounts to different roles, begin by defining a role and its permissions. Then, assign this role to your member accounts. Follow these step-by-step instructions for guidance. ## Customizing Role Permissions 1. Navigate to [My Account > Team Members](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/team-management)**.** Under **Added Roles** tab, click **'Add New Role.'**
2. Set the role name and choose role permissions by selecting the checkbox for each module. Once completed, click **'Confirm'** to finish the setup.
3. To edit roles you've created, return to the **Added Roles** tab, select the role you wish to edit, and click **'Edit.'** Then, follow the previous steps to assign role permissions. The changes will be applied to all member accounts under that role.
## Adding Member Accounts 1. To assign roles to your member accounts, first create a member account. Go to [My Account > Team Members](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/team-management)**.** Under the **Team Member Accounts** tab, click **'Add Team Member Account.'**
2. Enter the team member's email and assign the appropriate role to their account. After completion, click **'Add New Role.'**
3. The platform will send an activation email to the member's account email, which must be activated within 120 hours. After activation, the member account can log in to the Partner Center.
If the activation email expires, the main account can click **'Resend Email'** to send the activation email again.
## Log in with Member Accounts After clicking on the invitation link in the email, you will be redirected to the Partner Center, where you can sign up for a member account. You'll then be able to log in using a subaccount associated with your registered email or phone number. **Please note:** 1. Each email or phone number can be linked to only one subaccount or one main account. 2. Ensure you log out of any existing accounts in the Partner Center before logging in with your new member account. Failing to do so may result in an "unmatched" error. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/df2be87afd644ef890e27a1ab51a06ec~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Editing Member Accounts 1. If you made a mistake and need to edit the account, you can do so if the account status is **'Pending'** and the member hasn't activated the activation email. Go to [My Account > Team Members](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/team-management)**.** Under the **Team Member Accounts** tab, select the email of the member account you wish to edit.
2. Click the edit icon next to the email address and enter the new email. The platform will automatically send an activation email to the new member account email for activation. ## Deleting Member Accounts 1. To delete a member account, go to [My Account > Team Members](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/approval/team-management)**.** Under the **Team Member Accounts** tab, select the email of the member account you wish to delete and click the delete icon.
## Check Your Account Type For Sub Account: * Quickly confirm your account type via: **Log into TTSPC > My Account > Profile > check the account label** 1. If you’re on a **Main Account**, will not display the additional information. 1. If you’re on a **Sub Account**, you’ll see "Sub Account" label along with the Main Account ID.
non - US
US
For Main Account: * If you’re a Main Account holder managing sub-accounts, you can check team members' email via: **Log into TTSPC > My Account > Team members** 1. If there are team member accounts, the account list will show the full, plain-text email address of each team member. If an email is too long, hover over it to see the complete address. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/66ce5c60d5894e929446e3e100229053~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. If there is no team member account/no role under your Main Account, the team members page will show guidance on how to create and relevant explanations.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/868d2e82807c48f684a490fff02b411f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b7e56fc18d6d4828a4393e1f05223989~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
*Note*: Sub-account users can’t see other sub-accounts’ emails. This view is exclusive to Main Accounts for privacy.
# FAQ 1. **Can I directly assign permissions to a member account?** No, you can only assign roles to a member account. The member account will then inherit all the permissions associated with the roles assigned to it. 2. **How can I change the member account email if it has been changed/invalid?** If you made a mistake and need to edit the email, you can do so if the account status is 'Pending' and the member hasn't activated the activation email. Go to **My Account > Team Members.** Under the **Team Member Accounts** tab, click the edit icon to update the email for a particular member account. The activation email will be sent again to this new email. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/26f0555604a343d1b0f1841c954d5466~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c1a24944c67a4447aa5189e8931524f1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 3. **Will my newly added category certification and feature permissions be granted to member accounts automatically?** No, for new features, you need to add permissions and grant them to member accounts separately. 4. **What if my main account has been terminated by the platform? Could I still use my subaccount？** No, member account permission will be invalid if the main account has been terminated. 5. **I cannot access Seller Center while using Shop Analytics on Partner Center. What should I do?** If you are unable to access Seller Center while using Shop Analytics on Partner Center, please note that you won't be able to access Seller Center using your member account. To gain access to Seller Center, please contact the main account for assistance.

These categories make it easier for TikTok Shop sellers to find relevant services that align with their needs and goals. Partners can select the appropriate service category when creating a service to ensure it's listed in the relevant section of the App & Service Store, making it more discoverable to potential clients. 📌 The service categories available to a partner are determined by several factors, including the partner's registration region and their chosen target market. detail.title: Register as a service partner
detail.content:
**Updating Phone**📌 This is a guide to register as a service partner. It's applicable for CAP, MCN, TAP, and TSP. If you are a developer, please [see the developer guide](64f1993d9495ef0281851694).  
# Getting Started on TikTok Shop Partner Center
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ab3349b3334b492bb6867a5a4a5476a0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 1: Create an account
Create an account with your email and password. Phone number is optional.
📌 Please keep in mind that your email address will serve as the primary channel for receiving important platform notifications, so make sure it's valid and up-to-date.
**Important:** Be sure to use the Partner Center site specific to your market and company's business certification:

* If you are servicing creators or sellers in the **US market,** create an account at [partner.us.tiktokshop.com/account/sign-up](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/account/sign-up)
* If you are servicing creators or sellers in **non-US markets**, create an account at [partner.tiktokshop.com/account/sign-up](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/account/sign-up)

**Note:** The TikTok Shop Partner Platform and Open Platform merged into TikTok Shop Partner Center in late 2022. If you possess a TikTok Shop Partner Platform or Open Platform account, you can log in using your existing credentials on Partner Center.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5b614118c0db4a668854b0bd5d5af528~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 2: Select your category and market
After creating an account, you'll find a business guide tailored to different partner types. Pick your partner type from this guide, click on 'Start Business,' and it will lead you to the 'Get Started' page to initiate your application for your selected category.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3a616f116d7f40e9bd68d367d9e10310~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0978ee0512764f7c870738e0fa36c0b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

* **Registration Region:** Please ensure the region is consistent with your company's business certification.
* **Target Market**：
   * Cross-border partners (registration region is China and/or Hong Kong, China) have the option to select (US, UK, MY, VN, TH, PH, SG, ES, DE, FR, IT, JP) as their target market.
   * Local partners (entities in the local market) should choose only the local market as their target market.
* **Business Category:** Select your business category.

📌 The available business categories may vary depending on the registration region and target market. Learn more about [business categories for different markets](64f1989064ed2e0295f3c1b5).
### Select your category and market in Bulk
You can choose categories(Maximum of 4 categories) **in bulk** and fill in the required info on one page.
Note: if you are also applying for the Developer category, you can click "get app key now" to gain the app key and start building your app.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eade2bcf778b43e590922085d87172ac~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 3: Fill in the required information
You'll need to complete the necessary fields according to the category you've selected.
Tips: You can refer to the [partner application requirements](64f19899cb677b0286e75d67) for more information and have your documents prepared in advance.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bc306e63b6ca4b638413d73a7c6a9077~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 4: Submit application
Once you have completed step 3, click 'Submit' and wait for the submission review. You can check the status of your application by going to **My Account>>My category & market.**
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/58efa1fa975c44a7ba88a00d69312f83~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
📌 If your application is rejected, you can click 'Modify' to update the information and resubmit.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/422a62ad72ba44469e760c94e780f06a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Applying for a new category and market
If you want to provide service(s) to TikTok Shop sellers and creators, simply apply by adding a new category and market to your Partner Center account.
## Step 1: Add a new category and market to your profile
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/07e343df2c5c4e32bb9cec7e9705c7c9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
to My Account and click on 'Add Category & Market" on the profile page.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/52d89857a40746e5b628e0620e066d1c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 2: Select a new category and fill out the details
Partners need to finalize their selection of the new category and submit the required documents for the new role.
📌 Any common qualification information previously filled in for your previous category certification will be displayed automatically and can not be changed. You only need to complete additional documents relevant to the new category.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9bbd9d93a47a442e9525b6bf8ad86ef9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/78a09b59e47e4987ac6999dd09521ec2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Step 3: Submit application
After providing the necessary information, you can submit your application and monitor the review status on your profile page.
# Checking the status of your application
You can check the status of application on profile page:
| **Status** | **Screenshot** |
| --- | --- |
| Approved - You can click [view details] to view the information. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1ccbc5a6fa4495282ca0d46ffa034f9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) |
| Not approved - You can click [fix it] to review rejected reason and modify information. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3f09375d361c4d7194a2994161a8d5d9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) |
| Pending - Please wait patiently for platform to review | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/aba507452a9f4cb6a3473218d076c28a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) |
# Multi-role partner navigation
If you have multiple roles, you can easily select your partner role from the top navigation bar. Your role will be reflected in a streamlined single-column menu, allowing you for quicker and more focused navigation.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2e4544b38a6a4ed6916ae7a0881760d6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
Here's a breakdown of the available menu for different partner roles:
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4451aca6f42243a8b005d8c6fd30f306~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Managing your account
To manage your account information, such as login email, phone number, and password, go to **My Account>>Profile** page.
If you wish to change your login email, phone number, or password, simply click on the respective email address, phone number, or password on the right-hand side. You'll be prompted to verify your identity through an email or phone verification code before you can successfully update your email address, phone number, or password.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/41eaeeaec4b5463a8a461bf3c4a87d2f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

## **Updating Email/Phone/Password**
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1938c0c42f1c4ed99d16e15c46063bde~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

detail.title: [MY] Partner Tax Info Collection
detail.content:
# EN To comply with the E-invoice Guidelines issued by Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri Malaysia (LHDN), TikTok Shop Malaysia will issue e-invoices to partners for transactions conducted on the platform starting July 1st, 2026. These e-invoices serve as official documentation of income for partners, helping them to maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper income reporting to LHDN for tax compliance purposes. Thus, all partners on TikTok Shop need to provide the platform with their tax information. ****Note:*** *If partners do not provide tax information, the platform will still issue e-invoices following partners' basic information provided during the onboarding process. However, please note that in the absence of complete tax information, it may result in invoices that are not fully compliant or may not be accepted for your tax purposes. To avoid such limitations and ensure smooth tax compliance, partners are strongly encouraged to provide their tax information as early as possible.*
## Provide Tax Information Partners may submit their tax information on the [Tax Information](https://partner.my.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-finance/tax-information) page, starting from 16th April, 2026. The first batch of e-invoices will be issued in early May, 2026.
**Note: screenshots are for reference only. Actual interface and content may differ.* Information that partners need to provide include: * Business/company name * Business registration certificate/Company incorporation certificate * TIN * Billing address, which must be consistent with the address registered in the government's tax system. * SST status and SST number
## Check Verification Status Partners' information will need to be verified. Partners may check their verification status on the [Tax Information](https://partner.my.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-finance/tax-information) **** Page. There are three review statuses. partners need to keep track of their review status and provide updated information if needed until the review is successful. | Review Status | Explanation | Display on the [Tax Information](https://partner.my.tiktokshop.com/affiliate-finance/tax-information) page | | --- | --- | --- | | Review in progress | Tax information is being reviewed. Partners should check regularly to make sure their tax information is valid. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2742f8863b904a7c80c81bf7cc209c94~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | Review success | Tax information has been verified. Actual interface and content differ.* # MY Untuk mematuhi Garis Panduan E-invois yang dikeluarkan oleh Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri Malaysia ILHDN), TikTok Shop Malaysia akan mengeluarkan e-invois kepada rakan kongsi untuk transaksi yang dijalankan di platform bermula 1 Julai 2026. E-invois ini berfungsi sebagai dokumentasi rasmi pendapatan untuk rakan kongsi, membantu mereka mengekalkan rekod kewangan yang tepat dan memastikan pelaporan pendapatan yang betul kepada LHDN untuk tujuan pematuhan cukai. Oleh itu, semua rakan kongsi di TikTok Shop perlu menyediakan platform dengan maklumat cukai mereka. ****Nota:*** *Jika rakan kongsi tidak menyokong maklumat cukai, platform masih akan mengeluarkan e-invois mengikut maklumat asas rakan kongsi yang diberikan semasa proses onboarding. Walau bagaimanapun, untuk mematuhi peraturan cukai Malaysia dengan sebaik mungkin dan mengelakkan potensi kesulitan dalam pematuhan cukai, adalah menjadi kepentingan terbaik rakan kongsi untuk memberikan maklumat cukai secepat mungkin.*

detail.title: [SEA] Creator Level for Partners
detail.content:
In this article, we’ll show teach you how to navigate and use the Creator Level system to support your future partnerships with Affiliate Creators. To get you started, we will go over the following: * What is Creator Level? * Why Do We Show Creator Level to Partners? * Where to find the Creator's Levels in the Partner Center **The tasks and benefits shown in the screenshots may not reflect the current version of Creator Level. Please check your Partner Center for the most up-to-date list.*
# What is Creator Level? **Creator Level** is a season-based program that gives Creators a set of tasks in order to level up and receive rewards. * Creators are ranked from Level 0 (L0) to Level 8 (L8), with levels refreshed at the start of each month based on the previous month’s performance. Performance is evaluated using GMV, activity level, and product selection and e-commerce capabilities. * **Higher Creator Levels** reflect stronger GMV generation and consistent affiliate activity. They also unlock greater benefits and support from the platform. To learn more from the Creator POV, **read our guide here.**
# Why Do We Show Creator Level to Partners? | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/cb40f4d3778740b8aaf714a645c4c001~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Easily Spot Top Talent with Creator Levels**

* The Creator Level feature makes it simple for partners to discover high-performing creators. Updated monthly, it highlights who’s driving strong sales and staying active—so you can build smarter, more reliable affiliate collaborations.

**Partner with the Best, Reap the Rewards**

* Creators at higher levels enjoy exclusive perks and platform support, giving your campaigns an extra boost and helping drive major sales results.
| | --- | --- |
# Where to find the Creator's Levels in the Partner Center On the Partner Center, you will start seeing Creator Levels on various modules. You can use the Creator Levels as a guide or marker on choosing the right Creator to establish a partnership with. With the Creator levels, you can get a glimpse of how active a Creator is in a month-long period. ## Find Creators Creator's level can be found next to the creator's name on the **Find Creator**'s main page and Creator Detail Page.
### Find Creator Filter When searching for creators, partners can filter by the creator's level, which is available under the "Creators" filter. Partners can select one or more levels when applying the filter.
# FAQ 1. Can only Partners see the Creator Level in their desktop centers? * No, Creator Levels are also visible for Sellers. # **ID - Level Kreator untuk Partner** Dalam artikel ini, kami akan menunjukkan cara menggunakan Level Kreator untuk mendukung kemitraan Anda di masa depan dengan Kreator Afiliasi. Untuk memulai, kami akan membahas hal-hal berikut: * Apa itu Level Kreator? * Mengapa Kami Menampilkan Level Kreator kepada Partner? * Cara Menemukan Level Kreator di Partner Center *Catatan: Tugas dan manfaat yang ditampilkan dalam tangkapan layar mungkin tidak mencerminkan versi terbaru dari Level Kreator. Silakan periksa Partner Center Anda untuk daftar terbaru.*
# **Apa itu Level Kreator?** Level Kreator adalah program berbasis musim yang memberikan serangkaian tugas kepada kreator untuk naik level dan mendapatkan hadiah. * Kreator diklasifikasikan dari Level 0 (L0) hingga Level 8 (L8), dengan level yang diperbarui di awal setiap bulan berdasarkan performa bulan sebelumnya. Evaluasi dilakukan berdasarkan GMV, tingkat aktivitas, serta kemampuan dalam memilih produk dan menjalankan bisnis e-commerce. * Level yang lebih tinggi mencerminkan performa lebih kuat dalam menghasilkan GMV dan aktivitas afiliasi yang konsisten. Kreator dengan level tinggi juga mendapatkan lebih banyak keuntungan dan dukungan dari platform. Untuk mempelajari lebih lanjut dari sudut pandang kreator, baca panduan kami **di sini.**
# **Mengapa Kami Menampilkan Level Kreator kepada Partner?** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/89c8a4442daf42a1a13786ead70dc1dd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Temukan talenta terbaik dengan mudah melalui Level Kreator**

* Fitur Level Kreator memudahkan partner untuk menemukan kreator berperforma tinggi. Fitur ini diperbarui setiap bulannya sehingga dapat menunjukkan siapa yang aktif dan menghasilkan penjualan—membantu Anda membangun kolaborasi afiliasi yang lebih cerdas dan andal.

**Bermitra dengan yang terbaik dan dapatkan hasil Maksimal**

* Kreator dengan level tinggi menikmati keuntungan eksklusif dan dukungan dari platform yang dapat memberikan dorongan ekstra pada campaign Anda dan membantu meningkatkan penjualan secara signifikan. | | --- | --- |
# **Cara Menemukan Level Kreator di Partner Center** Di Partner Center, Anda dapat melihat Level Kreator di berbagai modul. Anda dapat menggunakan level ini sebagai panduan atau penanda untuk memilih kreator yang tepat untuk dijadikan mitra. Level ini memberi gambaran seberapa aktif seorang kreator selama periode satu bulan. ## **Temukan Kreator** Level kreator dapat ditemukan di samping nama kreator di halaman utama "Temukan Kreator" dan di halaman detail kreator.
### **Filter Pencarian Kreator** Saat mencari kreator, partner dapat memfilter berdasarkan level kreator, yang tersedia di bawah filter "Kreator". Partner dapat memilih satu atau lebih level saat menerapkan filter.
## **FAQ** 1. **Apakah hanya Partner yang bisa melihat Level Kreator di desktop Partner Center mereka?** * Tidak, Level Kreator juga dapat dilihat oleh Penjual (Sellers). # **MY - Tahap Kreator untuk Rakan Kongsi** Dalam artikel ini, kami akan tunjukkan cara untuk menavigasi dan menggunakan sistem Tahap Kreator bagi menyokong kerjasama anda dengan Kreator Afiliasi pada masa hadapan. Untuk permulaan, kami akan menerangkan perkara berikut: * Apa itu Tahap Kreator? * Mengapa Kami Paparkan Tahap Kreator kepada Rakan Kongsi? * Di Mana Nak Cari Tahap Kreator dalam Partner Center *Nota: Tugas dan faedah yang dipaparkan dalam tangkapan skrin mungkin tidak mencerminkan versi terkini Tahap Kreator. Sila semak Partner Center anda untuk senarai paling terkini.*
# **Apa itu Tahap Kreator?** Tahap Kreator ialah program bermusim yang memberikan tugasan kepada para kreator untuk naik ke tahap lebih tinggi dan menerima ganjaran. * Kreator dinilai dari Tahap 0 (L0) hingga Tahap 8 (L8), dan tahap akan dikemas kini pada awal setiap bulan berdasarkan prestasi bulan sebelumnya. Penilaian dilakukan berdasarkan GMV, tahap aktiviti, serta kebolehan dalam pemilihan produk dan pengurusan perniagaan e-dagang. * Kreator bertahap lebih tinggi menunjukkan prestasi yang lebih kukuh dalam menjana GMV dan kekal aktif dalam aktiviti afiliasi. Mereka juga menikmati lebih banyak faedah serta sokongan daripada platform. Untuk tahu lebih lanjut dari perspektif kreator, sila baca panduan kami di sini.
# **Mengapa Kami Paparkan Tahap Kreator kepada Rakan Kongsi?** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9ae9552aaf75426c8caa8001c740e9a9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| **Kenal Pasti Bakat Terbaik dengan Mudah melalui Tahap Kreator**
Ciri Tahap Kreator memudahkan rakan kongsi untuk mengenal pasti kreator berprestasi tinggi. Ia dikemas kini setiap bulan untuk menunjukkan siapa yang aktif dan berjaya menjana jualan—membolehkan anda membina kerjasama afiliasi yang lebih bijak dan boleh dipercayai.
**Bekerjasama dengan yang Terbaik, Dapatkan Hasil Maksimum**
Kreator pada tahap yang lebih tinggi menikmati ganjaran eksklusif dan sokongan dari platform, yang dapat meningkatkan lagi kempen anda dan membantu menjana jualan yang lebih besar. | | --- | --- |
# **Di Mana Nak Cari Tahap Kreator dalam Partner Center?** Di Partner Center, anda akan mula melihat Tahap Kreator dipaparkan dalam pelbagai modul. Anda boleh gunakan tahap ini sebagai panduan untuk memilih kreator yang sesuai untuk dijadikan rakan kerjasama. Tahap ini juga memberi gambaran sejauh mana kreator tersebut aktif dalam tempoh sebulan. ## **Cari Kreator** Tahap kreator boleh dilihat di sebelah nama kreator dalam halaman utama "Cari Kreator" dan juga dalam halaman Butiran Kreator.
### **Penapis Cari Kreator** Semasa mencari kreator, rakan kongsi boleh menapis berdasarkan tahap kreator, yang tersedia di bawah penapis "Kreator". Anda boleh pilih satu atau lebih tahap untuk digunakan.
# **Soalan Lazim (FAQ)** 1. **Adakah hanya Rakan Kongsi yang boleh melihat Tahap Kreator dalam Partner Center desktop mereka?** * Tidak, Tahap Kreator juga boleh dilihat oleh Penjual.

TikTok Shop Partner Center（US Market) : [https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/) # Onboarding Workflow ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b4a0e2779d4e47b6b301d2561cfb866e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Step 1: Register an account You can register an account with Email, Phone number (optional), and password. **Please note that* the *email address is* critical *and will be used to receive platform emails. Please make sure this is a real and valid email address.*
# Step 2: Choose a Role * "TikTok Shop Partner" (for TSP/CAP/TAP roles). * "Developer" (for ISV roles). ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9f1fc765fdbb4a3b9806aa82c9e5ab0b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Step 3: Fill Out Company Details Provide company entity info for platform review. Any additional submissions will result in your application being rejected ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6a3c22807b1442f9b26f1a749a86187c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) *Category information list: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/88c3626c40ee4c7d944fba75030afafe~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) After successfully submitting your onboarding application, you will see this confirmation page. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/74f081bec88b4d5c9e99f6401f3e4d69~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Step 4: Apply and check review status After delivering the applications, you can go to **[My Account] ➤[Profile] ➤[ Company entity info]** to check the company entity info and review status. Under the [Service category info] Tab, you can check the review status of each category's applications. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/909f5c244e8b44e894fc29a375068184~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b5c949e47abf43ebbcad20a07a86bca0~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ***Status of application** | Status | Action | Demo | | --- | --- | --- | | Approved | For approved applications, you can view details or click **"Edit"** to modify related information | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b5620122d65542c78fcd8483d4387022~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Rejected | You can click[modify] to review **rejected reasons** and modify information | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/80ce9156dc3c4555ba1aae048c52e87b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| | Pending Review | Please kindly wait for the platform to review your applications
| ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/19a968df5b1d49ebbb4c3425c8cfb9f3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| Note: You can also click "add category & market" on the profile page to apply another new category as needed.
# *Experience For Existing Agency Partners ### New Service Category for All Agencies The service category upgrade will take effect from April 30. All existing partners might notice a slight difference in your system. **⚠️ Please note:** * This upgrade would not affect any related feature usage according to the different partner types * From **April 30th,** new partners will be **unable to register** for the discontinued categories of ++Mass Recruiting, Mass Tutoring, and Paid Media++**.** * From **June 5th**, **obtaining new authorization** from sellers for the discontinued categories of ++Mass Recruiting, Mass Tutoring, and Paid Media++ will no longer be possible. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c04e9c4573ae41f99de6b17ec5865045~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Together with the service category update, for the role switch button on other product pages, like payments and analytics pages... The role will reference the latest service category structure to retrieve the corresponding data.
### Check the existing onboarding status and information Your application status for each category will be **kept the same** as before. Your onboarding information will be integrated into a new user interface framework. You can view your entity information under the "Company Entity Info" section and access related category information and review statuses under the "Service Category Info" section. **Please note:** During the TTSPC upgrade, your onboarding application will be rejected, while the system will automatically generate another application under the same category. After the upgrade, your application will be processed. We appreciate your patience and kind understanding and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

detail.title: [US] Service Category- Shop Registration
detail.content:
# **Introduction** The Shop Registration service category empowers TSPs to streamline the process of referring sellers to TikTok Shop through automated referral link generation and link management. The service category is open to both Local-to-Local (operating locally in the U.S.) and Cross-Border (operating outside the U.S.) partners. # **Step by Step guide** ## U.S. Entity Partners ### **For new partners** New partners can directly follow the instructions in the **U.S. Agency Partner Onboard Guide.** Select "Shop Registration" when choosing a category, and follow the remaining guide. https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/683f1353f979330480b82080 ### **For existing partners** Please follow the steps below to complete the service application. ##### **Step 1: Apply for Shop Registration Service in "My Account - Profile"** 1. Initiate Service Category Application * Log in to TikTok Shop Partner Center (TTSPC). In the left-hand sidebar, navigate to My Account > Profile. * On the Profile page, switch to the Service category tab. Click the "+ Category & market" button to start applying for a new service category.
2. Select Category & Market In the “Start Business” > “Category & market” section * Registration region & Company registration region: Confirm as “United States” * Target market: Select “United States”. * Category & market: Under “TikTok Shop Partner”, choose "Outsourced Operations", then check "Shop registration" as the specific service category.
3. Fill Out Application Details * Proceed to the “Fill out details” step, fill relevent information * After filling in all fields, click the "Submit" button. You’ll see a "Submitted successfully" confirmation.
4. Check Application Status Return to the Profile > Service category tab. Track the “Shop registration” application status: it shows **Reviewing** during processing and updates to **Approved** once confirmed. Once approved, TSPs can use the Shop Registration service as per the feature’s functionality.
##### **Step 2: Create a custom shop registration service** 1. Initiate Custom Service Creation * Log in to TikTok Shop Partner Center (TTSPC). In the left-hand sidebar, click on App & Service. Then click the "+ Category & market" button * Select the Custom service type (public not available now). * Click the “Service category” dropdown, choose Outsourced Operation, then select "Shop registration" from its sub - options.
2. Configure Service Details * Fill in the necessary fields * Click the Create button to submit the custom Shop Registration service setup.
##### **Step 3: Publish custom shop registration service to get TTS seller shop registration url** 1. Publish the Service * Click the Publish button in the top-right corner. * In the pop-up confirmation, verify the target market
2. Get Referral Links * Once published, the service status updates to “On” * Two URLs are generated: one for local sellers and one for cross-border sellers.
3. Manage Service Activation/Deactivation * Click the `...` icon next to “Target sellers”. * Choose Deactivate to disable the service. * URL unchanged when TSP deactivate or re-publish same service
##### **Step 4: Seller Onboarding** When sellers click the link, they’re redirected to the U.S. TikTok Shop Seller Center verification page with a “Start selling” prompt to begin onboarding.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9263a92ca5244a41ae49842a4e055315~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/86a46ad5c6854285915aaa4bcab3d110~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
## Non-US entity Partners Similar to the U.S. entity steps, only the following differences exist: 1. The position of the "+ Category & Market/+类目与市场" button has changed slightly. And partners can only apply for Shop Registration Service from the "profile/个人信息主页"
2. The "Start Business/开始入驻" form for cross-border partners requires more information
*Last Updated: 28th Aug. 2025*

detail.title: [US] TikTok Shop Partner Tiering Mechanism
detail.content:
The TikTok Shop Partners('TSP') tiering system is designed to cultivate a robust ecosystem, set service benchmarks, and offer customized resources for TSP at various development stages—thereby guiding their growth path. *This Tiering Mechanism only applies to TikTok Shop Partners certified and operating in the US market.* # **Rules for TSP Tiering** ## **2.1 TSP Tiers** **For regular type TSPs** TSPs will be divided into 6 tiers from V0 to V5, corresponding to the V0 TSP->V1 Certified TSP->V2 Bronze TSP->V3 Silver TSP->V4 Gold TSP->V5 Platinum TSP levels. The higher the agency's rating, the stronger its comprehensive promotion capabilities. **For TSPs that focus on providing seller acquisition services** There will be an isolated tiering system to measure their tiers and provide them with corresponding operational tips, rights and benefits. ## **2.2 TSP Tier Calculation Rules & Key Evaluation Metrics** ### **2.2.1 Main Evaluation Metrics** After successfully registered as a TSP, partners will be evaluated and scored based on their selected service type(s) (single or multiple, including Creator Service, Seller Service - General, and Seller Service - Creator Matchmaking). Currently, our service provider rating primarily focuses on ① performance. Evaluations of ② capabilities and ③ compliance status will be gradually introduced at a later stage. | **Service Type** | **①Performance Metrics** | | --- | --- | | **Seller Service** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8797d2204e1748009a78092dc7814041~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | **Creator Service** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/0fd578d839174a0698560deb6740a4d1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | **Creator Matchmaking** | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/25bc964da9694f7c85c3bb5b344209b8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | ### **2.2.2 Calculation Rules** **Scoring Rules:** 1. Single Service: The overall rating is calculated as the final score × 90% service weight. 2. Multiple Services: The overall rating is calculated as the average score of each service × 110% - 130% service weight. **Tier Determination**: 1. The composite rating falls into the corresponding score range to determine the final tier. Tier promotion follows a step-by-step mechanism to ensure steady growth. For example, a TSP rated V1 in the prior evaluation cannot skip to V3 in the new rating. Instead, upgrading to V2 is a mandatory prerequisite before this TSP advancing to V3. 2. For rating as a V4 partner, partners must have at least one single service score ≥80 points and an overall score ≥80 points. 3. For rating as a V5 partner, partners must have at least one single service score >100 points and an overall score >100 points. **Score Range of TSP Tier** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e6e2b1726e684cb1a42cbd98db3c4a5b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) **Service Type x Service Weight** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e0a9a44c15dd48dabac9b2d569cc223c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## **2.3 TSP Tier Update Schedule** 1. The TSP tier will be updated on the 3rd~5th day of each following month, and it will be calculated according to the performance data of the partner in the previous month. 2. There may be a delay in updating the tiering results, and the actual update will be based on the notification within the product. 3. The tiering result is automatically calculated by the system based on various indicators. Since it is not a point-deduction system, appeals are not supported yet. 4. A violation point system will be implemented in the near future. # **Rights and Benefits of Different TSP Tiers** The platform grants TSPs different rights and benefits based on their tier levels and makes timely adjustments according to the rollout schedule of these benefits. The rights and benefits available to TSPs at different tiers include, but are not limited to: access to honor awards, account/store protect and appeal, livestream support, exclusive event privileges, operation support, and more. The different rights and benefits are matched according to the tier level of the TSP agency, and the specific approval standards follow the overall requirements. (To be continued) ## Detailed Rights and Benefits Here are some of the rights and benefits associated with partners in different tiers. More benefits will be gradually launched. Please consult your partner AMs for more information. Note： The specific requirements for the use of rights and interests shall be subject to the actual situation. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9e58ff728f3d4fb38f24cf4671ef0b51~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # How to check Partner Tiering on TikTok Shop Partner Center? All the tiering labels can be visible on TikTok Shop Partner Center( [https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/)） After logging in, partners will receive a notification to review the new tiering rules after the partner tier is officially launched. Click "**View the Introduction**" to understand the tier mechanism and corresponding benefits. * Local partners can check tiering badges on the Profile Page, Home Page, Role Switch Page, etc. * Cross-border partners can view tiering badges on the Home Page. Partners can view details about the definition of each tier by hovering over the tiering badge. Please note: Currently, tiering badges are only displayed for V1-V5 partners. V0 partners will not show a badge at this time.
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/850376dd665c4742abaf2617dceb53e2~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c3001c70a2394eb9a77dc97acaf21636~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

The platform reserves the right to adjust these rules in accordance with its development and operational management needs, and will publicly announce any changes. Once these rules take effect, continued use of the platform services by TikTok Shop Partners("TSP") will be deemed as acceptance and acknowledgment of the rules. If a TSP disagrees with these rules or any revised rules, it may follow the platform's guidelines to apply for discontinuation of the platform services.
